izzyondroid:com.craxiom.networksurvey.name: Network Survey
izzyondroid:com.craxiom.networksurvey.summary: Survey cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and GNSS, then log, stream or upload the data
izzyondroid:com.craxiom.networksurvey.description:
Network Survey turns an Android phone into a wireless survey tool. Pick what to survey, pick where the data goes, and press Start survey. One survey, one Start and one Stop.
 What it records 
 Cellular: serving and neighbor cells for GSM, CDMA, UMTS, LTE and 5G NR, including carrier aggregation
 Phone state: what the radio is doing
 Wi-Fi: access points, with channel, security and 802.11 standard
 Bluetooth: Classic and BLE devices, with company names and Find My trackers
 GNSS: GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou, QZSS, IRNSS and SBAS satellites
 Call records: calls, texts (SMS and MMS) and cell tower changes, saved to log files
 Where the data goes 
 Turn on one destination or several at once:
 Log files: CSV files on the phone
 NS Analytics: uploads to your team's workspace
 MQTT stream: JSON records to your own broker (for example Mosquitto ), with TLS and QR code setup
 gRPC stream: records to your own gRPC server
 Community databases: OpenCelliD and BeaconDB
 Message formats: messaging.networksurvey.app 
 NS Analytics 
 NS Analytics is the web analytics companion for Network Survey data. Connected phones upload their records to your workspace, so nobody copies files off phones. See your surveys on one map, open an analysis page for each record type, and export the raw records. Connect a phone by scanning the QR code on your workspace's Devices page. It is a separate web service: networksurvey.app/analytics 
 And more 
 Signals: live Cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and GNSS views, including AGC and C/N0 trends
 Map: towers from OpenCelliD and BTSearch, and the points your NS Analytics and Community database surveys covered, colored by signal strength
 Watchlist alerts when a saved Wi-Fi network is seen
 Cellular tools, PLMN lookup, OUI lookup and Wi-Fi spectrum
 Saved setups, light and dark themes, and nine accent colors
 Managed configuration (MDM) per record type and destination, and an Intent API
 Permissions and privacy 
 Location is needed because every record needs a position, and Android requires it to scan Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. Background location is requested only if you turn on Start survey automatically. This build has no Firebase, analytics or crash reporting. Privacy policy 
 Some anti-malware apps flag Network Survey because it can read SMS. It never sends texts and installs nothing. The SMS and call log permissions are used only for Call records (text events and the other party's number) and are asked for only when you turn Call records on, or set a survey that records them to start automatically. Both are optional: without them Call records still logs calls and tower changes. More on GitHub 
 Open source (Apache 2.0): github.com/christianrowlands/android-network-survey . Manual: networksurvey.app/manual . Requires Android 8.0 or later.

Processing

fdroid:com.polyalerts.name: PolyAlerts
fdroid:com.polyalerts.summary: Price & % alerts for Polymarket prediction markets. Unofficial. No account.
fdroid:com.polyalerts.description:
PolyAlerts is a lightweight, unofficial companion for following prediction markets on Polymarket. Set a target and get a notification the moment a market's price or probability reaches it — so you never have to sit and refresh a chart.
PolyAlerts is an information and notification tool. It does not place bets, hold funds, or process any transactions. When you want to act on an alert, one tap opens the official Polymarket website in your browser.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
* Browse and search live prediction markets across Politics, Sports, Crypto, Economy, Tech, World, Business and Pop Culture.
* Set a PRICE / PROBABILITY alert — get notified when an outcome reaches a % you choose (for example: "Yes rises to 60%").
* Set a MOVEMENT alert — get notified when an outcome moves by a chosen amount in either direction (for example: "moves by ±10%").
* See current probabilities and 24h volume at a glance.
* Open any market on Polymarket with one tap.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
* No account and no sign-up.
* No ads, no trackers, no analytics.
* Your alerts are stored only on your device.
HONEST ABOUT LIMITS
Alerts are checked periodically in the background. Delivery timing depends on your phone's battery and power-saving settings, so alerts are near-real-time, not instantaneous. If you rely on them, allow the app to run in the background in your device settings.
NOT AFFILIATED WITH POLYMARKET
PolyAlerts is an independent project. It is not created by, endorsed by, or affiliated with Polymarket. All market data comes from Polymarket's public API. "Polymarket" is used only to describe what the app tracks.
Prediction markets may be restricted or unavailable in your region. PolyAlerts only displays public information and sends reminders; any decision to visit Polymarket and trade is entirely your own.

fdroid:dev.encgallery.name: Wolf Gallery
fdroid:dev.encgallery.summary: Encrypted, offline photo & video vault with a comfortable gallery
fdroid:dev.encgallery.description:
Wolf Gallery is an offline gallery that keeps your photos and videos encrypted on the device.
Each file is stored as ciphertext in the app's private storage, so other apps and the system only ever see encrypted data. Files are decrypted on demand, including when you share to another app or set a wallpaper, so your media is never written out in the clear. You can use it as your main gallery or keep it next to the stock one as a private vault.
Development is active and ongoing.
 Security 
Every file is encrypted in an isolated vault inside the app's private storage. There is no internet permission and no accounts, cloud, telemetry or trackers, so the app simply cannot reach the network. Encryption uses authenticated AES-256-GCM, so any tampering is detected on decryption, and keys are derived from your passphrase with Argon2id, the memory-hard winner of the Password Hashing Competition. Your passphrase is never stored. The vault key is wrapped with an Argon2id key on top of the hardware-backed Android Keystore, so both the device and your password or PIN are needed to decrypt. The vault is symmetric-only, which makes it quantum-resistant by design, and a native crypto core zeroes key material in memory after use. Screenshots and Recents previews are blocked, wrong unlock attempts are slowed by exponential backoff, and an optional wipe after a set number of failures is available. A built-in self-test screen runs the crypto, file-format and migration checks right on your device.
 Organize 
Create groups and albums inside the app and rename anything, including with emoji. Sort, search and pin your groups, albums and files, set an album cover from any picture with adjustable framing, and import or export on your own terms — a whole group leaves as a folder with a subfolder per album. You can share to other apps or set a wallpaper directly from the vault.
 Appearance 
Choose from several themes, including pure-black dark modes, paired with a custom accent color. Adjust the grid density, switch thumbnails and albums between rounded and square corners, and place the action bar at the top or the bottom to suit your grip.
 Other 
A built-in trash keeps deletions undoable, a first-run wizard makes setup effortless, and the app is available in several languages with more translations on the way.

apple-macos:1537641390.description:
Share-A-Cart allows you to share the contents of your cart with anyone else.
Affiliate Disclosure: Share-A-Cart may earn an affiliate commission on purchases facilitated by the extension.
What Is Share-A-Cart?
Share-A-Cart is a free browser extension that lets you share your online shopping cart with anyone. Whether you're planning a grocery trip, sending a gift list, or managing a classroom supply order, Share-A-Cart makes collaborative shopping simple and efficient.
How to Share a Shopping Cart
1. Shop online like usual at your favorite retailer.
2. Use Share-A-Cart to generate a unique cart sharing link.
3. Send the link to anyone - they can instantly view and load your cart on their device.
Great for Home Use
- Share grocery lists with family
- Send birthday or holiday gift ideas
- Organize back-to-school shopping with kids or co-parents
Perfect for Work
- Teachers can share classroom supply lists with administrators
- Office staff can streamline purchasing with centralized supply lists
- Small businesses and teams can collaborate on procurement and restocking
Supports Thousands of Retailers
- Including Amazon, Walmart, Wayfair, Apple, and many more!
- See all supported stores here: https://share-a-cart.com/supported
Top Features
- Free to use – no sign-up required
- Supports 95% of all online stores
- View & organize carts with tags and keywords
- Reorder easily from cart history
- Print & export carts you've created or received
Who's Using Share-A-Cart?
- Families & friends planning meals and gifts
- Teachers and staff organizing supplies
- Offices and businesses streamlining orders
- Influencers sharing promoted products with followers
- Homebuilders managing client needs
Why Choose Us?
- Trusted since 2018
- Over 2 million carts shared
- Used in 1,400+ schools
- We don't sell your data to any third parties or data brokers
- Responsive customer support
FAQs
Q: Where is the extension icon?
A: It's on the right side of your toolbar. You may want to pin it so that it's always there. Just click the icon that looks like a puzzle piece, and then click the pin icon next to Share-A-Cart.
Q: What does Share-A-Cart do with my user data?
A: We don't sell user data to any data brokers. You can access most of our features for free and without giving us your email address or going through any registration process.
Q: If I send a link to a cart to someone, do they need the extension as well?
A: Not always. Many major retailers are fully supported without requiring the extension on the recipient's end.
Q: What if I find a retailer that you don't support? Or if I have an issue?
A: Email us at info@share-a-cart.com, and we'll get back to you right away. We are adding support for new retailers every week.
Q: Can the person I send a cart link to edit my cart?
A: Yes! The receiver of the cart can add or remove items and change quantities. This is really helpful if you are sending a giant wishlist (like a Christmas gift list) to someone because it allows them to choose exactly what they want to order.
Q: Why should I use Share-A-Cart instead of other extensions that do the same thing?
A: No other extension supports as many stores as Share-A-Cart, and we have many helpful features that our competitors don't. We have been in business since 2018, and this is not a 'side project' for us. And if you report an idea for a feature, new retailer, or a bug, we get back to you right away!
NOTE: Share-A-Cart does not complete any purchases on your behalf. It only helps shoppers move items from their cart to a recipient's cart. All checkouts must still be completed by the user. Share-A-Cart is not related to or endorsed by any of our listed retailers.
Email: info@share-a-cart.com

Reel Motion is where they become yours.
WORKOUTS YOU ACTUALLY WANT
Paste a link from a video you saved and Reel Motion writes it out as a routine you can follow: every exercise in order, with sets, reps, rest, and a plain instruction for each step, plus an illustration of the start and finish position for each move.
The ones that suit you stay. The ones that do not, you delete. What you are left with is a small library of workouts you chose, instead of a folder of links you keep meaning to open.

SHAPED THE WAY YOU TRAIN
Change anything. Reorder the moves, drop the one that hurts your shoulder, add a set, set your own rest.
Pick easier or harder and every routine adjusts its reps and hold times to match. Pick Mark or Eve and that sets the voice you hear and the style of the illustrations. Set a weekly goal that is yours rather than a default.
WHENEVER YOU FEEL LIKE IT
Your routines are on your phone, so training does not depend on finding the video again, on a signal, or on getting through an ad first. Reel Motion is paid and has no advertising in it. Nothing plays before your workout and nothing interrupts it.
When you start one, you get a single exercise on a dark screen you can read from a meter away, mid set, with one eye. A coach reads the steps aloud so you can keep your eyes off the phone, and you can say "start", "next", "done", "pause", "resume" or "repeat" instead of touching it. Your music keeps playing underneath and drops in volume when the coach speaks.
SEEING IT ADD UP
Sessions, active minutes, exercises done, and how the week is going against your goal. Finished workouts save to Apple Health if you let them.
No badges, no confetti, and nothing that nags you to train on a rest day.
ON YOUR WATCH AND MAC

On the Mac you can build routines and tidy your library on a full size screen. Sign in with Apple and the same library is on your phone, your iPad and your Mac.
SUBSCRIPTION

flathub:de.manuel_kehl.go-for-it.summary: A stylish to-do list with built-in productivity timer
flathub:de.manuel_kehl.go-for-it.description:
GoForIt! is a simple and stylish productivity app, featuring a to-do list, merged with a timer that keeps your focus on the current task.
To-do lists are stored in the Todo.txt format. This simplifies synchronization with mobile devices and makes it possible to edit tasks using other front-ends.

flathub:eu.vcmi.VCMI.name: VCMI
flathub:eu.vcmi.VCMI.summary: Open-source game engine for Heroes of Might and Magic III
flathub:eu.vcmi.VCMI.description:
VCMI is an open-source engine for Heroes of Might and Magic III with new possibilities. Years
 of intensive work resulted in an impressive amount of features. Among the current features are:
 Complete gameplay mechanics
 Almost all objects, abilities, spells and other content
 Basic battle AI and adventure AI
 Many GUI improvements: high resolutions, stack queue, creature window
 Advanced and easy mod support - add new towns, creatures, heroes, artifacts and spells without
 limits or conflicts
 Launcher for easy configuration - download mods from our server and install them immediately!
 Random map generator that supports objects added by mods
 Note: In order to play the game using VCMI you need to own data files for Heroes of Might and
 Magic III: The Shadow of Death.
 If you want help, please check our forum, bug tracker or GitHub page.

flathub:io.github.eminfedar.vaktisalah-g.name: Vakt-i Salah
flathub:io.github.eminfedar.vaktisalah-g.description:
Simple Prayer/Adhan Times App.
 Prayer times are getting fetched every month from Türkiye's Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı (Presidency of Religious Affairs).
 Network Permission: Fetching prayer times from internet.
 Microphone/Audio Permission: Play notification sound when X minutes left. No microphone access.

flathub:org.gnome.OfficeRunner.name: Office Runner
flathub:org.gnome.OfficeRunner.summary: Close your laptop lid and start running
flathub:org.gnome.OfficeRunner.description:
Office Runner is a game where tallying up the time taken to go from one place in
 your office to the other.
 Incidentally, it will also let you close your laptop lid without the computer going
 to sleep, which is useful to avoid having to reconnect to the network after your
 short trip.

flathub:org.jabref.jabref.name: JabRef
flathub:org.jabref.jabref.summary: Graphical Java application for managing BibTeX and biblatex (.bib) databases
flathub:org.jabref.jabref.description: JabRef is an open-source, cross-platform citation and reference management tool. Stay on top of your literature: JabRef helps you to collect and organize sources, find the paper you need and discover the latest research.

flathub:org.kde.falkon.name: Falkon
flathub:org.kde.falkon.description:
Falkon is a new and very fast Qt web browser. It aims to be a lightweight web browser available
 through all major platforms. This project has been originally started only for educational purposes.
 But from its start, Falkon has grown into a feature-rich browser.
 Falkon has all standard functions you expect from a web browser. It includes bookmarks, history
 (both also in sidebar) and tabs. Above that, you can manage RSS feeds with an included RSS reader,
 block ads with a built-in AdBlock plugin, block Flash content with Click2Flash and edit the local
 CA Certificates database with an SSL manager.

flathub:rocks.shy.VacuumTube.name: VacuumTube
flathub:rocks.shy.VacuumTube.summary: YouTube for TV, on your PC
flathub:rocks.shy.VacuumTube.description:
VacuumTube is an unofficial open source wrapper of YouTube Leanback (the console and Smart TV
 version of YouTube) for PCs, with a built-in adblocker and other enhancements. It is the best way
 to experience YouTube on your media center or handheld PC!

fedora-packages:ansible-pcp/ansible-pcp.description: A collection containing roles for Performance Co-Pilot (PCP) and related software such as Grafana and Valkey. The collection is made up of several Ansible roles, including: performancecopilot.metrics.pcp A role for core PCP capabilities, configuring live performance analysis with a large base set of metrics from the kernel and system services, as well as data recording and rule inference. performancecopilot.metrics.keyserver A role for configuring a local key server (Valkey/Redis), suitable for use with a Performance Co-Pilot archive repository (for single or many hosts) and fast, scalable querying of metrics. performancecopilot.metrics.grafana A role for configuring a local Grafana server, providing web frontend visuals for Performance Co-Pilot metrics, both live and historically. Data sources for Vector (live), Valkey (historical) and interactive bpftrace (eBPF) scripts can be configured by this role. The PCP REST API service (from the core pcp role) should be configured in order to use this role. performancecopilot.metrics.bpftrace A role that extends the core PCP role, providing metrics from bpftrace scripts using Linux eBPF facilities. Configuring authentication of a local user capable of running bpftrace scripts via the PCP agent is a key task of this role. performancecopilot.metrics.elasticsearch A role that extends the core PCP role, providing metrics from a live ElasticSearch instance for PCP analysis or exporting of PCP metric values (and metadata) to ElasticSearch for the indexing and querying of performance data.

firefox-addons:3111440.name: SakSak Ad Blocker
firefox-addons:3111440.summary: Fast, lightweight ad blocker for YouTube and every site. Removes ads, pop-ups and trackers. No data collection.
firefox-addons:3111440.description:
Ads gone. Pages faster.
SakSak ("싹싹" — Korean for "wiped clean") is a lightweight, fast ad blocker built with Korean websites in mind, and it works just as well everywhere else. Install it and ads and trackers on YouTube, news sites and portals are cleaned up right away — no setup required, with fine-grained control when you want it.
■ Features
• Ads & trackers — removes banners, pop-ups, video ads and in-article ads, and stops tracking scripts and pixels.
• YouTube ads — cleans up pre-roll and mid-roll ads and overlay banners.
• Strong on Korean sites — Korean filters for Naver, Daum, news sites and communities are built in, plus Japanese and Chinese regional filters; the one matching your browser language is turned on automatically.
• See what was blocked — tap the counter to see which companies' ads and trackers were blocked on the page, and how many.
• Fix it automatically — if a site looks broken, tap "Site broken?" and SakSak relaxes blocking on that site one step at a time until it works. It remembers only what fixed it, and you can undo it with one tap.
• Element remover — click anything left over, widen or narrow the selection and preview before hiding. Every erased element can be restored from the popup.
• Annoyance switches — notification-permission prompts are blocked and autoplaying sound is muted by default; newsletter pop-ups, chat buttons, recommended-article boxes, YouTube Shorts and end screens can be hidden too.
• Cookie banner cleanup and removal of tracking parameters (utm_source, fbclid…) from links.
• Home dashboard & monthly report — today, this week and this month: blocked items, data and time saved, and your most-blocked sites. Save the monthly report as an image to share.
• Import from other blockers — bring over your rules and allowed sites from uBlock Origin or AdGuard backups, or ABP-format rules.
• Quick filter updates — urgent rule fixes (data only) are fetched from youngsam.net every 12 hours, without waiting for a store update.
• Per-site off switch, pause on this tab only, and problem reports.
• Light, dark or system theme. Available in English, 한국어, 日本語 and 简体中文.
• Simple & Expert modes — start simple; Expert mode shows filter lists, your own rules and every blocked request.
■ Fast and light
SakSak uses the browser's built-in Manifest V3 rule engine (declarativeNetRequest), so the browser itself filters requests. No heavy scripts running on every page means less memory and battery use.
■ No data collection
SakSak does not collect any personal data or browsing history. Settings and stats stay in your browser, and there are no analytics or ad SDKs. A problem report is sent only when you review it and press Send.
■ How to use
 Pin the SakSak icon to your toolbar after installing.
 Click it to see how many items were blocked on the current site and the on/off button. Tap the number to see what was blocked.
 Leftover ad? Use "Remove element" (Alt+Shift+H). Broken page? Use "Site broken?".
Questions or bug reports: use "Report a problem" in the extension or https://youngsam.net/programs/saksak/report 
Made by YoungSam.net (영삼넷) https://youngsam.net — SakSak guides and release notes, other free programs and IT tips.
YouTube, Naver and Daum are trademarks of their respective owners. SakSak is not affiliated with them.

TranslateLocally is one of the products to come out of the Bergamot project . The Bergamot Project Consortium is coordinated by the University of Edinburgh with partners Charles University in Prague, the University of Sheffield, University of Tartu, and Mozilla. firefox-addons:985847.name: GateKeeper Password Manager
firefox-addons:985847.summary: GateKeeper Password Manager works with the GateKeeper Core desktop application to provide proximity based access to web credentials.
firefox-addons:985847.description:
Login to websites with your phone or a Bluetooth token. The GateKeeper Password Manager gives proximity access to web credentials, including one-time-passwords (OTPs) when using a GateKeeper key and software for secure access to your computer.
The add-on enhances the user's ability to manage their web passwords in their GateKeeper profiles. It communicates with the GateKeeper desktop application to allow users to save and retrieve their web credentials on any computer they log on to using their GateKeeper proximity token. For enterprise users, this extension provides access to web credentials for all users on every computer on the network once the user is authenticated on to the machine using their GateKeeper proximity token. 
Once a user logs on to any computer on the network using their GateKeeper proximity token, all their web credentials are available for them to use through this extension. Additionally, by registering web applications that support Time-Based One-Time-Passwords, the extension provides the 6-digit OTP in addition to the username and password for the web application, automatically. With GateKeeper, you will have on-demand and secure access to your computer, web and 2-FA OTP codes in one place.
For any questions regarding proximity lock and unlock with GateKeeper, please email us at info@gkaccess.com or visit https://gkaccess.com .

firefox-addons:3110619.description:
Make DuelingBook look and play the way you want. DBuddy restyles every screen of duelingbook.com , gives every theme its own attack effect, and adds duel hotkeys, a middle-click wheel, turn alerts, replay, deck and chat tools, and optional foil finishes for your cards. It never changes game rules. Free, no ads, no account needed. 
Themes
- 83 themes that restyle every DuelingBook screen, from the main menu to duels and the Deck Constructor
- Each theme has its own animated scene, menus, buttons, pop-ups, duel field and attack effect
- Life points your way: the theme's own counter or one of eight styles
- Pick every colour, corner roundness, background art and lettering
- Share your theme as a code, or add your own CSS
Duel tools
- Turn and duel-found alerts: a chime, a flashing tab and an optional desktop notification
- Duel hotkeys for draw, mill, shuffle, phases and custom chat messages; card hotkeys for a hovered card's menu
- Middle-click wheel (off by default): hold the middle mouse button and pick a pile to view
- Card tracker of what your opponent added, set or revealed, a floating notepad
Replays, decks and chat
- Replays: step back, jump to any turn, bookmarks, download the replay
- Decks: test hands, opening odds, version history and deleted-deck recovery
- Chat: mute players, get alerted on your name, custom shortcuts
Card rarities (optional)
- 11 foil finishes for your cards: Rare is free, the shinier ones cost DBling coins
- Try a finish before you buy it, under the big card preview
- Connect Discord for free DBling coins every month; opponents who use DBuddy see your finishes
How to use
1. Open duelingbook.com 
2. Click the round button in the bottom-right corner, the toolbar icon, or press Alt+Shift+D
3. Switch on what you like — most things start off, and every change can be undone
Privacy
Your settings stay in your browser. Once a day DBuddy sends only the name of the theme you have on (no id), so we know which themes people use — turn it off in Settings › Privacy. Only if you press Connect Discord does our server keep your DBling coins, bought finishes, Discord user id and a hash of your email. Delete account in Settings › Account removes it. Nothing is sold.
Made by a DuelingBook player. Join our Discord to request themes, report bugs and get help: https://discord.gg/XtP5Vj4q3C

Incorporating the highest-quality ingredients, the menu includes a variety of entree-sized salads,"very special” entrees, crave-worthy burgers and sandwiches, signature Wok Out Bowls™, housemade pizza, indulgent desserts and so much more. Doc B’s also impresses with an extensive craft beer, wine and spirits selection in addition to signature cocktails. No matter what occasion, the expansive menu truly offers something for everyone. With each location having its own personality, we invite you to experience hospitality at its best, at the location nearest you! 

Download our app to get rewards and extra perks. Here’s how it works:


1) Register your credit/debit card(s) in the app.

2) Dine as usual.

3) We’ll buzz your phone when you earn a reward. No need to fish your phone out, check-in, or scan anything. Just pay as you normally would.

4) Rewards show up on your phone for you to use. It's like magic!

bluejetty:00164933:ios.description:
Discover the PokéCardex application ! 
Manage your Pokemon card collection easily and quickly thanks to our application. Our database allows you to browse more than 24,000 cards in more than 240 sets, from the newest to the oldest, including promotional sets.
You can also add your Japanese and Simplified Chinese card collections, with more than 560 sets and 38,000 referenced cards!
Main features:
- Collection 
Detailed management of your Pokémon card collection: version, condition, quantity, and language. 
Card prices displayed from reseller sites Cardmarket and TCGPlayer.
- Sealed products 
Browse the TCG product catalog (boosters, displays, and more), check each product’s details and contents, and manage your sealed or opened product collection.
- Card Scanner 
Use your camera to scan your Pokémon cards, check if you already own them, and add them to your collection in an instant*
- Custom binders 
Create your own card binders, choose the format, cards from different regions, plan your next acquisitions and share them with your friends.
- Card prices and history
Check the current price of each card and track how it changes over time. Data comes from several online marketplaces to give you a more reliable estimate.
- Customizable Interface 
Customize how cards and sets are displayed, according to your preferences.
- Statistics 
Comprehensive statistics to track your collection's progress.
- Backup your collection 
Backup and sync your collection with your PokéCardex account**, so you never lose your data again!
- 100% offline 
Enjoy all these features with or without an Internet connection.
For any question or suggestions, you may free join us at appli_ios[at]pokecardex.com
_______________________________________________
* The card scanner, binders, wishlists and price history are available without limit only for PokéCardex Plus subscribers.
** Although it isn't required to create a PokéCardex account, doing so will allow you to benefit from the backup and synchronize features.
- Terms & Conditions
https://www.pokecardex.com/terms_ios
- Privacy
https://www.pokecardex.com/legal_ios

You can choose to be billed monthly or yearly. You can turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID Account Settings any time after purchase.

bluejetty:00113651:ios.description:
FAST MOTORCYCLE DRIVER - Ultimate 3D City Racing Simulator
CONQUER THE URBAN JUNGLE WITH REAL MOTORCYCLE POWER!
Experience the thrill of high-speed motorcycle racing through massive 3D city environments! Navigate bustling urban streets, climb towering skyscrapers, and master realistic physics in the most authentic motorcycle simulator on mobile.
SKYSCRAPER CLIMBING CHALLENGE
Take on the ultimate urban adventure by riding your motorcycle up the sides of massive skyscrapers! This unique gameplay mechanic sets you apart from ordinary racing games and delivers heart-pounding vertical thrills.
AUTHENTIC MOTORCYCLE EXPERIENCE 
Feel the raw power of real motorcycle engines with our advanced physics simulation. Every acceleration, brake, and turn responds exactly like a real bike, giving you the most authentic riding experience possible.
MASSIVE URBAN ENVIRONMENTS
Explore expansive 3D city maps filled with realistic details, traffic, and challenging routes. From busy downtown streets to quiet residential areas, every corner of the city offers new racing opportunities.
PREMIUM SIMULATOR FEATURES
- Realistic Physics Engine with authentic motorcycle dynamics
- Multiple Camera Angles including first-person cockpit view
- Stunning 3D Graphics with detailed city environments
- Authentic Engine Sounds from real motorcycle recordings 
- Intuitive Controls optimized for mobile devices
- Variety of High-Performance Motorcycles to choose from
- Dynamic Weather and Lighting Effects
- Challenging Urban Racing Missions
- Smooth Performance across all devices
DIVERSE MOTORCYCLE COLLECTION
Choose from a wide selection of powerful motorcycles, each with unique handling characteristics, engine sounds, and visual designs. From sport bikes to cruisers, find your perfect urban riding machine.
REALISTIC CITY RACING
Navigate through realistic traffic, follow traffic rules or break them for extra thrills. The dynamic city environment reacts to your riding style, creating endless possibilities for urban motorcycle adventures.
BUILT FOR MOTORCYCLE ENTHUSIASTS
Whether you love sport bikes, street racing, or urban exploration, this simulator captures the authentic spirit of motorcycle culture with realistic physics and challenging city environments.
DOWNLOAD FREE NOW
Ready to become the ultimate urban motorcycle rider? Download Fast Motorcycle Driver and experience the most realistic 3D city motorcycle simulator available!
Perfect for fans of motorcycle games, city racing, 3D simulators, urban exploration, street racing, bike simulators, physics-based games.

bluejetty:00177265:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00177265:ios.description:
Tired of typing long paragraphs from images, notes, or PDFs?
Try the Image to Text Scanner, a fast and accurate OCR scanner app. Whether you're scanning books, notes, PDFs, or handwriting to text, this text extractor extracts text in seconds. Use AI to summarize content, scan multiple pages at once, and export to text, Word, PDF, Excel, and more.
Whether it’s a document, photo, picture to text, handwritten note, scanned PDF, or even web content, this OCR scanner converts it into editable digital text in seconds, saving time and increasing productivity.
Core Features of Text Scanner:
Image to Text Grabber:
Convert photos or screenshots into text with high precision. Upload or take a picture, and this OCR text scanner converts an image to text will instantly extracting all readable content.
Translate Instantly:
The fun doesn't stop once you've converted your photo to text. Image to text converter app goes the extra mile by offering in-app language translation. Translate your extracted words into any language you desire, all within the convenience of the scan-to-text tool.
PDF to Text:
Extract scan text from any standard or scanned PDF file. Whether it's an invoice, a book page, or a scanned contract, convert it into plain text with ease.
Handwriting to Text:
Digitize your handwritten notes! Handwriting to text lets you scan any handwritten material and turn it into editable, shareable content. Ideal for students or note-takers using picture-to-text and image scanning.
Summarize Text (AI-Powered):
Convert lengthy paragraphs or entire documents into concise, informative summaries with intelligent AI summarization. Perfect for learning or extracting key points quickly from scanned text.
Batch Scanning:
Need to scan multiple documents or images at once? The scan-to-text feature allows you to process several pages in one go — no need to scan them individually using the text scanner repeatedly.
Scan from URL:
Paste a webpage URL and extract readable, clean text from it — without ads, clutter, or distractions. Great for reading articles offline or using image-to-text on web screenshots.
Convert & Export Easily:
Once the text is extracted, you can:
* Save it in your preferred format
* Edit it inside the app
* Share via social apps or email
* Export as PDF, Word (DOC), or Excel (XLS) — depending on your workflow, using text scanner from image features.
If you're looking for a clean, reliable, and powerful image-to-text and scan-to-text solution, this is the one. Whether it’s for work, education, research, or content creation, we’ve got you covered with handwriting to text and picture to text capabilities — all in one app.
If you have any questions or suggestions, please reach out to us at eclix.suport@gmail.com. Your feedback is very important to us.
Disclaimer:
Text extraction accuracy depends on image quality and content, and results may vary. Users are advised to review and verify the extracted text before using it for official or important purposes.

bluejetty:00131540:ios.name: DaVinci Resolve for iPad
bluejetty:00131540:ios.summary:
DaVinci Resolve for iPad
DaVinci Resolve for iPad is the world’s only solution that combines editing and color correction in one software tool! Its elegant, modern interface is fast to learn and easy for new users, yet powerful for professi
bluejetty:00131540:ios.description:
DaVinci Resolve for iPad
DaVinci Resolve for iPad is the world’s only solution that combines editing and color correction in one software tool! Its elegant, modern interface is fast to learn and easy for new users, yet powerful for professionals. DaVinci Resolve lets you work faster and at a higher quality because you don’t have to learn multiple apps or switch software for different tasks. That means you can work with camera original quality images throughout the entire process. It’s like having your own post production studio in a single app! Best of all, by learning DaVinci Resolve, you’re learning how to use the exact same tools used by Hollywood professionals in high end post production studios!
Turn work around fast using cut page editing!
The cut page is perfect for projects with tight deadlines that you have to turn around quickly. It’s also great for documentary work. The cut page has a streamlined interface that’s fast to learn and designed for speed. Features such as source tape for visual media browsing, fast review, and smart editing tools help you work faster than ever. The sync bin and source overwrite tools are the fastest way to edit multi-cam programs, with easy to create perfectly synchronized cut aways! With DaVinci Resolve you’ll spend more time editing and less time hunting for shots.
Hollywood’s favorite color corrector!
The DaVinci Resolve for iPad color page is Hollywood’s most advanced color corrector and has been used to color and finish more high end feature films and television shows than any other system! It’s also approachable with features designed to make it easier for new users to get great results while they continue to learn the advanced tools. For example, primary control sliders will be familiar to anyone who’s used image editing software, making it easy to adjust contrast, temperature, mid-tone detail, saturation and more. The color page has an incredible range of primary and secondary color grading features including PowerWindows™, qualifiers, 3D trackers, advanced HDR grading tools and more!
Blackmagic Cloud Collaboration
DaVinci Resolve for iPad supports the revolutionary Blackmagic Cloud, a whole new way of collaborating using cloud based workflows. Simply create a Blackmagic Cloud ID and set up a project library for your project. You can assign any number of collaborators to a project, using Blackmagic Cloud to share projects. Multiple people can work on the same timeline! When changes are made, you can see and accept them, changes are only applied when you accept updates. A single click can relink files, update timelines, or view changes. Built in timeline compare tools let you merge changes into a master timeline so others can continue with edits.
AI Tools for Creativity with Studio In-App-Purchase
Upgrade to DaVinci Resolve Studio to get cutting edge AI processing powered by the DaVinci AI Neural Engine. Tools such as magic mask need only a single stroke to locate and track people, features and objects in a shot. You can make characters stand out in an under lit shot, or invert the mask and stylize the background. Smart reframe repurposes footage to dramatically different aspect ratios by recognizing the action in a scene and panning within it so you can quickly create square or vertical versions for posting to social media. Voice isolation lets you easily remove loud, undesirable sounds from interviews and dialogue recordings from noisy locations. AI tools create quick, accurate results saving you hours of time!
Compatibility

The sync bin and source overwrite tools are the fastest way to edit multi-cam programs, with easy to create perfectly synchronized cut aways! 生词本 是一款针对英文阅读爱好者定制的记单词APP，也可用于初高中生四六级考研托福雅思GRE等记生词、强化记忆使用！简单好用是我们的宗旨。
地铁上、公交车上、出租车上，你可以随时打开APP，开始背单词，充分利用碎片化的时间。
###APP使用技巧
1. 在其他APP或浏览器中复制单词后，打开“生词本”APP会自动提示添加生词。
2. 在APP首页点击添加按钮，可以主动输入添加生词。
###主要功能：
* 「手动添加生词」：可自行编辑单词释义、备注。
* 「查询单词」
* 「今日计划」：可以自行调整每日学习计划，合理安排每一天的学习计划。
* 「记忆卡片」：自行选择分组，支持多种模式，强化薄弱环节。
* 「快速学习模式」：快速学习单词的简洁模式。
* 「List背单词」：根据艾宾浩斯的记忆规律，第一天记忆单词，后续的复习间隔周期为：第1天，第二天，第四天，第七天和第十五天，并由此制作每日所需记忆的单词计划表。
* 「边听边学」：自动语音播放，用耳机学单词。
* 「测试」：针对不熟悉的单词强化测试。
* 「听写&默写」：强化书写能力。
* 「Wi-Fi传输」：通过电脑浏览器即可完成添加单词、导入&导出数据等。
* 「导入导出」：可以将单词导出至电脑，并导入到其他手机上。
* 「账户同步」：支持多种设备。不同设备登录同一账号，可以实现数据同步。
* 内置中考、高考、四六级、考研、雅思、托福、GRE等词库。
###背单词绝没有捷径可走，唯有死记硬背！
真正的背单词就是不断的背诵和复习，比你单词量大的人多半都是比你更刻苦，而不是比你记忆力更好。
背单词是极其枯燥无聊的。想要改变这一点很难，实际上之所以会诞生各种所谓的背单词方法和单词记忆大师，就是因为他们是在给学生制造幻觉以为背单词变得有趣了，可能你真的觉得有趣了，但你不一定真的把单词背了下来。所以与其说说改变它，不如规避它。既然枯燥无聊，就不要背得太久，背单词的记忆效率是随时间而下降的，在下降之前最好停止。与其说背1个小时单词，从第10分钟就开始效率下降，不如只背10分钟，但背6个10分钟。利用零碎时间背单词不仅可以提高背记忆效率，还可以帮助高中生更容易挤出时间。
### 定价
生词本采用月套餐订阅模式。
订阅后，可享用全部高级会员功能。所有套餐支持在同一 Apple ID 登录的 iPhone 和 iPad 上使用。
订阅时长和价格会显示在购买页面。确认购买时，将通过用户的 Apple ID 账户付款。除非在当前订阅期结束前至少 24 小时关闭自动续订，否则订阅会自动续订。订阅和自动续订可在 Apple ID 账户设置中管理或关闭。

bluejetty:00015139:ios.description:
Crossword Pro is a classic crossword app with a useful twist. In arrow words puzzles, the clues are shown right in the puzzle grid, making them easy to view and play on the iPad and iPhone screen. 
This lovingly produced app includes 3,000 all-new Arrow Words puzzles in 4 levels. Easier levels use simpler words and a smaller grid, perfect for a short break. Harder levels have tougher clues for hours of challenging fun. Also, careful editing and a huge pool of words ensure that clues don’t repeat too often. 
The sound and graphics are also designed for true crossword aficionados. Choose from four visual interfaces that recreate the atmosphere of the crossword in the Sunday paper. If you miss using your favorite pen to solve puzzels, you’ll love the optional sounds of a moving pen as you fill in the squares, custom recorded for each letter! 
PLEASE NOTE: our puzzles are created by British puzzle editors especially with players from Commonwealth countries in mind. Of course, North American players are welcome to join the fun. 
Features: 
• Once you’ve solved an Crossword Pro puzzle on the iPad, you’ll never go back to paper!
• 3,000 free puzzles, 4 difficulty levels and 2 grid sizes 
• 4 interface options: Classic, News, Colour, Dark Mode 
• Optional sound effects and background music

bluejetty:00131938:ios.description:
APSA Pediatric Surgery Library contains: 
PEDIATRIC SURGERY NaT
From presentation to procedures to long term outcomes, the Pediatric Surgery NaT resource keeps the current general surgical care of children at your fingertips. Designed for both practicing and in-training pediatric surgeons, the Pediatric Surgery NaT is updated quarterly so you’ll know what strategies, techniques and procedures are being used right now. It is written for pediatric surgeons by pediatric surgeons and contains learning objectives, images, videos and links to MOC CME and the medical literature. Participate in the NaT community of practice today by downloading this app to your mobile device or tablet so you can provide better patient care with fast access anytime, anywhere.
Prime PubMed
Quickly search journal articles from the PubMed database on your smartphone and tablet. Results contain abstracts, citations, and links to available full text articles that can be read on device and shared with classmates and colleagues. Additionally, Prime PubMed contains Grapherence®, an exclusive way to visually explore interrelationships and relevance in the medical literature.
Features of the Pediatric Surgery Library include:
• Quick-read, highly organized clinical modules and learning objectives
• High-resolution images and videos
• Advanced searches of the medical literature
• Links to relevant PubMed articles 
• Full text search helps find topics fast 
• Custom notes and highlighting within entries
• "Favorites" for bookmarking important topics
Editors: Ron Hirschl, MD; David Powell, MD; John HT Waldhausen, MD
Publisher: American Pediatric Surgical Association (APSA)
Powered by: Unbound Medicine, Inc.
How It Works:
---------------------
• Install the app on your device.
• Open the app, enter your APSA Pediatric Surgery Library username and password, then tap “Login.”
• The latest content will be downloaded to your devices over your wireless connection.

Say goodbye to cluttered albums full of duplicate photos that waste precious storage. Cleaning up your photo library doesn’t have to be tedious or time-consuming. MobileClean makes it simple, satisfying—even fun.

Let cutting-edge AI do the heavy lifting so you can focus on making memories, not managing them.

Works entirely on-device with no internet required—so your privacy is always protected.

- Organize photos by month for tidy, structured cleanup.
- One tap to delete what you don’t need, one tap to keep what matters.

- No wasted storage space.
- A faster, lighter, more joyful phone experience.

MobileClean isn’t just about deleting—it’s about choosing.
- Curate your memories thoughtfully.
- Make space for what comes next.
- Enjoy peace of mind knowing nothing is removed without your approval.

bluejetty:00072827:ios.description:
Unlocking Spiritual Wisdom through Bible Word Puzzle – Bible Word Games: A Divine Journey of Fun and Faith.
Bible Word Puzzle Games stand as a unique bridge between the joy of gaming and the enlightenment of biblical knowledge. This Bible Word Games offers an immersive experience, combining the thrill of solving word puzzles with the profound teachings of the Bible.
Features:
1. Embark on a Spiritual Adventure with Bible Word Puzzle – Wordscapes Games
Imagine delving into the mesmerizing world of Bible Word Search Puzzle Games, where every tap and swipe on your device becomes a step towards unlocking the mysteries of the scriptures. 
2. Dive into Bible Word Search - Crossword Challenges:
Bible Word Search takes the timeless thrill of word hunting and infuses it with the richness of biblical language. Players navigate through a grid of letters, seeking hidden words related to Bible verses, Jesus quotes, and spiritual concepts.
3. Challenging the Mind with Bible Wordscapes: Trivia and Quiz:
For those eager to test their biblical knowledge, Bible Word Puzzle Games extend beyond mere word searches. Engaging Bible trivia and quizzes become a central component, challenging players with questions about Bible verses, Christian teachings, and historical events. This element adds an educational layer, making these games a delightful source of spiritual enlightenment.
4. Bible Crossword Games for All Ages and Stages of Faith:
Bible Word Puzzle caters to a diverse Christian audience. Whether you're a seasoned believer looking to reinforce your understanding of the Bible or a young adult eager to explore the teachings of Christianity, these Christian games offer a welcoming space.
5. The Unique Blend of Entertainment and Bible Study:
At the heart of Bible Word Search Puzzle Games lies a harmonious fusion of entertainment and study. The word search for challenging quiz ensures that players not only have fun but also enrich their understanding of the Bible. It's a holistic approach, making these games a source of joy for the soul and exercise for the mind.
6. Personalization and Spiritual Connection:
One standout feature is the ability to personalize the gaming experience. Players can choose their Holy Name or that of a beloved saint, creating a deeper connection to their spiritual journey. The inclusion of daily Bible verses upon logging in adds a consistent dose of inspiration, turning the game into a daily ritual of spiritual reflection.
7. Community and Competition in Christian Games:
Bible Word Search Puzzle - Crossword Games extend beyond individual play. Players can engage in friendly competition through leaderboards, sharing their achievements and challenging others in their faith community. The inclusion of a sharing feature allows friends to assist each other, fostering a sense of camaraderie in the pursuit of spiritual knowledge.
Bible Word Puzzle – Bible Word Search Games offer a unique and engaging way to combine entertainment with spiritual growth. As you navigate the puzzles, quiz, and challenges, you're not just playing a game, you're embarking on a divine journey, unlocking the wisdom and beauty of the Bible one word at a time.
If you like Bible games, Bible Quiz, Bible Trivia, Bible Word Games, or Christian games, this app is one of the most choices for you. The app brings fun features combined with classic puzzles, just like your favorite apps: Scrabble, Wordscapes, Word Search Explorer, Word Connect, Words of Wonders: Crossword, Word Trip, Word Collect, Word Cookies, Word Puzzles, Word Search, ...
Our mission is to "Preach" and "Glorify God" by creating many products, apps and bible games to help people enjoy learning about God's Word, Jesus Christ Quotes.

Download the new Marco’s Pizza app today for the ultimate pizza ordering experience.

bluejetty:00162867:ios.name: hi-fi+ Global Network
bluejetty:00162867:ios.summary:
Hi-Fi+ is Europe’s premier English-language high-end audio magazine. Whether it’s the latest in digital audio technology or the best turntable you’ve ever heard, Hi-Fi+ magazine is the ultimate audiophile authority.
Our goal is clear; to
bluejetty:00162867:ios.description:
Hi-Fi+ is Europe’s premier English-language high-end audio magazine. Whether it’s the latest in digital audio technology or the best turntable you’ve ever heard, Hi-Fi+ magazine is the ultimate audiophile authority.
Our goal is clear; to seek out the finest audio components money can buy. Music is the soundtrack to all our lives and we think that the better that soundtrack, sounds the more enriched our lives can be. A good audio system can open up new avenues of music that might surprise you. We don’t differentiate; it could be a classic valve amplifier or a state-of-the-art music server – if it sounds good, we want to know and we want to tell you about it. The difference between good sound and great sound lies in the details… and we are obsessive about detail. 
We aren’t constrained by measurement or bogged down in stuffy old paradigms. We are relevant and a little bit irreverent. Hi-Fi+ features some of the best writers in the business, all passionate about making music sound as good as it possibly can. We seek out the finest audio components – and the latest and greatest music – and aren’t afraid of finding the best, whatever the cost.
----------------------------------------------
This is a free app download. Within the app users can purchase the current issue and back issues.
Subscriptions are also available within the application. A subscription will start from the latest regular issue at the time of purchase.
-The subscription will renew automatically unless cancelled more than 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, for the same duration and at the current subscription rate for the product.
-You may turn off the auto-renewal of subscriptions through your Account Settings, however you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period.
-Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when a subscription to that publication is purchased.
-If a subscription offers a free trial, at the end of the trial period, you will be charged the full price of the subscription. You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription settings on your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged.
Users can register for/ login to a pocketmags account in-app. This will protect their issues in the case of a lost device and allow browsing of purchases on multiple platforms. Existing pocketmags users can retrieve their purchases by logging into their account.
We recommend loading the app for the first time in a wi-fi area so that all issue data is retrieved.
If your app will not load past the splash page after a first install or an update, please delete and reinstall the app from the App Store
Help and frequently asked questions can be accessed in-app and on pocketmags.
If you have any problems at all please do not hesitate to contact us: help@pocketmags.com
--------------------
You can find our privacy policy here:
http://www.pocketmags.com/privacy.aspx
You can find our terms and conditions here:
http://www.pocketmags.com/terms.aspx

bluejetty:00153537:ios.description:
Seal of Fate is a dazzling 3D anime fantasy RPG. Immerse yourself into a world that surpasses all your imaginations, where destiny meets desire. Along the path of fate, dazzling beauties await your choice. Whose fate will intertwine with yours?
Game Features: 
- Collect & Sortie with Beauties - Over 100 dazzling characters with unique personalities are waiting for you!
-Stunning 3D Visuals - Experience next-gen 3D rendering with high-quality models featuring 100,000+ polygons!
-Pure Strategy Combat - Engage in fair PvP battles where strategic team-building and tactical counterplays define victory!
-All-UR Evolution - Upgrade any character to UR rarity and swap formations freely without any loss!
-Manga-Style Storytelling - Immerse yourself in humorous and engaging storylines within a vibrant fantasy universe!
-Generous Rewards - Login for free Diamond Lifetime Card and earn 10 free summons upon every stage completion!
Ginger Squad—famous for being broke—is on a wild quest to find the legendary Seal of Fate. But things get chaotic when Princess Vera tags along, eager for adventure, and ends up angering her sister, Princess Khione, the kingdom’s archmage. Just when all hope seems lost, the Seal transforms into a dazzling girl who turns the tide...
Unravel the Seal’s secrets, defeat the Demon King, and meet captivating Meowmates in a laugh-filled, action-packed journey. Adventure starts now!

bluejetty:00175095:ios.description:
With eharmony, dating is about more than just meeting new people – it’s about building a meaningful, lasting relationship. As the No.1 trusted dating app* we’ve helped over 2 million couples find real love. Download and join free to find out why compatibility matters.
HOW DOES THE EHARMONY DATING APP WORK? 
When it comes to dating, compatibility matters. That’s why we’ve created our unique Compatibility Matching System to ensure each of your Matches are based on qualities that are important to you. Compared to other dating apps, we make finding love simple. We’ll guide you through the process in easy steps:
STEP 1: TELL US ABOUT YOURSELF
Your journey on our dating app starts with the Compatibility Quiz. Your answers help us understand exactly what you’re looking for and what matters most to you in a relationship.
STEP 2: FILL OUT YOUR PROFILE 
The next step to finding love is setting up your profile. We provide thoughtful prompts that help you show what makes you, you. We make online dating as enjoyable as possible by having richly detailed profiles that are easy to digest. That’s why eharmony is the dating app with the highest-rated user profiles**. 
STEP 3: EXPLORE SINGLES THAT MATCH YOUR PERSONALITY
Based on your answers to the Compatibility Quiz, eharmony’s matching algorithm determines which singles are the best fit for you. You can see how well you match based on your matching score. The higher the score, the greater the chance of falling in love.
STEP 4: START A CONVERSATION
It’s time to connect! Show your interest with a Like and send a first message. Once you get a Like in return, it’s a Match. With Premium memberships you can now swap messages and get to know each other better.
WHAT OUR DATING APP OFFERS TO YOU TO FIND A PARTNER 
• We focus on serious intentions: that’s why every profile must be at least 50% complete.
• Our unique Compatibility Matching System helps you meet singles who are truly compatible with you: when it comes to love, we rely on our matching system rather than pure chance.
•We’re committed to providing a trusted space for online dating: with thoughtful safeguards, clear guidance, and a dedicated Trust and Safety team, you can connect with confidence.
THE REVIEWS ARE IN 
"If you're in your 40s and ready to commit, like really commit, eharmony is where you want to be." (Mashable)
"Best dating app for long-term relationships." (GQ)
START YOUR NEXT CHAPTER WITH OUR DATING APP 
The Basic Membership is your default free membership upon joining, where you can gain some online dating experience and understand the app before upgrading to Premium. Some limitations may apply.
The Premium Membership is not free, but it is worth it. This gives you full access to all of eharmony’s features and capabilities, making it much easier to find a connection with your ideal partner.
Membership structure – Online dating is a journey that shouldn’t be rushed. We believe that shorter plans don’t give you the time to properly get to know your matches, which is why our Premium Membership is available in different durations.
Download our dating app today and find real love.

bluejetty:00068930:ios.description:
Make space for a little daily perspective.
Buz Horoscopes brings your horoscope, a small daily ritual and a place to reflect into one thoughtfully designed app.
YOUR DAILY PERSPECTIVE
Explore daily, weekly, monthly and yearly horoscopes for all 12 zodiac signs. Choose today or yesterday and see the date of the reading. When today’s reading is not yet available, the app clearly labels yesterday’s reading.
YOUR LUCKY DATES
Compare up to three dates for weddings, contracts, business launches, moves, travel and other important events using your birth date and numerology. Explore a complete example, save your analyses and share your results. Two complimentary analyses are available; Premium includes 10 analyses per calendar month. Comparing several dates in one request counts as one analysis. A signed-in account is required for personalized analyses.
A LITTLE COFFEE FORTUNE
Scratch to reveal a daily moment of inspiration. Save the fortunes you love and share a little encouragement with a friend.
YOUR BIRTH CHART — PREMIUM
Explore calculated planetary placements based on your birth date, place and optional birth time. Discover your Sun, Moon and, when your birth time is known, Rising sign, together with optional AI explanations. Save your readings and share them as text or a PDF.
YOUR COMPATIBILITY — PREMIUM
Compare two birth charts for a new perspective on a partnership or friendship. Explore planetary connections without compatibility scores or promises about your future.
YOUR PRIVATE JOURNAL
Check in with your mood, write a reflection and find past entries with search and an organized history. Journal entries stay on your device.
MORE TO EXPLORE
Discover dream meanings, Chinese horoscopes, zodiac profiles, love and friendship sign matchers, and famous birthdays. Set an optional daily coffee reminder or birthday greeting.
PURCHASES
An active subscription unlocks Your Birth Chart and Your Compatibility and removes advertising. The separate one-time Remove Ads purchase removes advertising without unlocking Premium readings. Restore supported purchases using the Apple Account you originally purchased with. Individual personal readings, where available, are separate one-time purchases and are not included with Premium.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled through your App Store account. Current prices, billing periods and any eligible introductory offers are shown before purchase.
Astrology, numerology and fortunes are for entertainment and personal reflection, not scientific predictions or professional advice.
Privacy: https://apps.buzlylabs.com/buz-horoscopes/privacy
Terms: https://apps.buzlylabs.com/buz-horoscopes/terms
Contact: ask@buzlylabs.com

bluejetty:00086900:ios.name: AIG ביטוח נסיעות לחו"ל
bluejetty:00086900:ios.summary:
אפליקציית ביטוח נסיעות לחו"ל של AIG - לטוס בראש שקט. האפליקציה מאפשרת לכם להגיש תביעות בקלות ולקבל החזר מיידי תוך 15 שניות הישר לכרטיסי אשראי - ויזה, ישראכרט או אמריקן אקספרס על הוצאות רפואיות - עד 500 דולר.
 *ההחזר כפוף לנהלי חברות כרטיסי
bluejetty:00086900:ios.description:
אפליקציית ביטוח נסיעות לחו"ל של AIG - לטוס בראש שקט. האפליקציה מאפשרת לכם להגיש תביעות בקלות ולקבל החזר מיידי תוך 15 שניות הישר לכרטיסי אשראי - ויזה, ישראכרט או אמריקן אקספרס על הוצאות רפואיות - עד 500 דולר.
 *ההחזר כפוף לנהלי חברות כרטיסי האשראי ומתאפשר בכרטיסים ויזה וישראכרט בלבד, עד לסך של 500 דולר ובגין הוצאות רפואיות בלבד. ייתכנו עיכובים בביצוע ההחזר בפועל.
 השירות הינו בכפוף לתנאי השימוש באפליקציה, כפי שיעודכנו מעת לעת.
מה אפשר לעשות באפליקציית ביטוח הנסיעות לחו"ל של AIG?
אחרי שרכשתם ביטוח חו"ל - AIG Travel, זה הזמן להוריד ללא עלות את האפליקציה לביטוח נסיעות לחו"ל של AIG שתאפשר להגיש תביעות ולאתר שירותים רפואיים בכל רגע בזמן שהותכם בחו"ל. ניתן גם להתייעץ בעברית עם רופא אונליין 24/7 - ולקבל שירותי רפואה בוואטסאפ, ולא פחות חשוב- לקבל החזר עבור הוצאות רפואיות.
קבלת החזר על הוצאות רפואיות תוך 15 שניות*
לאחר קבלת שירות רפואי בחו"ל, תוכלו להגיש תביעה בקלות על ההוצאות דרך האפליקציה. תוכלו להעלות מסמכים, לעדכן פרטים, ולקבל החזר מהיר של עד $500 ישירות לכרטיס האשראי. 
הסכום המירבי לקבלת החזר לאשראי הוא 500$. מעל סכום זה, ההחזר יתבצע בהתאם לתנאי הפוליסה.
איתור רופאים, מרפאות, בתי חולים ובתי מרקחת
לעיתים כשמטיילים בחו"ל , ובטח כשטסים עם ילדים, צריך לראות רופא או להגיע בזריזות לבית המרקחת הקרוב. עם ביטוח הנסיעות לחו"ל של AIG אפשר לאתר בקלות ובמהירות את בתי החולים, המרפאות, בתי המרקחת והרופאים הקרובים ביותר. זה פשוט: לחצו על כפתור "איתור רופא" ונמצא לכם את רופא המשפחה, רופא הילדים, הרופא המומחה או רופאת השיניים הזמינים והקרובים ביותר. בנוסף, האפליקציה מאפשרת גישה מהירה למספרי חירום מקומיים (שגרירויות, משטרה, אמבולנס וכו') למקרה הצורך.
שירות שיחה אונליין עם רופא בעברית - 24/7 
למקרים שבהם תעדיפו להתייעץ עם רופא בעברית תוכלו לבחור בכפתור "ייעוץ רפואי" באפליקצייה, למלא את פרטי המקרה ופרטי המבוטח ורופא יחזור אליכם בטלפון או במייל, תוך 3 שעות. 
איך מקבלים החזר בביטוח נסיעות לחו"ל?
כדי לפתוח תביעה ולקבל החזר כספי ניתן ללחוץ על כפתור "בקשה להחזר" ולבחור בתביעה חדשה או קיימת. אפשר להעלות את החשבונית והסיכום הרפואי ישירות מטלפון הנייד. לאחר מכן, יש לבחור את מספר כרטיס האשראי אליו יגיע ההחזר, וזהו.
מה עוד אפשר לעשות באפליקציה?
ניתן לדווח על אשפוז, לקבל הפניות לרופאים, לברר את מצב התביעה ולהתעדכן בפרטי הפוליסה של כל בני המשפחה המבוטחים. בנוסף, במעבר לאיזור האישי, מתוך האפליקציה, ניתן לקבל מידע גם על תביעות בכיסוי לעיכוב או אובדן כבודה.
אפליקציית ביטוח הנסיעות לחו"ל Safe Travel של AIG מביאה את הזמינות, האיכות והשירות שלנו לכל חופשה או נסיעת עסקים, לכל מקום, בכל שעה. מה שנשאר הוא פשוט להוריד את האפליקציה, לעלות על המטוס - ולטוס בראש שקט.
 הכל במקום אחד, שעושה את זה טוב יותר.

bluejetty:00099641:ios.description:
Unleash the Storm of Runes
From Asgard's shadows emerges a guardian,
A supreme striker who shatters the battlefield in defiance of fate.
New Class Update: Rune Fighter
Official Website: https://www.legendofymir.com
▣ Synopsis
A world of Ragnarok that repeats every 9,000 years.
The will to stop Ragnarok is passed down to the chosen ones awakened by fate;
and through endless cycles of reincarnation, a new hero of Ymir shall rise.
A grand tale of heroes who transcend the cycles of rebirth amidst the wars and conflicts between races.
The myth of the land of Ymir shall unfold once more.
▣ Game Features
► Imagination meets reality
Experience the awe-inspiring details of Norse mythology brought to life with Unreal Engine 5.
Step into a vivid and immersive world where ancient legends come alive.
► YMIR season system bringing fresh new air
Each season introduces new battlefields, stories, enemies, and events.
Escape the monotony of fixed systems and embrace the ever-evolving combat that changes moment by moment.
► Detailed hit-confirm controls
Feel the thrill at your fingertips with intricate controls and convenient automatic systems.
Redefining the excitement of combats through an immersive hit-confirmation system and evade controls.
►Build your own growth path
Your adventures, your choices. Every action and decision shapes your path, carving out your own unique journey.
Start an adventure that begins with you and create a story that only you can tell.
▣ Minimum Requirements: iOS 16 or higher; iPhone 12 or higher
Developer Contact
Address: WEMADE Tower, 49, Daewangpangyo-ro 644beon-gil, Bundang-gu, Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi-do, Republic of Korea
Email: legendofymirhelp@wemade.com

Experience a digital-rich reading experience with elegant grid and lists views, high-resolution photos and streaming videos, plus easy-to-navigate sections for local and national news, sports, opinion, business, family and faith.

• Best of the Deseret News - Access stories from each section. Sort by featured, latest and most popular.
• Digital-rich Reading Experience - Simple section story and “swipe-through” navigation, plus easy-to-use grid and list interface allows you to quickly access stories.
• Photos & Videos: View high-resolution photos and streaming videos. 
• Social Sharing - Share stories via email, Twitter and Facebook.
• Offline Reading - Catch up on the latest news even when you don’t have an Internet connection. 
• Push Notifications - Stay informed with real-time alerts on breaking news and important stories.

bluejetty:00015761:ios.summary:

Several reasons to download:

bluejetty:00015761:ios.description:
Sudoku is a logical puzzle game, which helps keep your brain sharp and strengthen analytical thinking.
Several reasons to download:
- intuitive and user-friendly interface and gameplay
- no annoying ads
- saves battery and does not warm your smartphone
- more than 10,000 of different sudoku of various complexity - easy, medium, hard and expert; both children and sudoku gurus will enjoy the game
- analyze your personal stats to upgrade your level and compete with friends
- a lot of various capabilities - make notes, cancel moves, take hints and others
- customize the game to your taste: set the maximum mistakes number, turn the timer on/off, highlight the cells, etc.
- offline mode
- daily challenges
Game rules:
 A Sudoku puzzle is defined as a logic-based, number-placement puzzle.
The objective is to fill a 9×9 grid with digits in such a way that each column, each row, and each of the nine 3×3 grids that make up the larger 9×9 grid contains all of the digits from 1 to 9.
 Each Sudoku puzzle begins with some cells filled in. The player uses these seed numbers as a launching point toward finding the unique solution.
 It is important to stress the fact that no number from 1 to 9 can be repeated in any row or column.

Terms and Conditions - https://sudokums.blogspot.com

bluejetty:00170002:ios.name: Paragon Pioneers 2
bluejetty:00170002:ios.summary:
» Embark on a Grand Adventure with Paragon Pioneers 2! «
Dive into the captivating world of Paragon Pioneers 2, an engaging city-building idle game filled with extensive content promising months of immersive gameplay. Discover and conquer
bluejetty:00170002:ios.description:
» Embark on a Grand Adventure with Paragon Pioneers 2! «
Dive into the captivating world of Paragon Pioneers 2, an engaging city-building idle game filled with extensive content promising months of immersive gameplay. Discover and conquer customizable islands, carefully shaping your empire to satisfy the needs of your citizens. Even with limited playtime, you can delve deep into this simulation, experimenting with various strategies to enhance your realm. Build a magnificent palace and establish your legacy as the most renowned leader in Paragon history!
This is the full version of Paragon Pioneers 2. The free lite version is available here: https://apps.apple.com/app/paragon-pioneers-2-lite/id6475304322
» What Can You Expect? «
BUILD your empire with over 300 diverse buildings.
PRODUCE more than 130 goods with intricate production chains.
RESEARCH over 200 unique perks to tailor your playstyle.
EXPLORE three distinct regions, each offering unique challenges.
CONQUER islands using an intuitive and multifaceted combat system.
IMMERSE yourself in easy-to-learn gameplay, free from ads and online requirements.
RELAX knowing your empire grows, even when you're not actively playing.
OBSERVE your inhabitants traversing a charming medieval/fantasy world.
SHAPE every island with a unique map generator to suit your needs.
ADAPT the game’s difficulty to your preferred play style.
ENJOY extensive replayability with powerful custodians that grant unique abilities.
» What’s New in the Sequel? «
NEW MAJOR FEATURES – Introducing a diverse research system featuring over 200 unique perks that significantly influence gameplay. Explore three distinct regions, each with its own mechanics and exclusive production chains. Tailor your adventure with customizable difficulty levels.
DOUBLE THE CONTENT – Your islands now have rivers and you can build water mills. Encounter more than double the number of buildings, goods, and units than before. Delve into even more complex production chains and optimize them! Boost your crop and livestock production with support buildings as technology advances.
GRAPHICAL OVERHAUL – Watch from above as your inhabitants transport goods around town and your ships dock at your islands, all enhanced by dynamic water visuals and more vivid graphics.
IMPROVED INTERFACE – Now available in landscape mode for tablets. The menu structure has been refined, and additional shortcuts introduced, ensuring seamless navigation. Trading routes have also been simplified, making their management more intuitive than ever.
ENHANCED PRESTIGE MECHANIC – Construct your palaces more progressively with new challenges and a focus on the long-term happiness of your inhabitants. A new reputation system offers greater freedom in custodian selections.
AND MUCH MORE – Enjoy numerous quality of life improvements inspired by the awesome Discord community for a smoother gameplay experience. Expect better stability, more device adjustment options and much more…
» Get in touch! «
Join my Discord community for exclusive tips, latest updates, and to connect with fellow gamers: https://discord.gg/pRuGbCDWCP
Reach out to me personally at tobias@paragonpioneers.com
» Thank you for playing Paragon Pioneers 2! «
My passion project Paragon Pioneers 2 is very special for me as it continues my dream of being a game developer. It makes me really happy when my creations bring joy to others and I invite you to join this journey and share your experiences with me :)
Happy Building!
- Tobias

bluejetty:00070549:ios.description:
Your phone came with a keyboard. It shows.
WAVE is the one you actually choose. Hundreds of animated and LED themes, dozens of
fonts, an AI that fixes your sentences before you send them, and typing that keeps up
with your thumbs.
LIVE THEMES, NOT WALLPAPERS
Our newest themes are rendered live, so they react to you. Keys flare when you press
them. Light runs the edge of the board. An aurora drifts behind your words while you
type. LED RGB, Edge Glow, Light Mode, and a gallery of animated themes that grows
every month.
Every theme previews before you commit, because "it looked good in the screenshot" is
how bad decisions happen.
FONTS FOR EVERY MOOD
Dozens of fonts, from clean and elegant to the bubbly one your group chat deserves.
Tap once and keep typing. They work anywhere you can type, no copy-paste ritual required.

bluejetty:00021032:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00021032:ios.description:
Listening is more ENJOYABLE and PRODUCTIVE than reading.
Text To Speech: Audio Books is an AI technology that enables to convert and read aloud any text as speech imitative of the human voice. This app transforms text, books, document, PDF and online articles into audiobooks. Now you can stay informed while cooking, driving, work out, doing sports, commute and let Text To Speech work as a text reader for you.
Text To Speech - Audiobooks is an essential tool for all kinds of reader, especially for those who are busy and want to enjoy audiobooks or people with dyslexia and other reading difficulties. The app is like an audible book, it can read aloud any text, webpages, PDF, eBooks or text book to you with our high quality natural sounding voices.
FEATURE LIST:
• Listen to articles, PDF, digital text, or physical books AS AUDIO.
• Listen with 50+ high quality natural human voices and 20+ languages.
• Listen at any speed you like, even faster or slower 5x than usual speed.
• Scan physical book pages with your device camera and convert to audible text.
• Import internet articles and online news straight from your mobile browser.
• Upload and convert photo, PDF and Docs file from iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox.
• Listen to audible text with your iOS iPhone and iPad
• Organize listening files with library
• Support multiple languages: English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Japanese, Italian, Russian, Dutch, Finnish, Swedish, Danish, Turkish, Polish, Hungarian, Vietnamese, Arabic, Hindi, Korean, Thai.
I. LISTEN TO ANY TEXT - IN ANYWHERE - AT ANYTIME:
Import PDF, photo of physical book pages, document, online articles, web pages or insert clipboard-copied text and let Text To Speech read aloud text to you in the natural human voice. Don't read anymore! Let's listen to your text!
II. +50 VOICES FOR BOTH MAN AND WOMEN, SUPPORTED 20 LANGUAGES:
Text To Speech provides more 50 high quality human voice across 20 languages. Just pick your favourite voice and find the perfect reading speed that works for you.
III. READ FASTER, REMEMBER LONGER
Text To Speech helps highlight each word as it reads. Listening and reading at the same time can maximize the levels of comprehension and help the reader remember longer than usual.
IV. SOLUTION FOR USERS WITH READING DYSLEXIA:
Text To Speech is a perfect solution for users with Dyslexia, ADHD, Low vision acuity, anxiety, concussions, and other reading disabilities to breeze through their readings and engage with their curiosities.
With Text To Speech : Audio Books, you can save time, retain more information, and stay focused. No matter what kind of reader you are, experience more with Text To Speech - Natural Reader.
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTIONS:
• Subscribed user can get access to Text To Speech Premium natural reading voices with unlimited uses.
• User can subscribe for one month (USD 19.99$) and one year (USD 99.99$) auto-renewing subscription.
• Unsubscribed users can only use those services with a limited quota per day.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of Use: http://vulcanlabs.co/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: http://vulcanlabs.co/privacy-policy/
You are welcome to contact us at support@vulcanlabs.co

About the NS app
The free NS app is your ideal travelling companion. It lets you plan your entire journey to any address in the Netherlands and keep up to date with the latest travel information and any disruptions as you go. You can also easily check where you can hire a public transport bicycle or shared car in your area, or quickly find the nearest P+R if you are travelling partly by car. See how crowded it is on the train and have your tickets quickly on hand. Everything to help you get going by whatever transport suits you best today.
Why traveling with the NS app
+ Best app in the Public Transport category
+ over 2 million users
+ Quick, safe and easy payment
+ The “Nearby me” feature lets you see exactly which forms of transport are available in the neighbourhood, from train, bus, tram and metro to public transport bicycles and shared cars. All in a single overview. So it’s the easy way to plan your entire door-to-door journey.
+ Arrange it all easily in Mijn NS. You can check your balance, access your journey information, simply change your travel class and view and change your season tickets.
Feedback
Every journey starts with the NS app. That’s why we’re always improving the app with new functions that will help you with your journey even more. If you have any questions, tips or other feedback, let us know in the app. That will let us make the app experience even better!

It lets you plan your entire journey to any address in the Netherlands and keep up to date with the latest travel information and any disruptions as you go. You can also easily check where you can hire a public transport bicycle or shared car in your area, or quickly find the nearest P+R if you are travelling partly by car. See how crowded it is on the train and have your tickets quickly on hand. Everything to help you get going by whatever transport suits you best today.

Why traveling with the NS app
+ Best app in the Public Transport category
+ over 2 million users
+ Quick, safe and easy payment
+ The “Nearby me” feature lets you see exactly which forms of transport are available in the neighbourhood, from train, bus, tram and metro to public transport bicycles and shared cars. All in a single overview. So it’s the easy way to plan your entire door-to-door journey.
+ Arrange it all easily in Mijn NS. You can check your balance, access your journey information, simply change your travel class and view and change your season tickets.

Feedback
Every journey starts with the NS app. That’s why we’re always improving the app with new functions that will help you with your journey even more. If you have any questions, tips or other feedback, let us know in the app. That will let us make the app experience even better!
