bluejetty:00118799:ios.summary: Staying on task seems is a real challenge for our screen-bound generation. The Be Focused lets you get things done by breaking up individual tasks among discrete intervals, separated by short breaks. It’s a surprisingly effective way to ret
bluejetty:00118799:ios.description:
Staying on task seems is a real challenge for our screen-bound generation. The Be Focused lets you get things done by breaking up individual tasks among discrete intervals, separated by short breaks. It’s a surprisingly effective way to retain motivation and focus. Create tasks, configure breaks and track your progress throughout the day, week or custom period. Use Be Focused on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac — everything stays perfectly in sync.
Task Management
• Create and manage tasks
• Add notes and due dates to tasks
• Organize tasks with tags and filters
• Paste task lists from other apps
Timer Control
• Start, pause, or skip intervals
• Auto-start the next interval (optionally)
• Plan intervals needed for task completion and track accuracy
• Manage completed intervals
Timer Customization
• Set durations for work sessions, short and long breaks
• Define number of intervals before a long break
• Set a daily goal for completed intervals 
• Assign different timer settings to individual tasks
Reports
• View detailed reports to monitor your progress
• Export your data in CSV format
Sounds and Notifications
• Chronometer ticking sound with adjustable frequency
• Variety of alarm sounds
• Interactive notifications
• Adjustable volume for alarms and chronometer
Integration
• Sync across all your devices (iPhone, iPad, Mac)
• Integration with Focus Matrix to manage tasks using urgent/important principle *
• Integration with Shortcuts app to automate workflow
Quick Access
• Widgets for Lock Screen and Home Screen
• Live activities for Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
• Control to start or stop the timer from the Lock Screen, Controls Center, or Action Button
Automation
• Integration with Shortcuts app (control tasks and timers via Shortcuts app)
• Automate Shortcuts execution on events in Be Focused app
Device Support
• Apple Watch support
• Also available for Mac
• Dark and Light mode support
Pro Version Features
• Single purchase unlocks Pro on iPhone, iPad, and Mac
• Sync across all your devices
• Tags and filters to organize tasks and maintain focus
• Integration with Focus Matrix to manage tasks using urgent/important principle *
• Shortcuts execution on events in Be Focused app
• Export data in CSV format
• No banners, no ads
Be Focused is free to download and use forever. However, if you want to access the Pro features on all your iPhones, iPads, and Macs, you can upgrade to the Pro version. The Pro subscription comes in three different options: Monthly, Yearly with a 7-day trial, and Lifetime (one-time payment).
Payment will be charged to your App Store account and will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Subscription may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://xwavesoft.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://xwavesoft.com/terms-of-use.html
* Integration with Focus Matrix requires the Pro version of Focus Matrix, sold separately.

bluejetty:00016915:ios.description:
Rise through the ranks against 24 of the PBA’s best bowlers as you compete for a variety of regional and national championship trophies. Starting in a local alley with a scuffed up 12 lb ball, you’ll hone your skills against bowling legends on your way to competing in the Tournament of Champions! 
Start a career or bowl a quick game!
Career mode is at the heart of PBA Bowling Challenge, but if you’d rather just lace up and take to the lanes, we’ve got you covered. Choose from a wide variety of opponents and locations and unlock even more content in Career Mode! 
Online Multiplayer Action!
Bowl against your friends in real-time, one-on-one multiplayer matches! Powered by Game Center services, multiplayer mode lets you invite your friends or get matched against a random opponent!
Bowl against the best!
How do you think you’d fare against the cool confidence and pin-point accuracy of Walter Ray Williams, Jr. or the brash power stroke of Pete Weber? How would your scores stand up against the high spin and smooth release of Norm Duke or the high cranking backswing of Tommy Jones? Based on actual statistics that track their power, hook, and control, PBA Bowling Challenge strives to accurately recreate the skill and style of the top bowlers in the sport today.
Features Include:
- Quickplay, Multiplayer, and Career modes!
- Dozens of PBA Tournaments!
- Bowl against 24 of the best PBA bowlers!
- Over 100 different bowling balls with unique stats!
- Leaderboards and Achievements.
- Bonus challenges in every tournament!
- Split Balls, Bomb Balls, and more!

bluejetty:00030551:ios.name: Zoho Sheet: Spreadsheet App
bluejetty:00030551:ios.summary:
Create a new spreadsheet or import an Excel file, stay completely offline or go online to collaborate on data with others in real time, and share your spreadsheets with the free Zoho Sheet app for iOS.
With this spreadsheet app on your iPh
bluejetty:00030551:ios.description:
Create a new spreadsheet or import an Excel file, stay completely offline or go online to collaborate on data with others in real time, and share your spreadsheets with the free Zoho Sheet app for iOS.
With this spreadsheet app on your iPhone, you can: 
Work offline
Need offline access whenever it matters? Create, edit, and manage your spreadsheets entirely without internet and move them to the cloud as needed for real-time collaboration.
Import files from your device or cloud apps
Bring in .csv, .tsv, and .xlsx files from your device and continue where you left off. You can also open, edit, and save spreadsheets from Dropbox and Box in Zoho Sheet or simply sync the changes back to your files stored in the cloud. 
Scan and insert data from pictures 
Save time on data entry with an effortless, two-step process. Scan data from printed materials or from images saved in your iPhone Photos app. Preview and insert the data into your worksheets. 
Collaborate on your spreadsheets
Track budgets, stocks, manage projects, create monthly reports, calendars, or generate charts for your next big presentation—all with the power of real-time collaboration. Add cell- or range-specific comments and use @mentions to tag collaborators for seamless teamwork. 
Export files
Choose the optimal format for each spreadsheet and download them as Microsoft Excel (.xlsx, .xls), PDF or other supported file formats to access them offline, store hard copies, or share the finished results of your work. 
Analyze and visualize
Crunch numbers with more than 350 functions and formulas and visualize your findings with more than 35 types of charts. 
Increase productivity with AI
Get suggestions for analyzing your data and automatically generate charts and pivot tables instantly with Zia, our in-house artificial intelligence. Even better, use voice commands to ask Zia your data-related questions. 
Build spreadsheets faster with templates 
Solve your use cases quickly with our gallery of ready-made spreadsheet templates like inventory tracker, invoice, and more. 
Get a unified experience across devices
Access and manage your spreadsheets with ease, whether you are on your iPhone or using Zoho Sheet on the web. Your data is automatically synced every time you make a change, allowing you to switch between the two platforms whenever you want.
Assure the privacy of your data
Zoho prioritizes privacy because we know it's important to our users, especially in the productivity and collaboration app segment. We have never shared our users' information with anyone for advertising purposes, nor have we generated revenue by displaying ads from other sources.
The Zoho advantage for businesses 
Zoho Sheet is part of the Zoho Office Suite, which also includes Writer, an online word processor, and Show, our online presentation software. This means when you sign up for Zoho Sheet, you'll get access to a full set of tools to manage your worksheets, presentations, and word documents in one place. It's even possible to integrate across apps to automatically add the latest data to the graphs in your upcoming presentation or report.
Zoho's single sign-on account means you can easily access all the Zoho apps you need. Our ecosystem currently offers 55+ apps across business categories like sales, marketing, email and collaboration, finance, HR, and more. 
For more details visit: https://www.zoho.com/sheet/mobile.html
If you have questions before you try the app or while using it, please write to us at ios-support@zohosheet.com.

bluejetty:00061865:ios.description:
Xero Me
Capture, track and manage expense claims as they happen, on the go. 
Xero Me is a self service employee tool that helps small businesses reduce the time spent gathering and fielding requests. 
Save time on expense management by empowering your employees to self-serve work admin tasks.
To log in to Xero Me you must be granted permission by your employer. Access to Expenses requires a Xero Expenses subscription and access permission granted by your employer. 
Check with your employer if you are having trouble logging in.
Note. You will only have access to mobile features your organisation has enabled, based on your role (not all mobile features may be available to you).
Key features include:
- Capture cost as they happen: scan and submit expenses, company card and mileage claim, anytime, anywhere.
- Automatic receipt transcription: Details are scanned from your photo receipt to auto fill the expense claim.
- Track your mileage: use the map in Xero Me or select from recent locations to accurately enter, track and submit mileage claims to get reimbursed faster.
- Submit expense claims in any currency: make it easier to keep track of actual costs and maintain accurate records.
- With approver permissions, review and approve expense claims on the go.
- With admin permissions, setup receipt analysis, claim accounts, team roles and bank accounts. 
ABOUT XERO
Xero is a beautiful, easy-to-use global cloud-based accounting software that connects people with the right numbers anytime, anywhere, on any device. For accountants and bookkeepers, Xero helps build a trusted relationship with small business clients through online collaboration. We’re proud to be helping over 2.7 million+ subscribers worldwide transform the way they do business.
We started Xero to change the game for small business. Xero is one of the fastest growing Software as a Service companies globally. We lead the New Zealand, Australian, and United Kingdom cloud accounting markets, employing a world-class team of more than 3,500+ people. We’re proud to be helping over 2.7 million+ subscribers worldwide transform the way they do business and seamlessly integrates with over 1,000 apps. And we’re just getting started.

Introducing Hiya AI Phone—your intelligent call assistant that makes your phone conversations safer and more productive. Designed for busy people who value their time and security, Hiya AI Phone empowers you to take control of every call.
• Save time. Automatically block spam and unwanted calls, so you can focus on what matters.
• Stay safe. Protect yourself from phone scams with advanced AI-driven detection.
• Work smarter. No more jotting down notes - Hiya AI Phone transcribes and summarizes your calls automatically, so you never miss any detail.
HIYA AI PHONE’S INTELLIGENT CALL MANAGEMENT FEATURES
AI-POWERED CALL SCREENING
Hiya uses advanced AI to screen calls, letting you know who’s calling and why. Block spam and unwanted calls while staying focused on what matters.
REAL-TIME SCAM PROTECTION
Stay protected from phone scams with Hiya’s industry-leading scam protection technology, ensuring your conversations stay secure. 
AI VOICE AND DEEPFAKE DETECTION
Hiya AI Phone safeguards your conversations by detecting and flagging deep fakes and AI Voices using advanced AI voice identification, ensuring your security and peace of mind.
INTELLIGENT CALL SUMMARIES AND TRANSCRIPTS
Extract key insights from every conversation with intuitive call transcriptions and summaries, store important details for easy reference, and effortlessly share them to drive collaboration and productivity.
VISUAL VOICEMAIL WITH AI VOICE DETECTION 
Visual voicemail lets you quickly review messages without listening, while identifying AI-generated or deepfake voicemails, enhancing your productivity and security.
YOUR CALLS REMAIN PRIVATE
Your call audio, transcripts or summaries are stored on-device to keep your conversations private. Use incognito mode during your phone call for extra-sensitive conversations that you don’t want transcribed or summarized. 
WORKS FOR ALL YOUR CALLS
Use Hiya AI Phone for both incoming and outgoing calls to ensure you always stay protected and productive. Say goodbye to the iOS Phone app.
WHAT LIFE IS LIKE WITH HIYA AI PHONE
• Communicate confidently in every interaction, knowing that Hiya AI Phone is enhancing your call experiences.
• Experience distraction-free conversations that enrich your day rather than disrupt it.
• Trust in the most advanced call safety technology to block unwanted calls to keep your communications secure and reliable.
• Gain control over your phone calls—filtering out unwanted distractions while ensuring you stay reachable for the calls that matter.
• Elevate your productivity by transforming phone conversations into actionable insights, empowering you to make informed decisions. 
• Stay connected safely by prioritizing important calls while filtering out distractions, ensuring you stay safe and in control. 
Hiya AI Phone is free to download, with a subscription required to access all features. Start with a free trial, and cancel anytime through your app store settings.

bluejetty:00081205:ios.description:
Let's Discover How to Make Personalized Wallpaper Based on Your Name!
Create Unique and Personalized Wallpapers with Your Beloved Cats in Just a Few Taps
DIY Cat Language Wallpaper is an app that helps you do this. Simply type your name using the cat keyboard within the DIY Cat Language Wallpaper application.
Each letter on the keyboard corresponds to a unique toy with its own style and color. Your name will be spelled out using these cat toy letters, forming a message in the "language of cats."
DIY Cat Language Wallpaper will also create fun, peaceful, and meaningful experiences.
*** Main Features ***
Cat Letter Based Wallpapers:
► A cat toy keyboard lets you explore your name written in the language of cats, with each letter represented by a unique and meaningful cat toy.
► Choose from a variety of cats to personalize your wallpaper. Each cat represents your own unique personality and emotions.
Customizable Keyboards:
► Select from a variety of themed keyboards, where each letter corresponds to a different cat's toy. Personalize your wallpapers by choosing your favorite cats or mixing and matching letters from various keyboards.
Soothing Music:
► Enhance your wallpaper creation experience with calming, soothing music. Customize your playlists, enjoy nature sounds, or meditate while designing.
Set as Cat Wallpaper:
► Save your stunning and unique creations and set them as wallpapers for your lock screen. Imagine the compliments you'll get from your friends and loved ones!
Customization Options:
► DIY Cat Language Wallpaper offers beautiful cat toys on the keyboard, with many options to customize your wallpaper representing your name.
► Add an optional cat, favorite toy, face, tree, rug, sleeping bag, or name tag to further decorate your cat.
► Background themes: Adjust the color, choose a beautiful available theme, or even import your own photo as the background.
► Tags: Personalize your tags with various styles, colors, and text fonts.
Each cat and toy in the app is associated with a specific meaning, allowing users to craft wallpapers that are both beautiful and meaningful. Type your letter and see it translated into a stunning cat design. Customize your wallpapers and enjoy unique layouts. Express yourself through cats!
Download DIY Cat Language Wallpaper now and step into a stunning and awesome cat world!

bluejetty:00017063:ios.description:
This app organizes the vast and varied library of Rick Steves’ audio content into geographic-specific playlists so that travelers can enjoy ready access to the information that relates specifically to their travel plans. Many tracks provide general cultural and sightseeing information gleaned from his public radio program, Travel with Rick Steves. Other tracks are self-guided tours to great sights and historic walks. While we travel there’s lots of down time, and this application can both entertain and teach. Rick Steves Audio Europe will hopefully make your European travels more meaningful and more fun.
Features:
• The app downloads and stores audio files on your device. No Wi-Fi or cellphone connection is required to listen. (You will need a connection if you choose to add audio tracks later.)
• Handy maps (PDF) that complement the self-guided audio tours can be viewed on your device.
• The audio content originates from Rick Steves guidebooks and the Travel with Rick Steves public radio program. Self-guided tours are excerpted from Rick Steves country and city guidebooks.
• Rick Steves Audio Europe is a work in progress. New audio tracks will be added and existing tracks updated as necessary. Be sure to enable Notifications for this app to get the latest updates.

bluejetty:00160990:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00160990:ios.description:
Keep the Glow (KtG) is one of the best couples apps to improve your communication for a better relationship. Start with 2 weeks FREE! 
HOW IT WORKS:
We all have a love bucket inside of us and your partner is the faucet. In the beginning, your partner was filling up your bucket by doing and saying all the right things. However, over time they turned down the faucet and started draining your bucket by doing things you don't like. Over time, your full love bucket became lower and lower until it became dry and that's when couples start to fall out of love. This app for couples is designed to reverse that! It will train you on how to open up your communication to start filling up your partner's love bucket again. As love buckets get fuller conflicts decrease because love promotes grace. The opposite is also true. As love buckets get lower conflict increases. 
THREE PHASES YOU'LL EXPERIENCE:
There are three phases you'll experience with this couples app to improve your communication. First, you'll learn what your partner's fillers are that they need to feel loved and what the drainers are that you do that makes them feel negative toward you. Second, you'll slowly learn how they are defining their fillers and drainers. For example, they may list affection as a filler but it may take time to learn what type of affection they desire most. Third, you'll slowly start changing your behavior to maximize their fillers and minimize the drainers. If couples are intentional, it usually takes 8-12 weeks to get their love buckets filled consistently. Changing behavior in relationships can be challenging. However, this couples app will help through regular communication on how well you both are doing filling up one another's love buckets. It also provides accountability through weekly feedback so neither partner backslides in their efforts. 
DEVELOPED BY A PSYCHOLOGIST:
KtG is developed by Licensed Psychologist Dr. Wyatt Fisher who has a Master’s and Doctorate in Clinical Psychology. He specializes in couples counseling in Boulder, CO. He's also the host of the Dr. Wyatt Show podcast and author of the Total Marriage Refresh book. 
SUBSCRIPTIONS:
KtG provides a free two-week trial for couples to try the app. After that, only one subscription per couple is required for full access. Full access includes the ability for couples to give and receive feedback on how well they filled up their partner's love bucket. This is essential to improve the communication in your relationship. In addition, you'll be able to see your progress charted over time on each filler and drainer to determine if you're improving. All of the articles and resources within the app are always free. Subscription options include monthly, six months (15% discount), or twelve months (30% discount). Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of your subscription date. However, you can turn off auto-renew at any time within your account settings. 
PERSONAL DATA:
Your personal data is securely stored on Keep the Glow. Be sure to read our privacy policy and terms and conditions. http://keeptheglow.com/privacy and http://keeptheglow.com/terms

bluejetty:00034801:ios.name: FM Radio: Music, News & Sports
bluejetty:00034801:ios.summary: Experience reliable connection with high-quality AM, FM, and online streams. Whether you are looking for music tracks, live sports coverage, breaking news, or talk shows, you can access them directly. Switch between your local stations and
bluejetty:00034801:ios.description:
Experience reliable connection with high-quality AM, FM, and online streams. Whether you are looking for music tracks, live sports coverage, breaking news, or talk shows, you can access them directly. Switch between your local stations and global broadcasts depending on your location. As an internet-based radio application, we focus on providing a stable streaming experience to let you access online audio anywhere.
Search & Discovery
• Find live radio stations by country, state, city, or genre (pop, classic hits, 80s/90s, hip-hop, rock) — including music, sports, news, and talk categories.
• Access 100,000+ stations worldwide, including FM radio, AM radio, internet radio, live streams, and CarPlay-compatible broadcasts.
Radio Player Features
• Support real-time streaming, save stations to your favorites or custom collections, and view recommendations curated by our team.
• Local Radio: Access live local stations, real-time regional traffic updates, and breaking news.
• Song Recognition: Identify songs currently playing on the radio to view trending tracks.
• Driving Mode: A simplified interface designed for on-the-road scenarios, allowing you to switch stations with a single tap.
Live Sports Coverage
• Access live sports broadcasts covering basketball, rugby, baseball, soccer, and other international tournaments.
• Listen to sports commentary and analysis to follow match dynamics in real time.
• Follow professional basketball, football leagues, baseball, tennis, golf, and other sports categories.
News & Talk Stations
• Access global and local live news streams for first-hand updates on current events.
• Review updates covering current topics, financial trends, social issues, and international news formats.
• Listen to interviews and opinion programs from professional perspectives during your commute, work, or rest hours.
CarPlay Integration
• Stream news, talk shows, and music via CarPlay during your drive.
• Switch channels and programs directly through your car display screen.
Common Usage Scenarios
• Daily Commute: Listen to news, traffic updates, or music on your way to work to make use of your travel time.
• Morning Routine: Access global headlines and local events to start your day.
• Relaxation: Unwind after work with music or talk shows to relieve stress.
• Travel: Stay connected with your hometown or experience regional cultures through local broadcasts.
Application Implementation
We deliver stable audio streaming with support for global broadcasts. The application features minimal buffering, built-in local recording, CarPlay compatibility, and streaming with no geographic restrictions. Designed for both new users and radio enthusiasts, this application brings live radio, music, news, and sports directly to your device.
FM Radio Highlights
• Listen to 100,000+ global radio stations from 200+ countries and territories.
• Search by station name, country, region, city, or genre.
• Track and song recognition support.
• CarPlay integration for in-car usage.
Subscription Information
Subscriptions automatically renew unless they are canceled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscriptions in Settings after purchase.
Privacy & Terms
We value your privacy – application data is used exclusively to improve functionality and is handled strictly in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
Privacy Policy: https://fmaudio.mobiaura.com/legal/privacy
Terms of Service: https://fmaudio.mobiaura.com/legal/terms
Feedback
Questions or suggestions? Contact us via email at service@mobiaura.com – we respond to user feedback to improve the application experience.
Download FM Radio to access live streams, sports commentary, breaking news, and local broadcasts from your device.

Transform Your iPhone or iPad into a Full Studio Guitar Setup with Deplike® !

Choose from 100+ amps, cabinets, pedals, and microphones to create your unique tones with full control over every sound setting. Deplike® features AUv3 compatibility, allowing you to integrate the app as a guitar effects and amp sim plugin into mobile DAWs such as GarageBand and Cubasis.

Our presets sound great on any guitar, bass, or acoustic guitar with pickups. Whether you play heavy metal on an old Fender or soft rock on a modern bass, the sound will always be familiar and high-quality.

100.000+ presets for popular songs across various genres

Favorites for quick access to preferred presets

Collections of presets handpicked by Deplike editors
Intelligent feedback and noise reduction system for a clear sound
Low latency for real-time playing
Pickup setting information
Preset requests for new sounds
ADVANCED (FREE) FEATURES:

bluejetty:00064996:ios.description:
Are you buying a home, selling, renting, or simply following the housing market? HouseSigma helps you search homes across Canada, track sold prices, monitor listings, stay on top of market trends, and make more informed real estate decisions.
HouseSigma is a Canadian real estate app built for people who want more than basic property listings. Search for homes for sale and rent, explore sold history, check home values, and set neighbourhood alerts for new listings, price changes, and status updates. Whether you are actively looking for a home or keeping an eye on a neighbourhood, HouseSigma gives you the insights you need to navigate the market with confidence.
What you can do with HouseSigma:
• Search homes for sale and rent across major Canadian markets
• View sold prices and listing history - even if the home was sold years ago
• Set alerts for new listings, sales, price changes, and status updates
• Track neighbourhoods, communities, and custom map areas
• Check school scores and nearby amenities while exploring homes
• Use AI-powered home valuation tools
• See market trends and local real estate insights
• Find sold comparables for nearby similar properties
• See which nearby home listings are getting the most attention
• Assess rental yields for investment properties
• Connect with HouseSigma real estate agents for help buying, selling, or renting
HouseSigma is trusted by more than two million monthly users and has a 4.9/5 Trustpilot rating for its platform and brokerage.
Note: Listing coverage and historical sold data vary by market, and coverage continues to expand across Canada.

bluejetty:00149356:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00149356:ios.description:
As humans, we’re hardwired for connection. Belonging to a community makes us feel safe and helps us thrive. 
But so often, living with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) can make you feel physically and emotionally isolated. Not only can it be hard to do things you loved before your diagnosis, but it can also feel like no one understands what it’s like.
Until now.
Our mission is to cultivate a space powered by the IBD community and empowered by each other. From one-to-one chats to conversation forums, we make connecting easy. This is a safe place to find and receive advice, to seek and offer support, and to discover the authentic stories of members, just like you.
Bezzy IBD is a free online platform bringing new meaning to the word “community.” 
Our aim is to create an experience where:
- everyone feels seen, valued, and understood
- everyone’s story matters
- shared vulnerability is the name of the game
Bezzy IBD is a place where you are more than your IBD. It’s a place where, finally, you belong.
HOW IT WORKS
Social-first Content
Like all of your favorite social networks, we’ve designed an activity feed to connect you with other members living with IBD. We pride ourselves on making Bezzy IBD a safe and secure space where you can join live discussions, connect one-to-one, and read the latest articles and personal stories.
Live Chats 
Need to vent? Get advice? Share what’s on your mind? Hop into a daily live chat to join the conversation. They’re often led by our amazing Community Guide, but you can also expect to chat with other advocates and experts, too.
Forums
From treatments to symptoms to daily living, IBD changes everything. Whatever you're feeling on any given day, there's a forum where you can connect and share directly with others.
1:1 Messaging
Let us connect you with a new member from our community every day. We’ll recommend members to you based on your treatment plan, lifestyle interests, and needs. Browse member profiles and request to connect with anyone from our community with members listed as “Online Now.”
Discover Articles and Stories
We believe that shared experiences empower the kind of belonging that can help people not only survive—but thrive—with IBD. Our stories offer perspectives and tips from people who know what it’s like.
Get handpicked wellness and member stories delivered to you each week.
Connect Safely Anytime, Anywhere 
We take thoughtful steps to build safety, security, and privacy into our platform and foster an environment where members feel safe sharing their personal experiences. Check and send messages, see who’s online, and get notified when a new message comes in—so you’ll never miss a thing. 
ABOUT HEALTHLINE

listings.name: Bezzy IBD (Crohn's & Colitis)
listings.description:
As humans, we’re hardwired for connection. Belonging to a community makes us feel safe and helps us thrive. 
 
But so often, living with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) can make you feel physically and emotionally isolated. Not only can it be hard to do things you loved before your diagnosis, but it can also feel like no one understands what it’s like.
 
Until now.

Our mission is to cultivate a space powered by the IBD community and empowered by each other. From one-to-one chats to conversation forums, we make connecting easy. This is a safe place to find and receive advice, to seek and offer support, and to discover the authentic stories of members, just like you.
 
Bezzy IBD is a free online platform bringing new meaning to the word “community.” 
 
Our aim is to create an experience where:
- everyone feels seen, valued, and understood
- everyone’s story matters
- shared vulnerability is the name of the game
 
Bezzy IBD is a place where you are more than your IBD. It’s a place where, finally, you belong.

HOW IT WORKS

Social-first Content
Like all of your favorite social networks, we’ve designed an activity feed to connect you with other members living with IBD. We pride ourselves on making Bezzy IBD a safe and secure space where you can join live discussions, connect one-to-one, and read the latest articles and personal stories.

Live Chats 
Need to vent? Get advice? Share what’s on your mind? Hop into a daily live chat to join the conversation. They’re often led by our amazing Community Guide, but you can also expect to chat with other advocates and experts, too.
 
Forums
From treatments to symptoms to daily living, IBD changes everything. Whatever you're feeling on any given day, there's a forum where you can connect and share directly with others.
 
1:1 Messaging
Let us connect you with a new member from our community every day. We’ll recommend members to you based on your treatment plan, lifestyle interests, and needs. Browse member profiles and request to connect with anyone from our community with members listed as “Online Now.”

Discover Articles and Stories
We believe that shared experiences empower the kind of belonging that can help people not only survive—but thrive—with IBD. Our stories offer perspectives and tips from people who know what it’s like.
Get handpicked wellness and member stories delivered to you each week.
 
Connect Safely Anytime, Anywhere 
We take thoughtful steps to build safety, security, and privacy into our platform and foster an environment where members feel safe sharing their personal experiences. Check and send messages, see who’s online, and get notified when a new message comes in—so you’ll never miss a thing. 
 
 
ABOUT HEALTHLINE

From preschool and beyond, Learn German by Studycat inspires children's innate love of learning with interactive games and a
bluejetty:00120136:ios.description:
From the award-winning creators of Studycat for Schools, comes Learn German! The #1 way for kids to learn Deutsch!
From preschool and beyond, Learn German by Studycat inspires children's innate love of learning with interactive games and activities.
Our bite-sized lessons will keep your child motivated while they discover a new language and build bilingual skills for a lifetime!
WHY STUDYCAT?
• Learn German, in German. All our activities focus on virtual language immersion, which means your child won't be hearing any English, only German! This might be confusing at first, but trust us, it's the best way to learn.
• Everyday Language. Our lessons teach words and expressions that kids can apply in their everyday lives, so they can get a head start developing their bilingual abilities.
• Get Talking Fast. With our interactive speaking challenges, kids will be encouraged to speak entire words and phrases on their own! The earlier kids start their language-learning journey, the more likely they are to reach proficiency quickly.
• Vocal Variety. Our characters' voices use different tones, expressions, and accents so that kids can pick up on the subtleties of pronunciation from different speakers.
• Designed by Experts. All our activities are designed by language and early-education experts. Thoughtfully developed lessons will build your child's confidence with every step.
• Learner Profiles (coming soon). Create up to four personalized profiles for different family members, allowing tailored learning paths and individual progress tracking.
• Safe for Kids & Ad-Free. Parents can rest easy knowing that there are no pesky ads to distract children from their learning. All content is appropriate for ages 3 and up.
• Offline Learning. On a plane, at a restaurant, or in a park? No problem! Learn German by Studycat is available for both online and offline use.
WHAT ARE PARENTS SAYING?
“As a parent trying to raise bilingual children at home, Studycat is a helpful app to start them off and create excitement about the language.” — Fluent in 3 Months
“Everything has been thought out carefully and the games and activities are really engaging.” — Bilingual Kidspot
“The concept is so simple but extremely effective. I even found myself learning at the same time.” — Bump, Baby & You
--
If you like Learn German by Studycat, try it out for 7 days free! Empower your child to learn like never before, and get extras like printable worksheets.
If you choose to subscribe, payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the App Store after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://studycat.com/about/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00177706:ios.description:
Use two or more accounts of the same app on one phone, each signed in separately. Switch between personal and work accounts in a tap, with no logging out and back in.
Dual Accounts keeps every account apart: your second Instagram never sees your first one, and signing out of one account leaves the others exactly as they were. Run multiple accounts side by side, keep them private, and manage them all from one secure app.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Tap Add and pick an app, or type any website.
2. Give the account a name, like "Work" or "Personal".
3. Sign in once. Next time it opens already signed in.
Add the same app as many times as you need, and each copy keeps its own login.
KEY FEATURES
• Multiple accounts, fully separate
Add two, three or more accounts of the same app. Each keeps its own login and its own session, so you stay signed in to all of them at once without one account affecting another.
• 50+ popular social apps
Use popular apps like Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, X, Snapchat, Messenger, Telegram, LinkedIn, Gmail, Threads, Discord, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit and Teams.
• Add any website as a custom app
Missing an app? Type its web address, give it a name, and it sits on your Home screen like any other account.
• 30+ AI tools in one place
Open popular AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Claude, Copilot and Perplexity next to your accounts, and keep separate logins for each.
• Games
Quick browser games like 8 Ball Pool, Ludo, Slither.io and UNO, one tap away.
• Live Cricket
Live scores and ball-by-ball highlights for every match, plus up-to-date match information, team rankings and player statistics.
• Private Gallery
Hide photos and videos from your phone's gallery in a passcode-protected vault. Organise them into albums, view them full screen, and export them back to your phone whenever you like.
• Cloud Backup
Back up your Private Gallery to secure cloud storage. Restore it on a new phone or after reinstalling the app, and choose exactly which photos and videos to bring back.
• My Files
A built-in file manager with folders. Import documents, scan pages with your camera, add photos and open files from other apps, all kept inside Dual Accounts.
• Private Notes
Write notes that stay behind your passcode, with the date and time saved on each one.
• Music
Import your own audio files and play them inside the app.
• Usage and Time Limits
See how much time you spend in each app, AI tool and game, and set daily limits so you stay in control of your screen time.
• Passcode and Face ID
Lock the whole app with a passcode or Face ID. Set a recovery email so you can get back in if you ever forget your passcode.
• Private Browser
Browse the web without saving your history.
• Brand new design
A fresh, modern look with Light and Dark themes, built to be faster and smoother.
PREMIUM
Upgrade to remove ads, add unlimited apps and unlock Cloud Backup. Weekly, monthly, yearly and lifetime plans are available. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your account settings.

listings.description:
Use two or more accounts of the same app on one phone, each signed in separately. Switch between personal and work accounts in a tap, with no logging out and back in.

Dual Accounts keeps every account apart: your second Instagram never sees your first one, and signing out of one account leaves the others exactly as they were. Run multiple accounts side by side, keep them private, and manage them all from one secure app.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Tap Add and pick an app, or type any website.
2. Give the account a name, like "Work" or "Personal".
3. Sign in once. Next time it opens already signed in.
Add the same app as many times as you need, and each copy keeps its own login.

KEY FEATURES

• Multiple accounts, fully separate
Add two, three or more accounts of the same app. Each keeps its own login and its own session, so you stay signed in to all of them at once without one account affecting another.

• 50+ popular social apps
Use popular apps like Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, X, Snapchat, Messenger, Telegram, LinkedIn, Gmail, Threads, Discord, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit and Teams.

• Add any website as a custom app

Open popular AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Claude, Copilot and Perplexity next to your accounts, and keep separate logins for each.

• Games
Quick browser games like 8 Ball Pool, Ludo, Slither.io and UNO, one tap away.

Live scores and ball-by-ball highlights for every match, plus up-to-date match information, team rankings and player statistics.

• Private Gallery
Hide photos and videos from your phone's gallery in a passcode-protected vault. Organise them into albums, view them full screen, and export them back to your phone whenever you like.

• Cloud Backup
Back up your Private Gallery to secure cloud storage. Restore it on a new phone or after reinstalling the app, and choose exactly which photos and videos to bring back.

A built-in file manager with folders. Import documents, scan pages with your camera, add photos and open files from other apps, all kept inside Dual Accounts.

• Private Notes
Write notes that stay behind your passcode, with the date and time saved on each one.

• Music
Import your own audio files and play them inside the app.

• Usage and Time Limits
See how much time you spend in each app, AI tool and game, and set daily limits so you stay in control of your screen time.

Lock the whole app with a passcode or Face ID. Set a recovery email so you can get back in if you ever forget your passcode.

Browse the web without saving your history.

bluejetty:00089057:ios.summary: Strike helps you grow your bitcoin holdings. Trusted by millions of individuals and thousands of businesses, Strike is beginner-friendly for first-time buyers and sophisticated for seasoned holders. Sign up in seconds and start with any amo
bluejetty:00089057:ios.description:
Strike helps you grow your bitcoin holdings. Trusted by millions of individuals and thousands of businesses, Strike is beginner-friendly for first-time buyers and sophisticated for seasoned holders. Sign up in seconds and start with any amount.
ACCUMULATE BITCOIN ON YOUR TERMS
• Add funds through a linked bank account, wire transfer, or debit card. Buy or sell from $1 to $2,500,000 per transaction. Deposit and trade unlimited times.
• Direct deposit¹ your salary to Strike. Convert up to 100% of your paycheck to bitcoin, with fees waived for up to $20K per month.
• Set target orders to automatically buy during market dips or to sell at your preferred price. Add chart widgets to your homescreen and get notifications for price changes.
• Schedule recurring buys to automate your dollar-cost averaging (DCA) strategy. Fees are waived after the first week for personal accounts.
• Benefit from transparent fees as low as 0.49%. The more you trade, the less you pay. Earn fee-free trades for each friend you refer.
BORROW CASH AGAINST BITCOIN
• Apply for a bitcoin-backed loan¹, available for individuals and businesses in select regions. Borrow from $10,000 to $5,000,000 for 12 months with a maximum initial loan-to-value (LTV) ratio of 50%. No credit check required.
• Pay no origination, early-repayment, or late-payment fees. Refinance¹ or close anytime after your loan has been open for 60 days.
• Get Annual Percentage Rates (APRs) starting at at 9.5%² for monthly payment loans and 10.5%² for payment-at-maturity loans. For example, if you open a $10,000 payment-at-maturity loan at 13% APR, you would repay $11,300 (principal plus interest) one year later, assuming you maintain the required loan-to-value (LTV) ratio. Rates, interest, and payment amounts are estimates for illustrative purposes only. The actual APR, loan term, and payment amount will be disclosed before accepting the loan. Collateral requirements apply and may change. Your bitcoin is held with Strike or transferred to our trusted capital providers with no further rehypothecation.
MANAGE YOUR BITCOIN HOLDINGS
• Hold bitcoin with confidence. Assets in your Strike account are always fully backed 1:1.
• Protect your account with two-factor authentication (2FA) using an authenticator app, passkey, or security key.
• Withdraw to self-custody for free. We cover the blockchain network costs.
• Track your cost basis1 to manage your portfolio and file taxes with ease.
• Need help? Request in-app, email, or phone¹ support.
MAKE PAYMENTS AND GLOBAL MONEY TRANSFERS
• Get a unique routing and account number and use bitcoin or cash to pay bills¹, including utilities, credit card bills, rent, mortgages, insurance, and more.
• Shop gift cards from your favorite stores and top up your phone.
• Transfer cash or bitcoin to any friend who also uses Strike. Send on-chain and Lightning payments to any bitcoin wallet. Pay invoices as small as 0.00000001 BTC (1 satoshi).
• Send remittances directly to mobile money wallets or international bank accounts in 14 supported countries, including Mexico, the Philippines, and Nigeria.
—
¹ Features only available in certain regions for eligible customers.
² The Annual Percentage Rate (APR) varies by loan type and principal amount. Depending on your location, loans are issued by Zap Solutions Capital, Inc., dba Strike Lending (NMLS No. 2741098), or Column N.A., Member FDIC. Strike Lending is a financial technology company, not a bank. Loan approval is subject to an agreement and eligibility. Collateral requirements apply and may change. To qualify for a loan, you must reside in a supported region and have an active Strike account in good standing.
The availability of the Strike App is subject to jurisdictional limitations. Strike may not offer certain products, features, and services in certain locations. See our Terms of Service for more information: https://strike.me/legal/tos/.
All investments involve risk, including the possible loss of principal.

Dada Bhagwan:
(The Official App of Dada Bhagwan Foundation – www.dadabhagwan.org)
Description:
The experience of being in the presence of a living Gnani Purush (Self-Realized being) is unexplainable, but it is not always possible. Although virtual, this app allows you to feel the presence of the Gnani through various digital media including Books, Audios, Videos, Galleries and much more…
Here is a glimpse of what you can find in this app:
1. Schedule: Find all the program schedules in one place whether it is for live satsang, WebTV or TV satsangs telecasted on different TV channels worldwide
• Web TV Schedule
• Satsang and Gnan Vidhi Schedule
• TV Program Schedule
• Live Webcast Schedule
2. Books: Download and read various books on Param Pujya Dada Bhagwan’s spiritual science in different languages
• e-Books (read)
• Audio Books (listen)
• Glossary
3. Magazines: Topic-based magazines designed to meet the needs of every age group
• Akram Express
• Akram Youth
• Dadavani
• Glossary
4. Videos: Charge yourself by watching your favourite videos from a vast collection of satsangs by Param Pujya Dadashri, Pujya Niruma and Pujya Deepakbhai
• Beginner Videos
• Gnan Experiences
• Energizers
• Recent Satsangs
• Library
• Events
• Samayik Module
• Music Videos
• Status Videos
5. Gallery: Purify your chit with the divine darshan of the Gnani Purush
• Photo Gallery
• Wallpapers
• Spiritual Quotes
6. Audios: Lots of spiritual material all in audio form for you to listen to anywhere, anytime
• Gnan Vani
• Spiritual Songs
• Ringtones
• Audio Books
• Audio Magazines
• Instrumentals
• Energizers - charge yourself with spiritual energy
• Recent Satsangs
• Library
• Samayik Module
• Experiences
• Beginner Audios
• Podcast
7. Contact: Reach us easily at any of our centers worldwide
• Main Center
• Find a Center
8. Sadhana Module: Sadhana essentials at your fingertips to help you progress spiritually
• Vidhi
• Aarti
• Samayik Of The Day
• New Addition: Pujya Deepakbhai's ‘Home Work’ Videos / Messages
*Exciting / Wonderful New Features*
• Preferred Language – By selecting your preferred language you get quick access to all the material available in that language
• Set a Reminder – Alerts pop-up to remind you to watch your favorite TV program and for sadhana
• Notifications of New Updates
• Playlist – Create your own playlists of the videos and audios you like.
• Favorites – Press the 'heart' button on any of the audios, videos, books and magazines you like and view them in the section.
• Watchlist – Add the videos that you want to watch later
• Bookmark – Under this feature, you can tag any video time wise as per your liking which will enable you to watch the selected part of that video at your convenience.
• History – The videos that you watch will automatically get saved in this section. This feature will help you track your already watched videos. 
• Download audio,eBooks and magazines and use them offline at any time and use ePub reader feature to read the downloaded ePub files within the app. Also you can bookmark the page which you feel like the most.

bluejetty:00084740:ios.name: Full Quran Sharif Offline
bluejetty:00084740:ios.summary:
Read and listen to the Full Quran Sharif with a simple Quran reading experience featuring the 16 Line Quran, translations, audio recitation, Prayer Times, Qibla Direction, and Islamic calendars.
Full Quran Sharif Offline is designed to mak
bluejetty:00084740:ios.description:
Read and listen to the Full Quran Sharif with a simple Quran reading experience featuring the 16 Line Quran, translations, audio recitation, Prayer Times, Qibla Direction, and Islamic calendars.
Full Quran Sharif Offline is designed to make reading and listening to the Holy Quran convenient for everyday use. Read the complete Quran Majeed in Arabic, view Quran translations in multiple languages, listen to Quran recitation, and easily navigate to any Surah or Para.
Whether you want to read the Quran, listen to recitation, follow the familiar 16-line layout, or check daily Salah timings, the app brings useful Quran and Islamic features together in one place.
FULL QURAN SHARIF
Read the complete Quran Majeed with a clean and comfortable reading experience. Easily navigate through Surahs and Paras using the Quran Index and continue your daily Quran reading and recitation.
16 LINE QURAN
Read the Holy Quran in the familiar 16 Line Quran layout. This format provides a consistent reading experience and is useful for regular recitation, memorization, and readers who are familiar with the traditional 16-line Quran format.
QURAN TRANSLATION
Read Quran Translation alongside the Arabic text to better understand the verses of the Holy Quran. Translations are available in multiple languages, allowing you to read the meaning while keeping the original Arabic Quran accessible on the same reading experience.
AUDIO QURAN
Listen to Quran recitation with the built-in Audio Quran feature. The audio experience makes it convenient to listen to the Holy Quran when reading is not possible or whenever you prefer listening to recitation.
Background audio playback allows you to continue listening while using other supported functions on your device, making Quran listening easier to include in your daily routine.
QURAN SEARCH & INDEX
Quickly find Quran content using the search feature. Search Quran topics and navigate to relevant content without manually browsing through the complete Quran.
The Quran Index also provides direct access to Surahs and Paras, making it easier to reach the section you want to read, recite, memorize, or study.
QIBLA DIRECTION
Find the Qibla Direction using the built-in Qibla Finder. The Qibla Compass helps determine the direction of the Kaaba in Makkah based on your location, providing convenient access to Qibla information at home or while traveling.
For better compass accuracy, ensure the required location and compass services are available on your device.
PRAYER TIMES & SALAH REMINDERS
Check daily Prayer Times based on your location and keep track of the five daily Salah timings. Prayer reminders can help you follow your daily prayer schedule.
Prayer Times are available alongside the Quran features, providing convenient access to Quran reading and daily Salah information from one app.
RAMADAN CALENDAR
Check Ramadan timings according to your location. View Sehar and Iftar timings during Ramadan and follow the fasting schedule throughout the holy month.
The Ramadan Calendar provides convenient access to daily Sehar and Iftar information during Ramadan.
HIJRI CALENDAR
View Hijri and Gregorian dates using the built-in Hijri Calendar. Navigate between months, check Islamic dates and events, and convert dates between the Hijri and Gregorian calendars.
Full Quran Sharif Offline brings Quran reading, audio recitation, Quran Translation, Prayer Times, Qibla Direction, Hijri dates, and Ramadan timings together in one convenient experience.
Read the Quran Majeed, listen to Quran recitation, understand verses with translation, find the Qibla, check Salah timings, and access useful Islamic calendar information as part of your daily routine.

bluejetty:00093097:ios.summary: FarmKeep is the only app you need to easily manage all your animals, breeding, production, finances, and more. Whether you are a family farm, homesteader, or small to mid size business, FarmKeep supports your needs and grows with you. Our f
bluejetty:00093097:ios.description:
FarmKeep is the only app you need to easily manage all your animals, breeding, production, finances, and more. Whether you are a family farm, homesteader, or small to mid size business, FarmKeep supports your needs and grows with you. Our features and services include:
Up to date animal records
Record animal information such as birth date, sex, and weight history, along with a dedicated photo gallery. Track your animals, health, vaccines, feedings, activity, breeding history, pedigree and more. No matter what animals you have, you can easily manage them all in one place.
Easy breeding management
Automatically calculate gestation periods and incubation times for over 1200 species and breeds, including custom ones. Get notifications about important milestones like exam dates, due dates, incubation lockdown, and hatch dates.
Optimize yield with production tracking
With FarmKeep’s simple record keeping experience, it’s easy to track products such as eggs, milk, honey, wool, and more on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis so you can see trends over time and improve productivity of your animals or crops.
Simplify financial record keeping
Record sales transactions, categorize expenses, and stay on top of your farm's financial health. Gain valuable insights and identify top-performing products or track costs associated with livestock, feed, equipment, and more.
Multi-member farm
Invite your family, friends, farm hands, customers or fans to join your farm with different levels of access so they can contribute or just keep up to date with all your farm activities.
Tasks and reminders

FarmKeep is the only app you need to easily manage all your animals, breeding, production, finances, and more. Whether you are a family farm, homesteader, or small to mid size business, FarmKeep supports your needs and grows with you. Our features and services include:

Up to date animal records
Record animal information such as birth date, sex, and weight history, along with a dedicated photo gallery. Track your animals, health, vaccines, feedings, activity, breeding history, pedigree and more. No matter what animals you have, you can easily manage them all in one place.

Easy breeding management
Automatically calculate gestation periods and incubation times for over 1200 species and breeds, including custom ones. Get notifications about important milestones like exam dates, due dates, incubation lockdown, and hatch dates.

Optimize yield with production tracking
With FarmKeep’s simple record keeping experience, it’s easy to track products such as eggs, milk, honey, wool, and more on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis so you can see trends over time and improve productivity of your animals or crops.

Simplify financial record keeping
Record sales transactions, categorize expenses, and stay on top of your farm's financial health. Gain valuable insights and identify top-performing products or track costs associated with livestock, feed, equipment, and more.

Multi-member farm
Invite your family, friends, farm hands, customers or fans to join your farm with different levels of access so they can contribute or just keep up to date with all your farm activities.

Tasks and reminders
Set tasks and reminders for yourself or others on your farm to get ahead of all your farm chores. Keep everything organized all in one place so if you need an extra helping hand, it’s easy to share your routine with anyone.

Accurate land mapping
Map areas on your property where animals live and crops are planted. Plan your pasture rotation and more to help you better manage activities throughout the year.

Cross platform

Mobile Adventures takes location based games to an exciting new level. We’re global leaders in delivering unique, fun and interactive games that combine amazing content with the latest technology to create a wide range of unique indoor and outdoor location based events.
Our innovative mobile gaming platform is ideal for private events, team building activities, training, group activities or simply as a fun location based activity that gets you out and about discovering great new places. 
Using our latest technology, we can provide off-the-shelf games in any location or provide you with a game that is uniquely tailored to your needs with your own customised tasks, questions and challenges.
Mobile Adventures - the ultimate team experience in the palm of your hand!
No data is collected by us at the point of downloading the app or loading the game. We only start collecting data at the point when individuals join a game, At that point we collect the following data: device used, device operating system, distance travelled during the game, starting battery life of the device, which tasks your unlocked during the game, % of tasks that you completed correctly, location throughout the game and answers to challenges which includes text responses, photos and videos. We process this data to help us develop, test and improve the systems, services and challenges we provide to you. Further information about our data protection policy can be found here: https://wearewildgoose.com/uk/team-activities/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00149412:ios.summary:
Not sure which scarf looks better on you or which filter to use on your picture? Perhaps you’re curious about what book to read next? With WhichOne, you can get answers to all of your easy and tough everyday decisions!

Creating
bluejetty:00149412:ios.description:
Not sure which scarf looks better on you or which filter to use on your picture? Perhaps you’re curious about what book to read next? With WhichOne, you can get answers to all of your easy and tough everyday decisions!
— Create — 
Creating a poll is easy: You ask a question and upload two images as options for people to vote on. After that, you’ll receive real-time updates on your profile regarding how many people have voted on your poll, as well as what the breakdown looks like for each option. All you have to do is sit back and let the world help you decide! 
— Vote —
As you’re scrolling through all of the incredible, user-generated polls, we’re certain you’ll come across ones that’ll catch your eye! Voting is simple: You simply tap on the image option you choose and we’ll show you a breakdown of what other people have chosen for you to compare! Our interface is designed in a way so you can vote on the things that matter to you and simply scroll past the polls you’re not interested in. After all, your opinion matters. Why not voice it?
— Follow — 
We’ve made it super easy to follow people whose content you care about including friends, influencers, companies, and more. Plus, you can invite your friends to follow you as well, so you’re always caught up on each other’s latest questions and polls.
As always, we encourage you to ask meaningful questions that pertain to your life! Whether you can’t decide what to wear, purchase, sell, or read - or you simply want to garner people’s beliefs about the purpose of life - WhichOne is the place for you. So, what will you ask the world?

bluejetty:00124055:ios.summary: Tower Defense Offline game. Best td game in defence genre. Play this best tower defence strategy game. Great TD among other defence games. Defend using epic and unique towers. This is a tower defence strategy game where your goal is to defe
bluejetty:00124055:ios.description:
Tower Defense Offline game. Best td game in defence genre. Play this best tower defence strategy game. Great TD among other defence games. Defend using epic and unique towers. This is a tower defence strategy game where your goal is to defend your territory by obstructing the enemy attackers by placing defensive structures on their path of attack. In this strategy game player has a space base that must be defended by the player. You have waves of multiple incoming "enemies" that must be defended against. Overall whether you will succeed or not will depend on your ability to strategically place and construct towers in the path of attacking enemies. 
 Highly customizable towers with 5 basic elements and more than 31 sci fi modules making your defence unique. 
Overcome incredible odds and build defence with strategy and wit.
 Download it now and enjoy the most challenging game among best tower defense games. Unparalleled level of depth for defence games. 
 Module Tower Defense features:
 • 80+ levels
 • Customize towers to fit your strategic plan
 • Plan your actions carefully and adapt to the ever changing battlefield as the level 
 transform itself during the battle
 • Vast amount of modular elements that can give your tower additional unique effects 
 such as income or splash or critical strike.
 • Find ultimate combos as Modules can amplify each other’s performance 
 • Enemies have special abilities that can have devastating effect on your defences.
 • Elements give you special bonuses and perks against certain enemies.
 • Change the level layout by building towers on the path of space monsters
 • 3 different skills that can give you yet another way to customize your experience.
 • Beautiful graphics
 • Achievements - Get rewards and show off your superiority making the best 
 combinations possible!
 I personally was playing TD games all my childhood and played through almost every single one. However, when I tried other tower defence games on the market I found that they were way too simple, or just plain boring. Some of what I found were not even tower defense offline games. Selection of towers was too small, they was either easy to build or did not hold enough without donations. Enemies managed to tower rush you in case you play td games free. No matter which tower you got, your tower defence would crush and burn and your castle would fall. 
 So I thought: there should be td games free to play with different options for towers and defences and all the perks of great strategy games. I made this tower defense offline game in hopes that it will give you the depth of old school td game experience on modern devices. Strategy is important here because the resources available to achieve these goals are limited. Strategy here involves setting goals, determining actions to achieve the goals, and mobilizing resources to execute the actions. A strategy describes how the ends (goals) will be achieved by the means (resources). It is a common knowledge that strategy typically involves two major processes: formulation and implementation. Formulation involves analyzing the environment or situation, making a diagnosis, and developing guiding policies. It includes such activities as strategic planning and strategic thinking. Implementation refers to the action plans taken to achieve the goals established by the guiding policy. In this game to succeed you will need to understand both of these processes.
Hope you like it. And if you don’t: leave me a comment so I can make it better. =)
We have got everything that makes great playing experience: tower, best strategy offline elements, sci fi setting. Explore one of the best tower defence offline games out there and unleash the power of the best tower you can build. 
https://www.facebook.com/Module-TD-Sci-Fi-Tower-Defense-2151672478181003/
http://moduletd.com/

bluejetty:00073445:ios.description:
The #1 trusted parking app: Save up to 40% on parking with Honk. Forget waiting at pay stations, digging for change and circling the block trying to find an empty parking spot - use the HonkMobile app the next time you park and save on time, money and parking tickets! 
Using a single account, drivers can pay for parking on their phone at any of the 2,000 locations and 190,000 parking spaces Honk is accepted across Canada and the United States. Whether you’re looking for city, off-street, hospital, school or airport parking, Honk has you covered! 
Just some of the cities you’ll find us in: Corner Brook, Halifax, Montreal, Ottawa, Toronto, Mississauga, Oakville, Whitby, Oshawa, London, Niagara Falls, St. Catharines, Waterloo, Windsor, Thunder Bay, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Calgary, Edmonton, Fort McMurray, Lethbridge, Burnaby, Kelowna, Surrey, Okanagan, Vancouver, Nanaimo, and Victoria.
How It Works:
- Sign up and create a free account using your email or Facebook Connect
- Add your license plate - parking sessions are validated by license plate - store as many as you like!
- Add as many payment methods as you’d like - great way to manage personal and business expenses
- Honk accepts all major credit cards, Visa/Debit, PayPal, MasterPass and ApplePay
- Book parking in real-time or make a reservation for the future
- Click ‘pay’ and get on your way faster!
App Features & Functionality:
- Hourly, daily, weekly and monthly parking options
Mapview of all available parking spots in relation to your destination
- Choose parking spot based on price and proximity
- Park in the same spot for work? Favourite your most frequented parking spot for even quicker and easier access to the spots you use on a regular basis
- Receive text notifications 15 minutes before your session is set to expire 
- Feed the meter directly from your phone - no more running back to beat the meter maid!

bluejetty:00019091:ios.summary: The goal of the game is to take as many tricks as possible and reach a score of 10 or more first. The game is played in pairs. Your partner sits opposite to you and the deals are played clockwise. Each player is dealt five cards and the gam
bluejetty:00019091:ios.description:
The goal of the game is to take as many tricks as possible and reach a score of 10 or more first. The game is played in pairs. Your partner sits opposite to you and the deals are played clockwise. Each player is dealt five cards and the game starts by choosing a card suit.
FEATURES
- advanced AI players
- intuitive interface
- balanced rules
TIPS
- In the first round you can choose the trump suit by choosing the card from the center pile. 
- If the current round passes without choosing the trump a second one follows.
- In the second round you must choose any suit of cards except the one you passed in the round before.
- If the trump is not chosen in these 2 rounds the cards are reshuffled and the game starts again without changing the dealer.
- Once a trump suit is chosen the game can start. 
- If you choose a trump suit in the first round, the card in the center pile is passed to the dealer of the cards.
- If you are the dealer of the cards, your name is marked with an encircled D. If the trump is chosen in the first round you receive the trump card and must shed any card you wish.
- The player next to the dealer in a clock-wise direction is the first to choose a trump suit. 
- If that player passes the chance, the next one after him follows.
- The game is played between two teams: a top-bottom team comprised of you and a computer player and a left-right team of computer players.
- The player and his partner are called the makers if one of them chooses a trump suit. Otherwise they are called the defenders.
- To win the makers must take at least 3 tricks. The defenders in order to win must take at least 3 tricks as well.
- If the makers take 5 tricks they score 2 points. If the defenders take 3 or more tricks they score 2 points.
- If the makers take 3 or 4 tricks they score 1 point. If the makers take less than 3 tricks they score 0 points.
- There is the possibility of playing alone by pressing the -play alone- button when choosing the trump.
- When playing alone the team scores 4 points if the maker takes all 5 tricks. Otherwise if the team takes 3 or 4 tricks it scores only 1 point.
- There is a specific order of the trump cards. The trump Jack is the most valuable card, followed by the Jack of the same-color suit. 
- For example if the trump suit is hearts, the most valuable card is the Jack of hearts followed by the Jack of diamonds.
- These cards are followed by the Ace, the King, the Queen, the 10 and the 9. 
- There are only 24 cards in the deck - 6 from each suit.
- The order of the cards in the other suits is the Ace, the King, the Queen, the Jack, the 10 and the 9.
- The Jack of the same color as the trump suit makes part of the trump suit.
- You can start the trick with any card but you must follow suit or play any other card if you cannot follow suit.
- The trick is won by the player who plays the highest trump or the highest card of the starting suit.
- To win the game you must be the first to score 10 or more points.
- There is a statistics menu in which you can view the total games played, the percentage of won games, the number of rounds played, the number of euchres made.
- If you as a defender take 3 or more tricks then you achieve a euchre.
- If you as a maker take less than 3 tricks then you have been euchred.
- The makers are marked with an M. The player that chose the trump is marked with a bold M.
- The defenders are marked with a D.
Support and Feedback
If you have any technical problems please email us directly at support@gsoftteam.com. Please, don’t leave support problems in our comments – we don’t check those regularly and it will take longer to fix any issues that you might encounter. Thank you for your understanding!

Do you want to know what dog breed you are? If you do, this fun quiz is perfect for you. Answer 10 questions and this test will tell you what dog breed you are!

If you are a fan of personality tests or animals you will love this app. There are a total of 33 different tests to try out!

What are you waiting for? Give the test a try!

Please note this app/game has been developed only for entertainment purposes and has no intention to hurt the user's feelings. The results are not real. The application uses a numerical algorithm to calculate the match and should be used only for fun.

bluejetty:00015488:ios.name: Monster Math : Kids Fun Games
bluejetty:00015488:ios.summary:
Embark on an EPIC math adventure with Monster Math games!
With Monster Math, kids explore exciting new planets, take on missions to save them, and collect cool badges. And the best part? They’re building their math skills while having a bl
bluejetty:00015488:ios.description:
Embark on an EPIC math adventure with Monster Math games!
With Monster Math, kids explore exciting new planets, take on missions to save them, and collect cool badges. And the best part? They’re building their math skills while having a blast playing the game!
Students flag off their journey by creating a profile and diving into a math journey adapted for their grade. Monster Math is designed by educators & grounded in research by Math Fact Fluency Expert Dr. Jennifer Bay-Williams. It sets the stage for kids' educational journey and builds their math facts skill step by step as their young minds explore fun and challenging math planets, mastering one math skill at a time in a fun game based format so immersive that they won’t even realize they are learning math.
With Monster Math, practicing math is nothing like doing worksheets or just recognizing flashcards.Kids take on mini math missions and build confidence as they get better at addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division in a fun and engaging way!
Winner of the Brain Child Award and National Parenting Product Award in 2020!
WHY MONSTER MATH? 
Focus on building Number Sense: Instead of rote memorization only, Monster Math focuses on using visual cues to help kids understand how operations work, learn basic and advanced fact strategies, and in general get very flexible with numbers. 
It’s Engaging: We believe learning should spark joy, be visual, interactive, and fun. That’s why at Monster Math, we create mini math missions that feel like games while helping kids master key concepts!
It’s aligned: Every mission in Monster Math is carefully designed to align with the Core curriculum as well as various state curriculums across the US, ensuring that kids are practicing the right skills at the right time. 
Designed for early elementary Grades: Monster Math covers key math concepts for 1st to 3rd graders, all aligned with Common Core standards.
Stress-Free Learning: No time limits, no penalties, and no distractions, just pure math fun in a safe, ad-free environment!
Play Anytime, Anywhere: Monster Math works offline, so kids can access the app and enjoy learning on the go, anytime and anywhere!
WHAT PARENTS SAY ABOUT MONSTER MATH
“My son has ADHD and loves the game. He is able to sit and play for an extended period of time. Without realizing that he is also learning. I highly recommend this game.” — Justin P’s Mom
“Super excited that we found this one. I think this is the most fine learning apps online” — Areiladas1013
MONSTER MATH FOR PARENTS
Monster Math isn’t just fun, it’s effective! Coming soon: You’ll get clear progress reports and skill breakdowns so you can easily track how your child is improving.
MONSTER MATH FOR TEACHERS
Monster Math is free for teachers. Use it to build Math fact fluency for your students. With student profiles, multiple kids can use the same device and still track their progress independently.
SUBSCRIBE ONCE, LEARN FOREVER
Sign up for a free 7-day trial to explore our learning experience. After the trial, subscribe annually for just $59.99/year.
With one annual subscription, which works across multiple devices, your child unlocks all missions, updates, and future content.
Subscription info:
- Makkajai subscriptions are auto-renewable and annual with a 7-day Free Trial
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at the end of the Free trial
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase
- Cancellation will not go into effect until the end of the monthly billing cycle
For support, questions or comments, write to us at: support@makkajai.com
Our privacy policy can be found at: http://www.makkajai.com/privacy-policy
Our terms of use can be found at: http://www.makkajai.com/terms
Connect with us on Facebook & Instagram

bluejetty:00068292:ios.description:
O Voors, plataforma de gestão estratégica de desenvolvimento de pessoas, é um software web desenvolvido pela Viasoft que também atende no formato de aplicativo.
Com ele, os colaboradores, na empresa ou em trabalho remoto, se mantêm conectados à empresa com segurança da informação e sem distrações dos meios comuns de comunicação através de módulos e funcionalidades capazes de otimizar a rotina de trabalho em diversos aspectos.
Um dos objetivos do Voors é gerenciar a comunicação das empresas, reduzindo interferências e garantindo a integração entre os setores. Dessa maneira, as equipes se mantêm engajadas e motivadas, sem obstáculos para compartilhar conhecimento e serem produtivas. 
O aplicativo é de fácil utilização, pois conta com uma interface amigável e intuitiva.

Restore a forgotten mansion to its former glory – and solve mysteries along the way! Can you uncover the secrets Grandma is hidin
bluejetty:00066438:ios.description:
Welcome to Merge Mansion – the original merge puzzle game with cozy gameplay, epic adventures and high drama!
Restore a forgotten mansion to its former glory – and solve mysteries along the way! Can you uncover the secrets Grandma is hiding and reveal the truth behind the Boulton family’s past?
Unlock spaces and rooms in the garden and mansion by completing fun merge tasks. Collect clues, meet fascinating characters, and piece the story together one mystery at a time.
Relax into this cozy merge puzzle game packed with more twists and turns than Grandma’s knitting.
MATCH & MERGE
Merge matching items to upgrade, and use them to complete tasks. Enjoy the satisfaction of creating and discovering new items and chains!
RENOVATE & DECORATE
Restore the mansion and gardens to their former glory! Collect themed decorations and customize your home as you wish.
INVESTIGATE & SOLVE
Uncover hidden areas and combine clues to find out what secrets Grandma is hiding - how far down the mystery rabbit hole will you go?
EXCLUSIVE EVENTS
Play limited-time events to gain points, climb leaderboards, collect gorgeous decorations, and win big rewards!
Merge Mansion is the number one destination for a cozy mystery puzzle adventure - and it never gets boring! Download this free puzzle merge game and discover its secrets.
——————————
Did you get stuck or run into a problem? Visit our support page in the Merge Mansion app or send us a message at mergemansionsupport@metacoregames.com.
——————————
Merge Mansion is free to download and play. Some in-game items can also be purchased for real money. You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device’s settings. Merge Mansion may offer randomized virtual items for purchase.
Merge Mansion may be updated from time to time for content or technical updates. If you do not install the provided updates, Merge Mansion may not function properly or at all.
