bluejetty:00141051:ios.description:
Play online with friends — anywhere. Every phone in the room joins the same game. No more passing one phone around the table.
Truth or Never is the real-time multiplayer party game for truth, dare, and never-have-i-ever rounds. Create a private room, share a 6-digit code, link, or QR code, and play in seconds. It works across the table and across the country.
WHAT YOU PLAY
• 7 fast rounds of 60 seconds each
• Tap Ever or Never as prompts appear on your screen
• The top scorer picks Truth or Dare in a final showdown, and everyone else votes
• 1000+ questions across 17 packs — a fresh match every time
17 QUESTION PACKS
• Classic — icebreakers for any group
• Social — casual, friends-first prompts
• Festive — holidays, birthdays, gatherings
• Friends Edition — inside jokes and shared history
• Party Mode — high-energy, keep-the-momentum rounds
• Couples / Date Night — fun, heartfelt prompts for two
• Hot Questions — playful topics for grown-ups
• Bold Edition — fun prompts for adventurous groups
• Travel — road trips and long flights
• Food — dinner parties and late-night kitchens
• School — dorms, teams, classmates
• Work — office icebreakers and team offsites
• Tech — for the gadget and internet crowd
• Sports — fan nights and tailgates
• Awkward / Embarrassing — the stories you only tell close friends
• Wild / Outrageous — chaotic, unpredictable rounds
• AI Questions Pack — fresh AI-generated prompts every round
WHY PLAYERS LOVE IT
• Real-time online multiplayer — no other dare or truth-or-dare app has this
• Every player on their own phone — no passing it around
• Join by 6-digit code, shareable link, or QR code
• No account required — open and play
• 34 languages supported in-product
PERFECT FOR
Friends' game nights and sleepovers. Couples on date night, anniversaries, or long-distance calls. Parties, housewarmings, bachelorette nights, dorm hangs, road trips, team offsites, and virtual hangouts.
HOW TO UNLOCK MORE PACKS
Core gameplay is free. Unlock every premium pack with a subscription (weekly $3.99, monthly $5.99, yearly $29.99) or buy a pack one-time for $2.99. You can also unlock select sets by inviting 2 friends — open a match together and the set is yours.
Download Truth or Never and make your next gathering unforgettable.
Privacy Policy: https://site.never-have-i-ever.net
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00183726:ios.description:
Z aplikacją PeoPay masz szybki i wygodny dostęp z poziomu smartfona do swojego konta osobistego i firmowego, kart oraz oszczędności. Zyskujesz dostęp do swoich finansów 24/7 – niezależnie od tego, gdzie jesteś. W aplikacji m.in. sprawdzisz saldo i historię konta bankowego, opłacisz rachunki, skorzystasz z BLIKA, a także złożysz online wniosek o kartę kredytową lub pożyczkę gotówkową. Wszystko to bez wychodzenia z domu! 
Nie jesteś klientem Pekao? Otwórz konto na selfie w PeoPay lub przez mObywatel albo udaj się do oddziału. 
Odkryj z nami zalety bankowości mobilnej!
Co umożliwi Ci aplikacja PeoPay?
• Dostęp do wszystkich produktów w Banku Pekao S.A. oraz ich historii.
• Składanie dyspozycji do Twoich produktów i komunikacja z bankiem w sekcji Twoje sprawy.
• Dostęp do oferty kredytowej, oszczędnościowej i ubezpieczeniowej.
• Dostęp do rachunków w innych bankach.
• Szybkie logowanie i zatwierdzanie operacji biometrycznie (odciskiem palca, FaceID, czyli rozpoznawaniem twarzy) lub PIN-em.
• Przelewy natychmiastowe Express Elixir oraz przelewy Sorbnet.
• Przelewy krajowe i zagraniczne oraz doładowania telefonu.
• Możliwość zakupu biletów MPK oraz biletów parkingowych.
• Automatyczne płatności za przejazdy autostradami krajowymi oraz zakup e-winiet na przejazdy płatnymi drogami zagranicznymi.
• Zarządzanie funkcjami podnoszącymi bezpieczeństwo pieniędzy np. ustawienia limitów, wiadomości push, blokada kanałów dostępu, potwierdzanie w aplikacji logowania do serwisu internetowego.
• Transakcje BLIK (w tym: przelewy na telefon, prośby o przelew, płacenie telefonem w sklepach stacjonarnych oraz internetowych z możliwością skopiowania kodu BLIK do pamięci, internetowe płatności bez konieczności ponownego użycia kodu, wypłaty gotówki z bankomatów i terminali (cashback) z logo BLIK, wpłaty gotówki we wpłatomatach z logo BLIK),płatności w internecie przez skanowanie kodu QR.
• Za Twoją zgodą - dostęp do oferty pożyczki gotówkowej oraz karty kredytowej „na klik”.
• Wymiana walut po preferencyjnych kursach.
• Procentowy lub kwotowy podgląd salda przed zalogowaniem.
• Obsługa rachunku indywidualnego i firmowego w jednej aplikacji.
• Korzystanie z wyszukiwarki w historii operacji, przelew z historii operacji i przelew zwrotny.
• Zarządzanie produktami dziecka dzięki Panelowi rodzica.
• Dostęp do programu rabatowego Okazje z Żubrem i innych bonusów.
• Opcje personalizacji np. możliwość wyboru tła, awatara, ustawienia skrótów i widgetów do ulubionych miejsc w aplikacji. 
Jeszcze więcej funkcji w jedne apce!
• Zakładanie konta oszczędnościowego, osobistego lub walutowego i wnioski o nowe produkty.
• Analiza finansowa z podsumowaniem wydatków z podziałem na kategorie,
• Płatności w internecie bezpośrednio z rachunków walutowych (jak kartą wielowalutową).
• Kalendarz płatności zaplanowanych.
• Sprawdzenie historii operacji kont regularnych funduszy Pekao TFI.
• Dostęp do produktów inwestycyjnych i maklerskich (w tym Giełdy Papierów Wartościowych).
• Zarządzanie kartami debetowymi do rachunków: aktywacja, nadawanie i zmiana PIN, zmiana limitów transakcyjnych, zablokowanie / odblokowanie / zastrzeżenie karty.
W aplikacji możesz zmienić język na angielski lub ukraiński. Więcej informacji znajdziesz na www.pekao.com.pl/peopay.

Managing your Linkt account has never been easier. Open an account, check your balance, view trips, top up your account, download/share statements, add/remove vehicles and set up auto payments, with just a few taps.
Popular features: 
• See your account balance and status instantly. 
• Top up your account quickly and securely.
• Download and share account statements.

• Stay informed: enable notifications to get relevant and timely information about your account.
• Avoid traffic and plan your travel: Get real-time road incident alerts on the Linkt app.
• Choose when and how much to top up using auto pay. 
• Review and search your recent activity in the 'Activity' tab: see trip history details and costs and compare your monthly spend.

• Sold or bought a car? Add and remove vehicles with just a few taps.
• Moved house? Update your personal details instantly. 
• Pay toll notices or toll invoices (selected toll roads only).
Want to know more about Linkt app? Discover all its features and functionality here - linkt.com.au/app
The Linkt app is just one of the many ways we’re working to make your life easier. If you’d like to share your feedback or suggest future features, please email us at mobileapps@linkt.com.au or visit linkt.com.au/app

bluejetty:00180149:ios.summary:
4x4 Off-Road Rally 7 — the off-road game where the road ends and the fun begins!
Grab the wheel of a real 4x4 truck and take on 100+ levels of mud, sand, rocks, rivers and mountain trails. Swamps that swallow wheels, hills that test your n
bluejetty:00180149:ios.description:
4x4 Off-Road Rally 7 — the off-road game where the road ends and the fun begins!
Grab the wheel of a real 4x4 truck and take on 100+ levels of mud, sand, rocks, rivers and mountain trails. Swamps that swallow wheels, hills that test your nerves, river crossings where one wrong move means a restart — this is off-road driving the way it should be: dirty, tricky and addictive.
WHAT'S WAITING FOR YOU
• 100+ hand-made off-road levels: forest, desert, mountains, night rides and river fords
• 10 SUVs and trucks to unlock — from a compact crossover to a monster truck
• Realistic physics: every rock, rut and puddle is felt through the wheel
• Your helper Jack teaches you to drive and cheers you on at every level
• Competitions: drag races, tug-of-war and races against AI
• Online drag races against real players — who's faster off the line?
• Cargo missions: bring the load to the finish without losing it
• Easy touch controls: steering wheel or buttons, gas, brake, handbrake and nitro
• Day, night, rain and fog
• 8 languages
HOW TO PLAY
Pick your ride, choose a level and reach the finish. Watch your speed on the hills, don't drown in the river, keep the cargo in the truck bed and hit every checkpoint. Earn cash for each finish, buy new cars and go back to beat your own time.
WHO IS IT FOR
For everyone who loves off-road games, 4x4 truck simulators, hill climb and mud racing. Five minutes at the bus stop or a whole evening on the couch — the next level is always waiting.
Plays offline (online races need an Internet connection).
Buckle up. The road is over — the real driving starts now!

bluejetty:00114457:ios.description:
It’s time to embark on an exciting matching adventure like never before in Shop Sorting : Goods puzzle! Your job is to sort multiple goods from fruits to cute animals and organize all your shelves properly to clear all of them and become a Shopper master!
If you are looking for a new way to relax and discover how additive it could be to sort and match hundreds of good! Then, this Shop Sorting puzzle game is for you. It combines triple-match gameplay, strategic sorting games, matching goods, and engaging puzzle elements. 
How to play:
- Drag and rearrange adjacent goods to create matches of 3.
- Collect 3 identical items to clear them
- Use powerful boosters strategically to manage more difficult sorting games or to freeze time
- Complete objectives to progress through the game & unlock new fun levels
Main features:
- Challenging Sorting Gameplay: Dive into a world of HD goods and engage in addictive sorting puzzles. 
- Discover hundreds of beautiful goods hand drawn by our team of artists. 
- Engaging Levels: We have created many different situations with great features so you will never get bored while playing this free matching Goods game.
- Amazing monthly events: Travel the world with us and play with unique goods while collecting unique postcards! 
- A truly relaxing, stress free experience: No time limit, no stress. 
Time to challenge yourself with this unique Match 3 gameplay of Goods fun! You won’t regret your puzzle journey with us!

bluejetty:00047718:ios.description:
Drive a selection of Awesome Vehicles, from Sedans through Sports Cars, Buses to even the most outlandish ones – a Tow Truck, a Fuel Tanker Truck and more! Explore a realistic Gas Station and the environment beyond!
GAME FEATURES:
▶ MASSIVE GARAGE: Now with 6 new vehicles up to a total of 13!
▶ MULTIPLE MISSIONS: Drive, fill up the tank, tow other cars & park in 60 exciting missions (30 brand new!)
▶ GAS IT: See how fast can you complete all the challenges and earn stars for your progress!
▶ FREE TO PLAY: All the way through, no strings attached!
Developed with fans of realistic driving and authentic car experiences in mind, Gas Station offers a unique opportunity to test your driving skills in a bunch of exciting vehicles! Variety is the name of the game here, as the cars vary in not only appearance, but – more importantly – in their performance and the way they handle!
Sit behind the wheel of a trusty Sedan, which after a few missions you will switch for a nimble 4x4! Don’t get too attached to it – new missions and challenges come fast and furiously, don’t leaving you much time to get overly confident or – more importantly – bored.
In addition to driving you will accomplish other diverse and exciting tasks. How will you your approach to steering the car change with a heavy trailer attached? Will you be able to fit a long, heavy, unwieldy bus into narrow parking spots at the gas station? Do you have what it takes to assist other drivers that need help?
Enter our Gas Station and let it surprise and excite you! Find new ways of driving and appreciating amazing the automobiles in all their glory!

bluejetty:00185836:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00185836:ios.description:
+++ Over 50 million players worldwide +++ 
+++ Number 1 in the games charts for iPad & iPhone in 89 countries +++
+++ SlopeMania add-on with 24 brand new levels, sloping roads and an explosive tank truck +++
+++ Trains add-on with 18 new, beautiful levels and two trains as vehicles +++
In Bridge Constructor you have to prove yourself as an accomplished master bridge builder. Play 40 different levels, and build bridges over deep valleys, canals, and rivers. Stress tests reveal whether the bridge you build can withstand the daily stress of continual use from cars, trucks and, more recently, super-heavy tank trucks.
You can choose from a range of materials for each individual bridge, such as wood, steel, cables, or concrete pillars. Use the appropriate materials and stay within budget to build the perfect bridge. The choice of different materials means that there are numerous solutions and approaches and you can build each bridge in any number of ways – your budget is the only limit. The refined grid system allows you to realise your idea of the perfect bridge with even more precision. Let your imagination and creativity run free! And if you happen to run into a dead end, you can pick up valuable tips from the brand new help system! 
Awesome Add-Ons: SlopeMania & Trains
In the SlopeMania add-on you find yourself on the Tiltin Islands, home to three brand new islands where you'll even be building your bridges inside colorful grottoes! The 24 tricky, never-before-seen levels will have you using sloping lanes to overcome the massive height differences. The "Crazy Levels" are the real brainteasers and require out-of-the-box thinking and unusual solutions. 
Purchase the Trains add-on and get the Choonited Kingdom island group, with a total of 18 new levels across three islands. Build massive bridges that can withstand the enormous weight of the two new vehicles on offer – a commuter train and a heavily loaded freight train. The idyllic and beautifully designed landscapes will make the heart of every railroad fanatic skip a beat.
"Trains" and "SlopeMania" are now available at an affordable price as an in-app purchase!
FEATURES:
• 40 Levels on the island nation of Camatuga
• Free build mode and help system
• 5 Settings: city, canyon, beach, mountains, hills
• Improved grid system 
• Map with unlocked worlds/levels
• 4 different building materials: wood, steel, cables, concrete pillars
• Color coded load indicator for different building materials
• Three different load bearing levels: car, truck and tank truck
• High score per level
• Facebook connection (upload screenshots and bridge scores)
FEATURES SlopeMania Add-On
• Completely new Tiltin Islands
• Option to build sloping roads – even for Camatuga
• Additional "Grotto" setting
• 24 "sloping" levels inc. especially tricky "Crazy Levels"
• Explosive tank truck as an exciting new vehicle
FEATURES Trains Add-On
• Open up 3 new islands with 18 new levels.
• Build bridges for modern commuter trains and heavy freight trains!
• New scenery: Enjoy the view of picturesque mountains and ravines!
OS 7 or higher required

bluejetty:00095086:ios.description:
Get Ready to Rumble with Your Most Annoying Relative in the Hilariously Chaotic "Punch Feast"!
Ever wanted to unleash a flurry of perfectly (or imperfectly) aimed punches on that one uncle who always tells the same bad jokes, steals the last slice of pizza, or insists on giving unsolicited life advice? Well, now's your chance! Step into the absurdly entertaining world of "Punch Feast," the funny fighting game where you can finally settle those familial squabbles in the most over-the-top and hilarious way imaginable.
Prepare for a punching game experience unlike any other, powered by delightfully wonky ragdoll physics. Watch in glee as your uncle stumbles, wobbles, and hilariously collapses under the weight of your expertly (or not-so-expertly) thrown fists. This isn't your typical serious fighting game; it's a wacky game designed for pure, unadulterated comedic relief.
Whether you're looking for a quick burst of stress relief after a long day or just want to indulge in some silly game antics, "Punch Feast" delivers. With intuitive controls, you can unleash a variety of hit game maneuvers, from gentle jabs to powerful haymakers. Discover special power punches and maybe even unlock some surprising punch abilities to truly dominate your annoying relative in the most comical fashion.
Engage in side-splitting scenarios and environments that amplify the comedy game experience. From chaotic family barbecues to awkward holiday gatherings, each setting provides the perfect backdrop for your hilarious fisticuffs. Master the art of the slap game if you prefer a more open-handed approach, or stick to classic punching to show that annoying hit master who's boss (in a completely lighthearted and virtual way, of course!).
"Punch Feast" offers:
Hilarious Ragdoll Physics: Witness the comical consequences of every punch and slap.
Intuitive Controls: Easy to pick up and play, perfect for casual gamers.
A Cast of Annoying Uncles (and maybe more!): Face off against a variety of uniquely irritating relatives.
Variety of Punches and Abilities: Discover and unlock special moves to enhance your punching prowess.
Humorous Environments: Engage in chaotic brawls in familiar, funny settings.
Perfect for Stress Relief: Blow off steam in a lighthearted and entertaining way.
A Unique Take on the Fighting Genre: This isn't about complex combos; it's about fun and laughter.

bluejetty:00186733:ios.description:
Dogo App is one of the most downloaded dog training apps, with more than 10 million parents and their 11 million happy dogs. 
Our dog training app has been chosen as one of Apple’s “Ones to Watch” apps, which, according to the editors, “are a benchmark in their respective categories for a reason.”
Dogo App received the app of the year award as well as the app of the day.
Dogo helps dog parents to train their dogs at home and build stronger relationships. 
Dogo is revolutionizing the way people raise and train their dogs. The app offers professionally tailored programs for dog parents that are curated by experienced dog trainers and veterinarians. Users can also exchange their experiences with other dog parents and share videos and pictures of their pets. Your smart pet will learn obedience. 
WITH DOGO APP YOU CAN
▶ CHOOSE what to teach your pup from the library of 100+ dog tricks with video instructions.
▶ ASK HELP of professional dog trainers. 
▶ SEND a video exam to the Dogo trainer and get feedback on your puppy’s performance. 
▶ USE our built-in dog clicker and whistle to mark a behavior, precise moment for which your doggo is rewarded, and reduce puppy training time. 
▶ READ our knowledge-based articles about dog obedience training, puppy behavior, nutrition, or health.
▶ PARTICIPATE in a weekly photo challenge: share photos with the Dogo community, vote for other puppers, connect with dog parents from around the world.
▶ PASS personalized training programs for your puppy.
WHY USE DOGO APP?
▶ TRAIN a dog or puppy: teach important skills.
▶ SOLVE behavior issues: say goodbye to barking, chewing, biting, and etc.
▶ TRY 100+ guided dog training courses, tricks, commands, games & exercises.
▶ WATCH Step-by-step video instruction for every training exercise.
▶ USE daily personalized training recommendations.
▶ SET reminders for your pup's potty and training schedules.
▶ TRACK & monitor your pup's training progress.
▶ STRENGTHEN Your Friendship. Bond with your best friend.
ABOUT Dogo App
Dogo App is a training app for dog parents. It includes all the necessary commands, different whistle sounds, and the possibility to create an individual schedule for your pet. 
We have 12 programs to choose from (New Dog Puppy Program, Dog Parenting 101, Stop Dog Jumping, Potty Training, Stop Dog Biting and Chewing, Home Alone, Leash Walking, Perfect Recall, Sit-Down-Stay and Trick Training). Get 100+ exclusive guided videos for all essential skills and behaviors (reliable recall, leash training, sitting, come, down, stay, puppy potty training, welcoming a new adopt pet, puppy games, house training, fetch the leash, stopping puppy biting, not jumping on people, separation anxiety, dog bark control and stop, dog voice and noise control, tail wag, calm around other dogs, staying on a place, loose-leash walking, impulse control, high-five, give a paw, rollover, peekaboo, spin, weave, jump over, crawl and much more), learn tricks, play games and enjoy the dog life with your pooch.
All you need to socialize, train, and bond with your dog are now on one app.
DOGO SUBSCRIPTION
You can try Dogo for 7-day with a free trial. After the free trial period ends, you will need to subscribe to Dogo.
You can subscribe to Dogo by choosing from the following plans:
– 1 month
– 12 months
The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Terms & Privacy
https://dogo.app/terms-of-service/ 
https://dogo.app/privacy/
EULA
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00186523:ios.summary: The KING Ground School Companion App enables you to download and take video lessons from any of our award winning online Ground School and Test Prep courses, Checkride courses and Single-Subject Flying courses -- anywhere, anytime. Even whe
bluejetty:00186523:ios.description:
The KING Ground School Companion App enables you to download and take video lessons from any of our award winning online Ground School and Test Prep courses, Checkride courses and Single-Subject Flying courses -- anywhere, anytime. Even when not connected to the Internet! Your course progress will automatically sync to your online course the next time your device is connected to the internet.
The Ground School Companion App even lets you take the quizzes that follow each video lesson from our Interactive Video Ground School and Test Prep courses—right on your device.
King Schools produces home-study courses used in preparation for FAA (The aviation authority in the United States) exams, overcome flying hurdles and meet mandatory flight training requirements. Whether you are studying for Sport Pilot, Private Pilot, Instrument Rating, Commercial Pilot, Flight Instructor (CFI), Multi-Engine or Airline Transport Pilot (ATP); King Schools has a course just for you.
King Schools courses are specifically designed to efficiently give you the vital flying knowledge you'll use for the rest of your flying career.
Born from a Passion for Flying
King Schools, Inc. is the world's leading producer of aviation training videos and computer software. KING was first established in 1974, when John and Martha began flying throughout the country to teach ground school courses.
Today, King Schools has over 50 employees operating from an 18,000 sq. ft. complex, housing a dedicated video production facility. In the past 10 years we have delivered more than 4 million hours of video instruction, teaching up to one-third of all pilots in the U.S. obtaining training.
We are keenly aware of the importance of the work we do. During the time someone is learning to fly, flying is the most important thing in his or her life. We are privileged to play such a significant role in the lives of such committed individuals. We take pride in producing quality work for these special people.

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION
Stop carrying heavy city tours guide in your pocket. TRAVEL LIGHT!!!
With this Travel Guide you have a full city guide in your iPhone & iPod Touch.
This tourist guide is built to be used offline. No connection to Internet required, meaning no extra charges in your phone bill!!
AUGMENTED REALITY, unlike other tourist guides you will be able to discover the city with the best iPhone tool - AR - Just click on the AR button, turn yourself 360° and view on the screen where the best spots are and how to find them. You can also scroll up and down to view the closest and furthest attraction. Slide through the tutorial for more tips. 
After many requests, we bring to you your own steps with a GPS feature. Do not get lost, just take a look where you are standing.
It is a very practical city guide since it is designed to be used by itineraries. There are 4 different itineraries for the city depending on the duration of your journey. We also provide tips and advices to travelers, how to get into the city, how to move around, where to shop, where to go at night, most popular places, safety tips, etc...
Unlike other guides, this Travel Guide provides you with interactive zoomable OFFLINE MAPS (x6 zoom + GPS capable) of the region showing the attractions, public bus stops, restaurants, pubs, hotels, hospitals and many other useful points of interest. You cannot get lost!. With this guide, you will not only visit the city but also move around its region.
The travel guide is made based on travelers advices. Unlike other city guides, we can guarantee we have already visited these places and would like to give you a fancy and practical tool to make your visit a more enjoyable one.
This app contains IAPs for you to enjoy and discover the best out of your visit.

bluejetty:00114803:ios.summary:

Now include
bluejetty:00114803:ios.description:
Imposter Game is the offline party word new game that turns any group into a social showdown.
One player is the imposter. Everyone else sees the secret word. Your goal is simple: blend in, say a clue, and avoid getting exposed.
Now include over 20+ categories, 500+ words, custom category creation, and the best part, Limited Time Trending Categories.
How to play
1. Open the app. No accounts, no setup.
2. The app shows everyone the secret word except the imposter.
3. Each player says one word related to the topic.
4. Discuss, accuse, and vote out the imposter.
5. Reveal. Were you fooled or did you catch the imposter?
Game Modes
• Imposter Mode
The original gameplay. One imposter, one secret word, one chance to blend in.
• Mafia Mode
A bonus mode inspired by the classic mafia party game. Instead of clues and guessing a word, players vote to eliminate suspects round by round. The goal is to identify the mafia player before they remove everyone else. Faster, more chaotic, and even more debate.
• Crazy Mode
Number of imposters or mafias are choosen at random every game. No one knows who's not to be trusted and how many are they. Create chaos, fun & memorable moments in this offline game mode. Exclusive to Party+
Why players choose Imposter Game
• Works offline in any location
• Perfect for parties, game nights, or date nights
• Fast rounds and easy to learn
• Can be played with friends, family, or coworkers
• Designed for two to ten players
Unlike other party games, Imposter Game focuses on conversation and bluffing instead of instructions or tapping through screens. The more convincing you sound, the longer you survive. If you are not the imposter, listen for hesitation, strange clues, or anything that feels off. If you are the imposter, play it cool and make your clues believable.
Start your first round and see who in your group is the best liar, the best detective, or the player who always slips up.
Download Imposter Game and play anywhere, anytime. Offline. Simple. Unpredictable.
Subscription and in-app purchase Imposter Game offers an optional recurring subscription called Party+ (via In App Purchase). Subscribers unlock all categories, gain full access to the complete content library, play custom created categories (like Stranger Things), view all metrics & game stats (versus only two in free version), unlock crazy mode for imposter and mafia, unlock narrator picking for mafia.
FREE 3 day trial is available!

Welcome to the Official App for your CPL club – Centre Circle, the best way for passionate Canadian soccer fans to connect with their Canadian Premier League clubs. Centre Circle is poised to connect Canadian soccer fans from coast-to-coast.
Centre Circle delivers exclusive access to content including app-exclusive news and updates, earning rewards points for participating in app activity, contests and prizing! Unlock a tailored and personalized content experience that is unique to your club and preferences. Whether it’s watching, reading or listening, fans will earn redeemable points on almost everything they do, allowing the CPL's biggest supporters to claim prizes, experiences and more 24 hours a day, seven days a week, 365 days a year, enhancing fans’ gameday and non-game day experiences.
About Centre Circle
It’s not “just a game.”
It’s an obsession that’s about more than any player, club or coach; More than wins or losses; more than any result. Soccer connects us in ways that, at times, evoke emotions that bind us forever. They’re connections often forged at the end of matches, when a referee’s whistle pierces the air above an outstretched arm pointing back at the Centre Circle, where it all began.
The Centre Circle is where anticipation builds; It’s a focal point before every match and an entry point into an experience that stretches far beyond 90 minutes. 
The Centre Circle app connects all our clubs to one central point, the veins of our communities that meet to form our passionate heart.
It’s the best way to experience the Canadian game.

bluejetty:00148701:ios.description:
Designed to help you monitor your health needs, and track trends over time! Monitoring blood pressure at home is an important tool to help both you and your Doctor understand your real blood pressure levels to ensure your Hypertension is controlled.
Using the MediLink App with your Bluetooth enabled BIOS monitor, you can accurately and efficiently calculate blood pressure averages that provide key insights into your heart health.
Automatically transfer blood pressure readings from your device, or manually enter your values.
The Swipe Averaging feature allows you to quickly grasp a selection of dates, to provide you with specific health data.
Coming soon! Growing with our line of Diagnostics products, the MediLink App will soon be your go to hub to monitor not only Blood Pressure, but temperatures from both fever and basal thermometers, pulse and SpO2 levels from Pulse Oximeters, health and wellness information from bathroom scales, and fitness information from exercise watches! Stay tuned for updates coming soon!
Privacy & Security:
The MediLink App requires users to create an account using an email address and password. This account allows you to replace your device, use multiple devices, provide data to your healthcare provider, or reset your password if needed. We take your security very seriously. Data transmission is encrypted for additional security.
Medical Disclaimer:
The MediLink App is not intended to diagnose or screen for Hypertension, AFIB, or other health conditions. This App is intended as an information management system that enables the analysis of blood pressure readings. It is not intended to be a substitute for the advice of a registered health care professional. Always consult your doctor if you have any health questions or concerns.

bluejetty:00157257:ios.name: UserLock Push
bluejetty:00157257:ios.summary:
UserLock Push works with UserLock’s two-factor authentication solution to verify Active Directory user identities and secure their access to both on-premise and cloud resources.
UserLock Push can also work with other services that require
bluejetty:00157257:ios.description:
UserLock Push works with UserLock’s two-factor authentication solution to verify Active Directory user identities and secure their access to both on-premise and cloud resources.
UserLock Push can also work with other services that require two-factor authentication passcodes, such as Gmail and Facebook. 
• How the app works
After entering your Active Directory login credentials, UserLock Push gives you two easy options for two-factor authentication:
1. One-Tap: Simply respond to the application’s push notification for easy, one-tap two-factor authentication, or
2. Enter the TOTP code generated by the app. 
The app shows the location, device, and time of the login attempt to help ensure you approve the correct request. 
To get a passcode for other applications and web services, enter your login credentials and then go to UserLock Push to recover the TOTP code generated by the app.
• Self-enrollment with UserLock Push
Before enrolling with UserLock Push, your organization needs to enable UserLock and activate your account. Once this is done:
1. Install UserLock Push on your smartphone
2. Scan the QR code displayed at login
3. Enter the code generated by the app to confirm activation
4. UserLock Push is now configured as a second authentication method on your Active Directory account
You can add third party accounts at any time for OTP passcodes.

bluejetty:00179206:ios.name: Trash Tycoon: idle simulator
bluejetty:00179206:ios.summary: Are you dreaming of being rich and famous all around the world? Do you want to make billions of dollars and build your own Empire as a real magnate? Then you’ll definitely like the Trash Tycoon game! You’ll become the Savior of our planet,
bluejetty:00179206:ios.description:
Are you dreaming of being rich and famous all around the world? Do you want to make billions of dollars and build your own Empire as a real magnate? Then you’ll definitely like the Trash Tycoon game! You’ll become the Savior of our planet, besides the fact that you’ll make a lot of money by selling garbage. And your success will make other people reflect on the environmental problems around them — save the ecology, protect nature, forests, and fields. 
In Trash Tycoon idle clicker, you will build objects for reprocessing all types of rubbish. Develop your idle factories, compactors, and containers, construct equipment for compressing trash into garbage cubes for further sale. Oddly enough, many people are involved in this scavenger hunt and want to use rubbish after recycling. The environmental activists will definitely thank you.
You’ll have an opportunity to clean up all the dirtiest places on our planet: the city of Varanasi, the Mediterranean Sea, the volcano Vesuvius, the Grand Canyon, the Samsun coast, the Rub al Khali desert, the Mendenhall glacier, the Amazon jungle, the savanna of Africa and the forests of Russia. Clearing all these places of trash is such a troublesome business, but you can earn cash on it and become a real Trash Tycoon.
Prehistory:
You inherited an abandoned landfill from your grandpa somewhere on the outskirts of your hometown. At the landfill, you will meet a binman - your grandfather's assistant who has been recycling garbage for many years so far. Start earning your first coins using an old rusty manual compactor. And then the story can go in different ways, and only you choose the path.
How to play:
It is easy to play in the Trash Tycoon simulator. To compress your first garbage cube, you just need to click on the compactor. The faster you click, the more trash you get. And gradually you will be able to build an enormous Trash Empire! After compressing the first batch of garbage, it's time to sell it on the stock exchange. Watch the quotes to choose the best moment to salvage a big score.
Once you get that taste and upgrade your compactor and container — move to a higher level to discover new horizons. Start clearing out the dirtiest places on our planet. And in case you get bored — this Trash2Cash simulator game has lots of exciting branches. For instance, you can carry out archaeological excavations in the mine, explore and invent new equipment in the Laboratory, make details to upgrade compactors in the Forge, fight for the best lots with a lot of cash in the Auction and much more. But the main offshoot will be the Racing World — the Garbage Truck Races, to be exact. You will be able to collect your first racing truck from trash and rush into the elite of this scavenger sports world.
Features:
• the Trash Tycoon game does not require a permanent Internet connection;
• you can play this ecoclicker with one hand, so it won’t be difficult to play in the subway, on the bus, or even in the toilet;
• some trash will be collected offline, meanwhile, you are not playing the game;
• the Trash Tycoon simulator game does not have annoying ads (an ecoclicker should lack obnoxious ads, don’t you think so?);
A small life hack from the developer: log in to the Trash Tycoon game several times a day to speed up your journey from trash to cash. This way you’ll succeed faster, Idle Tycoon. Forward to the eco-adventure!

Chinese learner all encounter the same problem: How to write Chinese characters?
You probably think learning how to write in Chinese is impossible.And I get it. I’m a native English speaker, and I know how complex Chinese characters seem.
But you’re about to learn that it’s not impossible.
All you need to know is a black magic – Chinese Stroke Order.
What is Chinese Stroke Order?
Strokes are the classified set of line patterns that are arranged and combined to form Chinese characters.Once you’ve mastered the strokes and learned the logic behind the radicals, learning Chinese writing will become a lot easier.
Why Chinese Stroke Order is so hard to learn?
Learning Chinese Strokes Order can be a bit scary and seems impossible at the first glance.
They just seem like scary blocks of words if you don’t know the idea of how they were formed. Before you start learning Chinese writing, you need to know the Chinese writing system first.
Chinese learners are all struggle with writing Chinese characters. It is very different from writing English, all you need to do is write every letter on the same line and space them well, you than have nice clean readable words. But Chinese characters are a lot more difficult and more complicated. Each character can be separated in to different little sections, and putting them together in a structure is not an easy task. Stroke order can help you structure the Chinese character in a more systematic way, it also help you to learn Chinese better.
What’s the best way to overcome this difficult and how to master it?
Don's waste money to buy many books and apps to learn how to write Chinese characters, none of them actually help me improve your skill, until you find this amazing app – Chinese Strokes Order! You can write Chinese characters so much easier and faster!
Why this app extreme help?
Chinese Strokes Order is the easy way to learn Chinese writing and calligraphy. Learn not only to write and recognize Chinese characters, but also to understand their meaning.
How you can make use of it?
All you have to do is simply type in a Chinese character and let the app show you its animated stroke order instantly.
You can easily change the stroke speed in the app’s settings if you find it hard to keep up, as well. It helps a lot for calligraphy and visualize stroke order.
Understand Chinese calligraphy
Extremely simple, efficient, and easy to use, it is sure to help you understand Chinese calligraphy and its meaning.
In addition, Chinese Strokes Order supports both simplified and traditional Chinese! The simple way to learn Chinese words and characters!

bluejetty:00063490:ios.name: Hearts of Space
bluejetty:00063490:ios.summary: HEARTS of SPACE is the original, premier national showcase for ambient, contemplative, and space-creating music. Listeners describe the show as 'addictive,' 'essential,' and ‘sublime’—a consistently high-quality experience with refined, emo
bluejetty:00063490:ios.description:
HEARTS of SPACE is the original, premier national showcase for ambient, contemplative, and space-creating music. Listeners describe the show as 'addictive,' 'essential,' and ‘sublime’—a consistently high-quality experience with refined, emotionally significant music that goes far beyond simple relaxation.
The 4th generation Hearts of Space mobile app offers iPhone/iPad/iPod Touch users free, anytime access to our new shows up to 4 times each week. Shows change and the free play allotment resets on Fridays around midnight Pacific Time. 
New in-app SETTINGS allow you to customize your experience. You can browse and SEARCH the entire Hearts of Space collection of programs and albums within the app and make and edit personal PLAYLISTS and FAVORITES (now a 3-star rating that also allows you to block any program you don’t want to hear). Apps offer glitchless audio “backgrounding,” Bluetooth and AirPlay support, and up to 256 kBps streaming in the high-quality AAC format. 
SUBSCRIBERS gain higher levels of access, choice and interactivity. One subscription works on all your mobile devices and all but prehistoric laptops and desktops. For a seamless musical experience, subscribers can turn voiceovers off, and use interactive stream navigation, a sleep timer, and auto-repeat.
OUR SERVICE PLANS
• FULL SERVICE—provides maximum access, choice, and interactivity, and is ideal for continuous background music. You can SEARCH and enjoy unlimited plays of the entire Hearts of Space universe of music: ~1,400 PROGRAMS, 150+ classic ALBUMS, 11 continuous interactive CHANNELS, THIS WEEK’s show, PLAYLISTS and FAVORITES on the web site and within the app, and our random program select feature SURPRISE ME.
• STANDARD SERVICE—is a budget-conscious choice for continuous background music and direct access to 133 programs, with slightly less interactivity. Includes unlimited play of THIS WEEK’s program and 11 continuous, interactive CHANNELS—9 genre-based, 1 “RECENT” channel featuring the 12 newest programs, and 1 eclectic "ALL ARCHIVE” channel that draws on the entire collection.
• BASIC SERVICE—gives you unlimited play of THIS WEEK’s show during the week it’s featured, and an auto-repeat function, plus the ability to browse and sample everything.
ABOUT HEARTS of SPACE
Beginning as a pioneering late night radio show in the San Francisco Bay area in 1973, the program continues to offer "slow music for fast times." Hearts of Space evolved its own unique format — a calm, space-creating mix of ambient, electronic, world, new age, classical, contemplative, and experimental music from many eras and cultures. The breadth and depth of this musical focus is the secret of our longevity. A weekly one-hour show was nationally syndicated on the NPR network starting in 1983 and has been heard by millions of radio listeners ever since.
In 2001, we were one of the first independent music producers to offer an online streaming service. While we continue to serve our radio network, our main focus today is our web site and mobile apps.
WANT TO TRY IT? Download our free app, create your free account, or sign in with your existing account and subscription and experience the sublime world of Hearts of Space.
Terms & Conditions
https://v4.hos.com/pages/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00015576:ios.name: Piano Ear Training
bluejetty:00015576:ios.summary:
• Suitable for beginners to advanced musicians with all the essential ear training exercises in various levels. 
• Quickly develop aural skills by personalising your training by focusing on specific chords, intervals, progressions, scales e
bluejetty:00015576:ios.description:
• Suitable for beginners to advanced musicians with all the essential ear training exercises in various levels. 
• Quickly develop aural skills by personalising your training by focusing on specific chords, intervals, progressions, scales etc.
• Track progress as you improve efficiently in each ear training discipline.
• A simple intuitive design enables you quickly enjoy ear training and follow the help and tutorials to get most out of the ear trainer. 
• Configurable piano which strongly aids connection between visual and aural skills and musical instruments.
• Most popular and extensive ear training with over 1 millions users.
• Highly recommended by professional and student musicians in top musical schools contributing to the design for their own use.
• Ideal for all musicians as you can easily change the instrument sounds.
Exercises:
***** interval training *****
Being able to determine intervals between notes in the key skill to playing by ear.
Challenge your expertise by changing the base note or playing the notes together.
This is made easy as it associates an interval with a well known song. 
***** chord distinction *****
Can you distinguish between a Major from a Minor chord for example?
There are 100s of chords to differentiate.
You can help your understanding by selecting arpeggio mode to aid chord distinction and selecting highlight to visualise the construction of the chords.
You can challenge yourself by changing the key of the chord.
Work your way quickly and steadily through the levels.
Another exercise to help you fully understand musical theory and composition.
***** higher lower *****
Given 2 notes, can you identify whether the second note is higher or lower in pitch than the first note? 
Musicians can train their ears to recognise different pitches.
Whilst this is a beginners exercise, you can challenge yourself by reducing the range of the 2 notes played.
***** pitch training *****
After hearing a pitch, can you accurately play that same pitch on the piano? 
This exercise allows your to zoom in on the note using relative pitch skills, and will record how many notes it takes for you to correctly identify. You can easily adjust the difficult by setting a time interval between listening and playing.
***** interval comparison *****
Given 2 intervals, can you determine whether the second interval is wider or narrower in distance?
***** pitch identification *****
A popular test that comes up in music grade aural exams. Given a chord can you identify a specific note/pitch within it? For example, given a C Major chord, can you find the highest note?
***** melodic dictation *****
Listen to a melody and then play it back on the piano. You can make it easier by adjusting the speed and focusing on a few notes at a time.
***** chord progression *****
Can you distinguish a I - IV - V - I progression from a I - V- IV - I? Contains all the most common chord progressions which you will find in nearly all the most popular songs.
***** scale identification *****
Listen to a scale and can you then identify it as a Major scale, Harmonic Minor or Natural Minor for example?
***** absolute pitch *****
Given the same note played at different octaves, can you identify its pitch?
Includes a Learning mode to imprint the pitches into the brain.

bluejetty:00099885:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of Archery Champ: Arrow & Bow, the most realistic and feature-packed 3D archery game. This is a game of skill, precision, and strategy.
An Authentic Archery Simulation:
The game features a realistic physics engine that simulates the feel of drawing a bow and releasing an arrow. Players will find a rewarding experience that is both intuitive for beginners and challenging for seasoned archers.
Key Features:
* Realistic Archery Physics: Experience the satisfaction of a well-aimed shot with a physics engine that mirrors real-life archery.
* Multiple Game Modes: Engage in competitive PvP multiplayer matches, or enjoy a variety of offline challenges. The goal is to climb the ranks and be recognized as a top archer.
* Stunning 3D Graphics: The game offers beautifully designed environments, from serene forests to grand arenas, for an immersive experience.
* Extensive Customization: A wide variety of bows, arrows, and equipment is available to unlock and upgrade, allowing for a personalized gameplay style.
Archery Champ: Arrow & Bow offers a comprehensive archery experience, with options for both offline play and intense multiplayer competition.

bluejetty:00144060:ios.description:
Manzana Verde - Healthy meal subscription to eat better with free delivery and nutritional advice. Start saving time today and eat delicious food.
Manzana Verde is an APP that helps you meet your goals. Whether it’s losing weight, gaining weight or just eating better. We have personalized plans with home delivery starting at S/.13.90 per day in Peru, $89 per day in Mexico and $13,900 per day in Colombia.
Personalized subscriptions, you can add lunch, dinner, snacks, saladas, drinks and much more. We invite you to try one of our delicious and healthy lunches, so that you live the Manzana Verde experience. Creating your own plan is easy, it will only take you 5 minutes. 
Save time with our monthly meal and drinks plans ¡you won’t have to cook again!
Manzana Verde’s own exclusive delivery brings to your home or office delicious, healthy meals that we cook daily for you. Our chefs prepare succulent fresh food and drinks with a select variety of ingredients so you keep a healthy diet. Your food will be handled with the care you deserve, for you to sit in front of a meal that delights all the senses and helps you positively transform your eating habits.
All our dishes take into account nutrition and taste. They are designed by expert nutritionists. In this way, our brilliant chefs prepare exclusive meals that offer you healthy nutritional food every day of the week; with free and exclusive delivery. Reduce weight or gain muscle mass without risking your health and without going hungry. Meet your nutritional coach now!
Manzana Verde creates for you personalized monthly subscriptions, which takes into account the most relevant details to provide you with appropriate meals to your nutritional requirements and physical activity; and also satisfy your palate completely. The subscriptions that Manzana Verde develops are based on your current size and the nutritional or physical goal you want to achieve. This allows us to provide you and each of our 1,500+ users with the care and attention that you would receive from a particular nutritionist, for a lower investment and without having to cook! Our delivery does not entrust third parties with the handling and transportation of your meals, our associated delivery partners bring to your home or workplace healthy meals; with a strict protocol, to maintain the freshness and presentation of our tasty dishes.
Delicious and healthy food at your door
Choose from a variety of more than 200 dishes. We change our menu every week so that healthy eating is delicious and simple for you.
Our healthy food is well-balanced. We measure the amount of calories, carbs, fats and proteins that your body needs so you can meet your goal.
Eco friendly packaging
Our packages are made from sugar cane, ideal for heating food without complications and taking care of the environment.
Free healthy recipes
Find recipes by our nutritionists and chefs, who seek to encourage you to prepare one of our various dishes.
New:
Weekly exercise routines, 3 times a week to help you achieve your goal.
Aerobic routines to accelerate your fat burning process.
Healthy nutrition courses and access to health webinars and talks.
If you are looking to change your eating habits for the better, losing weight, eating better and increasing your muscle mass, we are the reliable solution. If you live in Lima, Piura, CDMX, Guadalajara, Monterrey or Bogota we are the best healthy food delivery for you, cooked with love.

The essential heart and respiratory rate tool for clinicians. Medtimer is built for health professionals who need fast vital sign counts. Extremely simple to use, it frees you from watching the clock or performing mental calculations. Count heart rates (HR) and respiratory rates (RR) with a few simple taps, and instantly see reference range charts for adults and children of all ages.
IDEAL FOR:
* Nurses & Respiratory Therapists
* Doctors, EMTs & Paramedics
* Medical Assistants & CNAs
* Caregivers & Home Health Aides
* First Aid Providers
* Athletic Trainers & Sports Scientists

bluejetty:00077863:ios.description:

Every level challenges your logic, timing, and understanding of elastic mechanics.

In Stretch Robot: Physics Puzzle, you control a small robot with extendable arms.
Your goal is to stretch, grab, swing, and interact with the environment to overcome obstacles and reach the goal.
Spikes, saws, gaps, and tricky layouts stand in your way — brute force won’t help, only smart thinking.

elastic arms behave naturally, objects react realistically, and each puzzle has multiple possible approaches.
Short levels make the game perfect for quick sessions, while increasing complexity keeps your brain engaged.
Features:
• Physics-based puzzle gameplay with stretch mechanics
• Dozens of handcrafted levels with growing difficulty
• Easy to learn, hard to master logic challenges
• Casual pace with no timers or pressure
• Clean visuals and smooth animations
This is a casual puzzle game for players who enjoy thinking, experimenting, and finding elegant solutions.
Stretch your limits, solve the puzzles, and help the robot reach its destination.

bluejetty:00128629:ios.name: MEDS: Pill & Injection Tracker
bluejetty:00128629:ios.summary:
The essential tracker for injections and medications-designed for real patients managing real conditions.
Whether you're on Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, Humira, Enbrel, insulin, or navigating an IVF cycle, MEDS gives you one place to manage
bluejetty:00128629:ios.description:
The essential tracker for injections and medications-designed for real patients managing real conditions.
Whether you're on Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, Humira, Enbrel, insulin, or navigating an IVF cycle, MEDS gives you one place to manage every medication, every dose, and every schedule. Take control of your health with the tracker built specifically for injectables and complex medication regimens.
---
WHY MEDS?
Most reminder apps treat every medication the same way. MEDS is different. Built from the ground up for injectable medications and multi-drug schedules, it includes features that generic pill trackers simply can't offer-most importantly, built-in injection site rotation.
INJECTION SITE ROTATION
Repeated injections at the same site can cause tissue buildup that reduces medication absorption. MEDS automatically tracks and rotates your injection sites across the abdomen, thighs, and arms using a smart rotation system. You'll always know exactly where to inject next, and you can share your complete site history with your healthcare provider.
SMART DOSE REMINDERS
Missing a dose of Humira, insulin, or a GLP-1 injection can have real health consequences. MEDS gives you precise, customizable alarms for daily, weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly medications. Handles irregular schedules, split doses, and complex multi-medication routines without missing a beat.
REFILL ALERTS
Running out of a specialty medication can mean days without treatment. MEDS tracks your supply level and alerts you before you run low-giving you enough time to contact your pharmacy, specialty pharmacy, or insurance provider.
COMPLETE DOSE HISTORY
Every dose is logged automatically the moment you mark it taken. Review your full medication history at a glance, track adherence over time, and bring an accurate, complete record to every doctor's appointment.
MULTI-MED DASHBOARD
Managing more than one medication? MEDS handles it. Track pills, injectables, vitamins, and supplements in one organized dashboard-each with its own schedule, dose, notes, and log.
---
BUILT FOR:
* GLP-1 weight-loss injections: Ozempic®, Wegovy®, Mounjaro®, Zepbound®
* Biologic & immunotherapy medications: Humira®, Enbrel®, Cosentyx®, Dupixent®, Skyrizi®
* Insulin therapy: basal, bolus, rapid-acting, and pump-based regimens
* IVF and fertility treatment protocols
* Peptide therapy and research compounds
* Chronic conditions: rheumatoid arthritis, MS, Crohn's, psoriasis, and more
* Daily vitamins, minerals, and supplement routines
---
SIMPLE. PRIVATE. YOURS.
No account required. No subscription. No ads.
Your health data stays entirely on your device-it is never uploaded to a server, never sold to third parties, and never used for advertising. MEDS is built to protect your most sensitive personal information while giving you the tools you need to manage it.
Download MEDS today and take control of your health routine.
App uses using the standard Apple Terms of Use (EULA) https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

=== SAVE AND SHARE ===

With Grab Picture, you can actually seek to the time that you want and export this particular photo in JPEG through Email, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Snapchat and much more. But more importantly, you can save it in your camera roll.

=== GREAT FOR GRAB PICTURE FOR PETS ===

Tired to take blurry photos of your dogs, cats and all your cute pets? Really, it is easier than ever with Grab Picture. You will get your animal looking at the camera 100 percent of the time.

=== GREAT FOR ACTION VIDEOS ===

The application is also useful for taking a friend in ACTION, when you go skying, biking, surfing and so much more. Pick photos of your Tricks and share it with your friends!

=== STRUGGLING BETWEEN TAKING VIDEO OR PICTURE?! ===

Have you ever been in this situation where you have to take a video and grab multiples photos?! With our app Video screen capture, you can simply take your video without having to switch and then take your pictures anymore.

Grab Picture lets you pick picture as much as you want from video. Isn't it cool?

=== PLATFORMS AVAILABLE ===

Grab Picture is available on your iPhone and your iPad devices.

- Terms of use: https://hcmaker.fr/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00026920:ios.name: Wavve Boating: GPS, Map, Chart
bluejetty:00026920:ios.summary:
Ever have a stressful day navigating on the water? Wanted to know more about the conditions you are about to head into? Are you looking for exciting places to explore, the best place to refuel, or just trying to meet up with a friend?
Wavv
bluejetty:00026920:ios.description:
Ever have a stressful day navigating on the water? Wanted to know more about the conditions you are about to head into? Are you looking for exciting places to explore, the best place to refuel, or just trying to meet up with a friend?
Wavve Boating takes a new spin on traditional boating navigation by bringing detailed nautical charts, tide predictions, weather forecasts, and more in one easy-to-use tool. Join a fast-growing community of boaters building a network of marine knowledge that everyone can enjoy.
With Wavve Boating you get:
- Simple and Seamless Marine GPS Navigation -
Put away overcrowded and complex charts and apps. Wavve Boating's GPS focuses on important and relevant information so that navigating is as easy as staying in the blue and avoiding the red.
- Custom Nautical Charts -
View and change Wavve Boating's nautical charts based on your unique boating needs and preferences. Set your draft and Wavve Boating redraws the nautical charts to fit your boat. Nautical charts are available for the USA, Canada, Australia and the UK.
You can view a map of our coverage on our website.
- Community Boating -
Just like at the dock or on the water, we all help each other in Wavve Boating. Share expert knowledge of the local waterways by adding shared points of interest to the map. The community can vote on pins, making sure they are all valid and valuable. Not quite ready to share a great find? No problem, you can keep your points of interest private as well.
- Tides -
Track changes in water height in tidal regions and along rivers and lakes with the tides function. View a body of water in North America, and the app will update to reflect the current water levels. View predicted water heights up to 18 hours in advance and track the next tidal variances.
- Weather -
Check the weather, including a complete seven-day forecast, across all of North America. Easily view the temperature, wind speed, and wave height as you move around the map. The local daily forecasts are color-coded to show if it is dangerous to go boating, using guidelines from the Coast Guard's small vessel advisory.
- Fleets of Friends -
See who is on the water and where they are by adding friends to your fleet. Share your locations with members of your fleet to make meeting up a breeze. Want to keep your best fishing hole a secret, even from your boating buds? Easily hide your location to boat under the radar.
- So Long Chart Plotters -
Marine navigation is more than concentrating on a cluttered chart plotter. Get your head out of the cabin and enjoy the journey. Stop buying marine charts piece by piece for your chart plotter. Wavve Boating has integrated all the marine charts into one map for your boating GPS needs.
Subscription Pricing and Terms
Wavve Boating is free to download, and all customers are welcome to a free 14 day trial period. Should you choose to continue to use the Wavve Boating app after the free trial, we offer two auto-renewing subscription options, monthly ($11.99/month) or yearly ($69.99/year). 
Wavve Boating needs you! We've built the platform, but it is boaters that will build our Wavver community. Share your knowledge, share your time, and save a prop or two in the process.
MORE INFORMATION
Want to learn more about Wavve Boating’s marine navigation aid? Still deciding if this is the right boat GPS app for you to replace your chart plotter? Looking for an alternative to Navionics, Embark, Garmin Active Captain or other? Head to our website to learn more. 
TERMS OF SERVICE
https://wavveboating.com/terms-of-service/
PRIVACY POLICY
https://wavveboating.com/privacy-policy/

Both lifelong Greenwich, CT residents Curtis and Fisher cast aside their business suits and ties to immerse themselves in suds and water with the purchase of Greenwich Car Wash in 1981. bluejetty:00060903:ios.description:

m-BCA Benefits
1. No SIM card changes
m-BCA transactions are available through all GSM operators, including Telkomsel, XL Axiata, Indosat, Axis, and Three
2. Low transactions cost 
Reduce unnecessary cost using GPRS/EDGE/3G/WIFI internet connection
3. Payment Data Storage
m-BCA’s storage feature enables you to conduct repeat transactions without having to input the data all over again
4. Transfer Data
m-BCA saves your transfer activities--whether you’re sending funds between BCA accounts or to other banks—to a list for a time-saving and reliable banking experience

3. BCA Credit Card PIN Make / change facility via m-Admin menu ->Create / Change PIN.
4. Cardless Transaction feature through Setor Tarik menu ->Cash withdrawal and cash deposit. 
5. Transfer without hassle through QR menu ->Send or receive money using QR

KlikBCA 
Easy to access KlikBCA smartphone version smartphone https://m.klikbca.com with just one click
Info BCA 
https://www.bca.co.id/id/Individu/Produk/E-Banking/Info-BCA

What you need to do to get your bank account is only by providing e-KTP, completing the form, and doing video call with our Customer Service Officer through BCA mobile application. After you done, you’ll get the success notification of your opening account; you might need to directly activate your mobile banking service (by creating PIN number for transaction) and deposit money to your account. Then you are ready to do any transaction with your BCA mobile application (m-BCA menu). You will also get KlikBCA account the day after you succeed creating your mobile banking PIN via email.
For further assistant, call halo bca at 1500888 via cellular phone
Enjoy using the BCA mobile.

bluejetty:00040807:ios.summary: “Fatal Romance” is the fourth of a great murder story of the “Unsolved Case” investigation games series! Find hidden objects and investigate criminal case files in one of the best detective games! Solve the puzzles, escape room with the cha
bluejetty:00040807:ios.description:
“Fatal Romance” is the fourth of a great murder story of the “Unsolved Case” investigation games series! Find hidden objects and investigate criminal case files in one of the best detective games! Solve the puzzles, escape room with the characters, make decisions that affect the plot and games, unravel the mystery and find out how the next episode ends! Not only the great storyline with a lot of secrets will delight you, but also the fact that the game is completely free!
Hypocrisy - the plague of the 21st century. One can play music without facing consequences, but never play with people. In this story, reunite with already familiar characters to solve exciting new puzzles and unveil secrets. Meet some new bright personalities from the industry of show business and determine who killed a sax player right in the middle of a gig in a fancy jazz-club, and for what reason. However, to do so, you will have to face your own deepest fears…
. SAVOR THE ENTICING STORY FULL OF UNEXPECTED PLOT TWISTS!
Dynamically developing plot with investigation of criminal cases certainly will not leave you indifferent! Spend your time with pleasure playing murder mystery games and find the hidden objects. 
. MAKE YOUR OWN CHOICES AND SEE WHERE THEY LEAD. BETTER THINK TWICE!
You have the ability to choose character phrases for an action on which the investigation depends. Influence the plot of the detective quest, solve the murder mystery and see what comes of it all! 
. CONDUCT YOUR OWN INVESTIGATION AND EARN ACHIEVEMENTS!
Solve the puzzles and find the objects in the unsolved mystery games. Also, it's in your best interest to figure out all the suspects by trying to get into their criminal minds. This will all help you earn numerous achievements to highlight your success!
. PLAY THIS EPISODE OF THE UNSOLVED SERIES TO BE FULLY PREPARED FOR THE NEXT ONE!
Each game is an episode of one murder mystery story. Make your way through this game, solving criminal case files and looking for hidden objects to move on to the next episode and find out what came next. 
As you progress through the episodes, you'll be able to conduct crime investigations and solve a lot of mysterious cases! Finish one series and move on to the next, but if you feel stuck or don’t want to solve a mini-game, you may buy hints to help you proceed quicker!
-----

Find other games on our website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames

Key Features:
• Two-way Communicatio
bluejetty:00167686:ios.description:
Electronic Communication System (ECS) -
ECS is a tool for American Airlines Pilots and Flight attendants to view their schedule, receive updates on schedule changes and communicate with crew scheduling.
Key Features:
• Two-way Communication: Alert scheduling and tracking of your desire to no-show a deadhead, request help with a hotel, call in sick and many other options via the ECS app.
• Current Schedule updates: See updates to your schedule, such as reassignments or delays, to ensure you have the latest information. View departure and arrival gates with quick links to crew lists.
• Hotel Information: See the latest hotel information, including ground transportation, with quick links to the information you need to sign-in at the front desk.
• Customizable Communication Preferences: Control how you receive notifications. With optional push, email, autodial phone calls, and text preferences, you choose how and when you receive messages.
• User-Friendly Interface: Designed with pilots and Flight attendants in mind, ECS offers a clean and intuitive interface for quick and easy access.
ECS is constantly being updated and we look forward to your feedback so we can continue to make ECS a more valuable tool that you can rely on.

bluejetty:00036076:ios.description:
Calorize - Your AI-Powered Calorie Tracker and Diet Companion!
Tracking Calories Has Never Been Easier:
1) Answer questions to build your plan
2) Snap a photo of your meal
3) Get your nutritional macros 
Take control of your diet and nutrition with Calorize, the ultimate app for tracking calories, managing meals, and achieving your health and fitness goals. Whether you’re looking to lose weight, gain muscle, or maintain your current weight, Calorize provides AI-powered insights and tools to help you along the way.
Key Features:
1. Scan Meals and Get Instant Calorie Counts
Say goodbye to manual calorie counting! With Calorize, you can instantly scan your meals using the app’s advanced AI image recognition technology. Simply take a photo of your food, and our AI will analyze the dish to provide detailed calorie and macronutrient (proteins, fats, and carbs) information. No need to guess the nutritional value of your meals ever again.
2. Track Your Daily Calorie Intake and Nutritional Goals
Stay on top of your nutrition by tracking your daily calorie consumption and monitoring your macronutrient intake (Kcal, Protein, Fat, Carbs). Set personalized goals based on whether you want to lose weight, build muscle, or maintain your current weight. Calorize will guide you in making the right dietary choices and help you stick to your plan.
3. Log Meals Easily
Add your meals to the log with just a few taps. Whether you scan your meals or add them manually, Calorize keeps a detailed record of your food intake. You can also create and save meal combinations for easy logging in the future.
4. Progress Tracking with AI Insights
Track your progress over time with AI-powered analytics that help you see how your diet is affecting your body. Monitor your daily, weekly, and monthly progress with easy-to-read charts and stay motivated by seeing how close you are to reaching your goals.
5. AI-Powered Suggestions
Not sure what to eat? Let Calorize It give you meal suggestions that align with your dietary preferences and goals. Our AI provides you with recommendations based on your past meal logs and current progress.
6. Powered by the Most Advanced Version of ChatGPT
Experience the power of AI with the most advanced version of ChatGPT integrated into Calorize. This ensures you get precise and intelligent calorie analysis, and personalized diet recommendations. With ChatGPT, the app offers smarter insights and faster results, giving you an unparalleled diet tracking experience.
Why Choose Calorize?
 • AI-Powered Tracking: Our cutting-edge AI makes it easier than ever to track calories and analyze meals.
 • Personalized for You: Customize your dietary plan according to your goals – whether it’s weight loss, muscle gain, or maintenance.
 • Easy Meal Logging: Use the built-in scanner or manually enter meals – tracking has never been this simple!
 • Diet Flexibility: Easily switch between different goals and diets without losing your progress.
 • Nutrition Insights: Get a clear view of your nutritional intake and how it aligns with your goals.
Calorize is perfect for anyone serious about nutrition and health, whether you’re just starting your fitness journey or you’re an experienced athlete looking to fine-tune your diet. Our AI-powered approach makes it simple, intuitive, and effective to track your meals and reach your health goals.
Disclaimer:
Calorize provides nutritional information based on AI analysis (ChatGPT). This information is for educational purposes only and is not intended as medical advice. Please consult a healthcare professional for personalized recommendations. Follow this link to know more: https://s.scancalories.app/view/doc/disclaimer
Download Calorize today and take control of your nutrition with AI-powered precision!

언제나 빠르고 정확한 길 안내와 차량 관리를 위한 다양한 서비스도
한 번에 이용할 수 있다면 내 차와 함께하는 모든 일상에는 기쁨만 가득할 거예요.
카카오내비가 안내하는 편리하고 즐거운 운전 생활을 지금 경험해 보세요.
[정확하고 즐거운 운전 도우미, 카카오내비]
빅데이터를 바탕으로 최적의 경로를 찾아내는 빠르고 정확한 길 안내는 기본!
시원한 지도뷰와 다양한 추천, 탐색 기능으로 더욱 편리하게 운전을 도와드려요.
■ 빠르고 정확한 길 안내
이용자들의 실제 운행 데이터와 실시간 교통정보를 바탕으로 찾은 최적의 길로 막힘없이 시원하게 달려보세요.
■ 빅데이터로 운행 소요시간 예측
출발 시간을 변경하면 목적지까지 얼마나 걸리는지를 빅데이터와 교통 예측 알고리즘을 기반으로 알려 드려요.
■ Kakao i로 더 쉽고, 풍부해진 카카오내비
운전 중에도 목적지와 주변 주유소 검색부터 카톡 보내기, 음악 재생까지 음성으로 간편하게!
■ CarPlay에서 만나는 내비게이션
스마트폰을 연결하면 카카오내비가 더 큰 화면으로 쏘옥! 차량용 디스플레이와 오디오에 최적화된 길안내로 더욱 편하게 운전하세요. (CarPlay 지원 차량, 헤드유닛에서만 가능)
■ 카톡으로 전하는 실시간 위치
어디서 만날지, 어디쯤인지 일일이 설명하지 않아도 괜찮아요. 
약속 장소, 도착시간, 내 위치를 카톡으로 보내 간편하게 설명하세요!
[운전자에게 필요한 서비스를 모두 담은 운전생활 탭]
내 운전이력을 관리하고 보험, 전기차충전, 대리, 발레 등 다양한 차량관리 서비스도 경험해 보세요!
■ 현금 없이, 기다림 없는 새로운 [발레]
길에서 대기할 필요 없이 앱에서 미리 출차 신청하고, 차량을 받은 후 현금 없이 자동 결제로 시간을 절약하세요.
■ 내가 원하는 곳에서 편하게 [출장세차]
내가 원하는 곳으로, 원하는 시간에 찾아오는 출장 세차 서비스로 깨끗하게 차량을 관리하세요.
■ 회원가입 NO! 카드발급 NO! QR로 초간편 충전하세요 [전기차충전]
전국 5만 개 충전소에서 회원가입 및 회원카드 발급 없이 QR 스캔하면 바로 충전이 시작됩니다.
■ 자동차보험부터 운전자보험까지 [내차보험]
카카오내비 앱에서 실제 주행 거리만큼만 보험료를 내는 스마트한 운전자 보험부터
주행안전점수에 따라 할인 받는 자동차보험까지 알뜰한 자동차 보험을 경험하세요.
■ 내차 살 때도 팔 때도 카카오내비에서 한 번에! [내차팔기/내차사기]
1분 만에 내 차 시세 알아보고, 등록, 판매까지 한 번에 해결 가능! 내 차 살 때는 KCAR에서 인증 중고차를 믿고 구매하세요.
■ 나의 운전 이력과 습관을 한눈에! [나의 운전 기록]
나의 운전 시간과 거리, 경로를 쉽게 확인할 수 있고 과속, 급가속, 급감속 빈도로 안전점수를 계산해 드려요. 월간리포트에서 나의 주행 기록과 운전 성향도 확인해 보세요.
■ 운전생활 탭에서 나의 차량을 관리해 보세요.
자동차 검사 기간, 내 차 리콜 정보, 자동차 보험료 할인 정보 등을 바로 확인하세요.
[새로워진 주차탭에서 복잡한 곳에서의 주차도 스마트하게]
주차장 찾아 헤매지 마세요!
주차 탭에서 목적지 근처 주차장 검색부터 예약, 결제까지 한 번에 해결할 수 있어요. 
카카오 T 주차로 저렴하고 편리하게 주차해 보세요.

* 위치 - 길안내, 벌집 화면 구성, 주변검색을 위해 접근이 필요합니다.

listings.description:
내비게이션의 새로운 진화, 카카오내비

언제나 빠르고 정확한 길 안내와 차량 관리를 위한 다양한 서비스도
한 번에 이용할 수 있다면 내 차와 함께하는 모든 일상에는 기쁨만 가득할 거예요.
카카오내비가 안내하는 편리하고 즐거운 운전 생활을 지금 경험해 보세요.


[정확하고 즐거운 운전 도우미, 카카오내비]
빅데이터를 바탕으로 최적의 경로를 찾아내는 빠르고 정확한 길 안내는 기본!
시원한 지도뷰와 다양한 추천, 탐색 기능으로 더욱 편리하게 운전을 도와드려요.

■ 빠르고 정확한 길 안내
이용자들의 실제 운행 데이터와 실시간 교통정보를 바탕으로 찾은 최적의 길로 막힘없이 시원하게 달려보세요.

■ 빅데이터로 운행 소요시간 예측
출발 시간을 변경하면 목적지까지 얼마나 걸리는지를 빅데이터와 교통 예측 알고리즘을 기반으로 알려 드려요.

■ Kakao i로 더 쉽고, 풍부해진 카카오내비
운전 중에도 목적지와 주변 주유소 검색부터 카톡 보내기, 음악 재생까지 음성으로 간편하게!

■ CarPlay에서 만나는 내비게이션
스마트폰을 연결하면 카카오내비가 더 큰 화면으로 쏘옥! 차량용 디스플레이와 오디오에 최적화된 길안내로 더욱 편하게 운전하세요. (CarPlay 지원 차량, 헤드유닛에서만 가능)

■ 카톡으로 전하는 실시간 위치
어디서 만날지, 어디쯤인지 일일이 설명하지 않아도 괜찮아요. 
약속 장소, 도착시간, 내 위치를 카톡으로 보내 간편하게 설명하세요!


[운전자에게 필요한 서비스를 모두 담은 운전생활 탭]
내 운전이력을 관리하고 보험, 전기차충전, 대리, 발레 등 다양한 차량관리 서비스도 경험해 보세요!


■ 현금 없이, 기다림 없는 새로운 [발레]
길에서 대기할 필요 없이 앱에서 미리 출차 신청하고, 차량을 받은 후 현금 없이 자동 결제로 시간을 절약하세요.

■ 내가 원하는 곳에서 편하게 [출장세차]
내가 원하는 곳으로, 원하는 시간에 찾아오는 출장 세차 서비스로 깨끗하게 차량을 관리하세요.

■ 회원가입 NO! 카드발급 NO! QR로 초간편 충전하세요 [전기차충전]
전국 5만 개 충전소에서 회원가입 및 회원카드 발급 없이 QR 스캔하면 바로 충전이 시작됩니다.

■ 자동차보험부터 운전자보험까지 [내차보험]
카카오내비 앱에서 실제 주행 거리만큼만 보험료를 내는 스마트한 운전자 보험부터
주행안전점수에 따라 할인 받는 자동차보험까지 알뜰한 자동차 보험을 경험하세요.

■ 내차 살 때도 팔 때도 카카오내비에서 한 번에! [내차팔기/내차사기]
1분 만에 내 차 시세 알아보고, 등록, 판매까지 한 번에 해결 가능! 내 차 살 때는 KCAR에서 인증 중고차를 믿고 구매하세요.

■ 나의 운전 이력과 습관을 한눈에! [나의 운전 기록]
나의 운전 시간과 거리, 경로를 쉽게 확인할 수 있고 과속, 급가속, 급감속 빈도로 안전점수를 계산해 드려요. 월간리포트에서  나의 주행 기록과 운전 성향도 확인해 보세요.

■ 운전생활 탭에서 나의 차량을 관리해 보세요.
자동차 검사 기간, 내 차 리콜 정보, 자동차 보험료 할인 정보 등을 바로 확인하세요.

[새로워진 주차탭에서 복잡한 곳에서의 주차도 스마트하게]
주차장 찾아 헤매지 마세요!
주차 탭에서 목적지 근처 주차장 검색부터 예약, 결제까지 한 번에 해결할 수 있어요. 
카카오 T 주차로 저렴하고 편리하게 주차해 보세요.

bluejetty:00138787:ios.description:
You have 47 things you want and zero idea where you saved any of them. Listful is the one place that actually keeps track of it all.
Add anything from any store. Amazon, Sephora, Urban Outfitters, Abercrombie, Adidas, IKEA. If it's sold online, you can add it. Build one list or a dozen, arrange them exactly how you want, and make something that actually looks good. Share it with one link. That's it.
WHY PEOPLE SWITCH TO LISTFUL
Most people are juggling gift ideas across their Notes app, random screenshots, and browser tabs they swore they'd come back to. Listful puts it all in one beautiful place. Organize by color, build shareable collages, and give the people who love you one link to shop from.
HOW IT WORKS
• Create a list for any occasion
• Add items from any store by pasting a link or browsing in-app
• Share it with one link (no app or account needed to view)
• Shop it yourself or let the people who love you make your wishes happen
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Add items from every store on the internet with one tap
• Save fashion finds, outfits, and beauty picks all in one place
• Use it as your personal running list of everything you want
• Share lists by link, text, or directly to TikTok and Instagram
• Let people reserve gifts so nothing gets doubled up
• Get notified when someone reserves a wish
• Track prices and get price-drop alerts
• Build lists together with collaborators
• Compare prices directly on your wishlist
• Customize the app to fit your style
• Add items manually when there's no link
• Get personalized gift suggestions based on your lists
PERFECT FOR
• Christmas lists and holiday gift exchanges
• Birthday wishlists for kids, teens, and adults
• Wedding registries and bridal showers
• Baby shower registries
• Graduation gifts
• Fashion wishlists and style saving
• Everyday saving and shopping inspiration
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Is Listful free?
Yes. Creating, sharing, and shopping wishlists is free.
Does it work with any store?
Yes. Listful works with every store on the internet. You can also add items manually with no link at all.
Do my friends and family need the app to see my list?
Nope. Your wishlist link opens in any browser. They can view, shop, and reserve without downloading anything.
Fulfilling wishes should be easy. Download Listful and make it that way.

bluejetty:00149646:ios.description:
Suko: The compact number-placement puzzle
If you love the satisfying challenge of Sudoku but crave an experience that is fresh, fast, and elegantly simple, Suko is for you.
Suko distills the deep logic of classic number-placement games into a beautifully compact, minimalist board. It’s the perfect harmony of casual relaxation and brain-teasing challenge—designed to deliver that triumphant "aha!" moment in minutes, not hours.
Deceptively Simple. Deeply Challenging. Don't let the sleek, compact grid fool you. Suko is meticulously crafted to test your logic just as rigorously as your favorite Sudoku. Place the numbers 1 through 9 to perfectly match the target sums of the surrounding circles and color conditions. It is a completely new way to flex your brain.
Find Your Flow. Immerse yourself in a visually stunning, premium interface free from clutter and distractions. With smooth animations, quiet aesthetics, and no stressful timers, Suko is a meditative retreat for your mind. Whether you're unwinding after a long day or waking up your brain with your morning coffee, Suko brings a moment of zen to your routine.
Why You'll Love Suko:
• Familiar Yet Fresh: The ultimate puzzle for fans of Sudoku, Kakuro, and logic games looking for their next obsession.
• Bite-Sized Brilliance: Deeply engaging rounds that fit perfectly into the brief pauses of your day.
• Purely Casual: Play at your own pace. No timers, no pressure—just pure, uninterrupted problem-solving.

【游戏简介】：
　　最近在寻找一款单机的纯免费的，有情怀可以怀旧的游戏，找了很久找不到，就做了一个自娱自乐，游戏中能寻找到FC、GBA时代游戏的感觉。
 游戏的故事背景是发生在欧洲的骑士时代，主角杰里休斯从疼痛中醒来发现身在荒野，而此时一名小男孩被几名骑士追捕，原来国王突然遇刺身亡，而继承人失踪，就在此时皇后派出大量的骑士将伊尔小镇上的所有男孩抓回皇宫，杰里休斯此时挺身而出却被骑士击伤昏迷，幸好路过的武士相救回到伊尔小镇，却发现自己原来全身都是伤，也记不得之前发生或什么事。
　　时间不多，一个人开发、一个人制作、一个人完成，进度较慢，先发布第一个章节，之后每周不定时会有剧情更新，把剧情做下去，一定对得起这个容量。
==========游戏特点==========
 一个具有FC、GBA特色且纯免费的单机角色扮演游戏。
巅峰骑士团 讨论群：399259398
==========配置提示==========
 游戏过程中，如果觉得缓慢，请在设置中打开【始终冲刺】
==========游戏特色==========
【传送系统】可以传送到你去过的地方，前提是你要激活水晶
【好友系统】搞好关系吧，隐藏剧情、道具神马的就看这个
【技能系统】技能除了可以学习，还可以找高人提升威力和动画，技能与技能之间还可以相互组合
【动物互动】当你靠近鸟儿时，它们也许会飞走
【锻造系统】锻造武器并且强化、还可以镶嵌你喜欢的宝石
【时间系统】不同的时间会有不同的人物出现、事件的发生
【天气系统】感受一年四季变化，风雨带来的体验
【阵型系统】对付不同的敌人需要熟练运用阵型，阵型还能提高个人能力以及技能威力
【军团系统】队伍中一个人强大是不够的的，只有整个军团的平均实力提升才能克敌制胜
【坐骑系统】除了有可以在地上跑的马，还有可以穿越地形飞行在空中的飞龙、巨鸟等。
【任务系统】在高自由的城市都可以接到需要完成的任务，自由选择未来。
【家园系统】游戏之余可以进行养成玩法，购买庄园种地雇佣女仆，招募探险家。
