Caesar, we will plunge you into the age of great empires and conquest! Strategically upgrade your warriors, and protect your city, travel back to the age of Empires. Join the battle to rewrite history of Rome and Europe! The glory of Rome awaits you in this war strategy game. Play Rise of the Roman Empire and turn your small town into the largest and most powerful empire in history. The age of empire, the Roman Empire, is coming! Caesar! prove yourself in battle! The rise of the empire will come with a Caesar like you! The settlers want to see you as their Caesar! Age of Empire, Roman Empire is the most interesting and beautiful city building simulator. Roman game for real kings of kingdoms!
Caesar! You have to take control of a Roman settlement and turn it into a powerful, prosperous Roman Empire! With a General like you, Rome will regain its former glory! learn game strategy, conquer new civilizations and conquer different cultures and peoples. In this strategy game, a Caesar like you will build a strong, powerful kingdom, an entire Roman civilization with different peoples and cultures of being. The age of empire begins here. Caesar with Roman settlers will begin the conquest of the barbarian kingdoms and empires.
The Roman warriors are strong and brave, they fight like wolves, but they lack an experienced leader. A strong, tactical and strategic general.
The Emperor, in addition to the Roman legions and the fleet, under your command there will be 2 strong advisers - Ovid and Asteria!
Ovid is an experienced commander, a tactician and strategist, seasoned in battles with barbarians. A participant in the great imperial wars with the kingdom of Elvinar, the mighty empire of Sim and the cruel island of the Viking clan. Has awards of the Orders of Ice and Fire, as the highest title of devotion to the Roman Empire! Ovid is the chief admiral of the Roman Empire, legends are made about him. The conquest of new lands has already begun!
Asteria - has a sharp and flexible mind, knows how to correctly plan, manage the construction and life of a Roman settlement. Knows how to build various buildings of production, architecture and culture of Rome. How to build and manage trade routes. Knows how to negotiate with neighboring tribes, villages and cities. Will help in the diplomatic conduct of affairs, a peaceful outcome in the war. Asteria is a real forge of the great Roman Empire!
With an Emperor like you and such powerful advisors, the new age of the dawn of the Roman Empire will begin! The whole civilization is in your hands! The strategy for the development of Roman culture depends only on you!
Great wars and conquests, building a city, seizing new territories, training soldiers, equipment, production of resources and goods, sea battles and trade, raids and dungeons, hundreds of interesting quests and tasks, battles on the global map with other players - All this is available to you! City building game! Emperor! The Roman Empire is you!
Our strategy game will make you a real Roman Caesar, immerse you in the wars of ancient civilizations. Rise of the Roman strategy game will immerse you in the Rome games, the whole culture of the Roman civilization. Caesar, you are going to play and build your kingdom. Entire cultures and nations will fall at your feet in this city building games. You will become a worthy ruler, a worthy Caesar of the great Roman Empire. Caesar start a new age of the Roman Empire, play our strategy game and conquer mysterious civilizations and kingdoms. The strategy game Rise of the Roman Empire will make you a real military commander, a real Caesar of your own, military empire. The settlers welcome the new Caesar! Ave Caesar! Ave Caesar! Strategy about the rise of the great Roman Empire, the conquest of kingdoms and kings.

bluejetty:00187511:ios.summary: Lili is an award-winning online business banking platform built for growth-ready small businesses in the U.S. High-performance business banking with fast payments, high-yield savings, business credit, and exceptional support, Lili provides
bluejetty:00187511:ios.description:
Lili is an award-winning online business banking platform built for growth-ready small businesses in the U.S. High-performance business banking with fast payments, high-yield savings, business credit, and exceptional support, Lili provides the financial foundation businesses rely on from day one through higher-revenue, multi-employee stages.
ADVANCED BUSINESS BANKING
• High-Speed Payments - Express ACH, domestic & international wires [2], and expedited check deposits [6]
• Up to 4.00% Annual Percentage Yield (APY) on savings - Daily earnings, no lockups [4]
• $3M FDIC Insurance – Expanded coverage via sweep network [8]
• Access to Business Credit – Flexible terms, fast decisions [5]
• Seamless Integrations – Connect with QuickBooks, Xero, Stripe, Shopify, Gusto, and more
• Team Access – Add members and accountants with permissions
• 7-Day Live Support – Reliable help when you need it
HIGH-YIELD BUSINESS SAVINGS
• Earn up to 4.00% APY on your business savings [4]
• Daily earnings with no lockups or penalties
• No minimum balance requirements
HIGH-SPEED PAYMENTS, BUILT FOR SCALE
• Express ACH and expedited check deposits for faster access to funds [6]
• Domestic and international wires with limits designed for higher volume
• Reliable money movement to support day-to-day operations as your business grows
ACCESS TO BUSINESS CREDIT (LINE OF CREDIT) [5]
• Get a business line of credit up to $250,000 [5]
• Apply in as little as 3 minutes, with no impact to your credit score to apply
• If approved, funds available as soon as the next business day
• Flexible, revolving credit - draw, repay, and reuse as cash flow cycles
• Clear, predictable costs, with fixed fees only on the amount you use
SUPPORT YOU CAN RELY ON
• Live customer support available 7 days a week
• Smart 24/7 assistance for fast answers
• Educational resources and tools for growing businesses
• 83% of customers rate Lili support 9 or 10 out of 10 [7]
ADVANCED SECURITY & PROTECTION
Lili accounts are insured up to $3 million through a network of FDIC-insured sweep program banks [8]. 
Your funds and data are protected with industry-grade encryption, fraud monitoring, multi-factor authentication, real-time alerts, and instant card controls—available anytime via web or mobile.
LEGAL DISCLOSURES 
Lili is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services are provided by Sunrise Banks N.A., Member FDIC.
[1] The Core banking account has no monthly fee. Monthly fees apply to the Pro, Smart, and Premium accounts. 
[2] International wire transfers are only available to legal entity customers (LLCs, corporations, and partnerships). Transfers can be made to and from select countries. Please check your app for the most up to date list. Fees apply. Learn more here Sunrise Banks Account Agreement. 
[3] Available to Lili Pro, Smart, and Premium account holders only; monthly account fees apply. 
[4] The APY for the Lili Savings Account is variable and subject to change. As of January 13, 2026, 2.25% APY applies to balances up to $500,000. Balances over $500,000 and up to $1 million earn 4.00% APY. Balances above $1 million do not earn interest. 
[5] Access to capital is provided by partners that offer business loans or lines of credit. Lili is not a bank or lender. Underwriting required. At least 3 months in business and $30K in revenue required to apply. 
[6] Expedited availability of funds is based on individual circumstances. 
[7] Figures based on a Lili survey conducted between January 1, 2025 to January 1, 2026. Information available upon request. 
[8] FDIC insurance only covers the failure of an FDIC insured bank. The standard FDIC deposit insurance limit is $250,000 per depositor, per FDIC insured bank, per ownership category through Sunrise Banks, N.A and the sweep program banks. See Sunrise Banks Account Agreement and Addendum to Sunrise Banks Account Agreement.

bluejetty:00016711:ios.description:
Match fruits, flowers, and candies, solve delightful puzzles, and rebuild iconic cities around the globe with Magica: Match 3 Puzzle Game!
Embark on an unforgettable adventure through hundreds of captivating match 3 levels. Discover vibrant locations, restore famous landmarks, and meet charming friends along your journey.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE MAGICA:
MATCH 3 FUN
Swipe and match colorful fruits, flowers, and candies to solve exciting puzzles. Collect apples, strawberries, and beautiful flowers to create amazing bonuses. Gather valuable resources like wood, mana, and crystals to rebuild iconic cities!
MAGICAL BOOSTERS
Activate incredible boosters such as Parrot, Paint, and Bomb to blast through levels faster. Combine boosters strategically to conquer even the toughest puzzles.
RESTORE ICONIC CITIES
Travel and rebuild more than 35 real cities including Paris, Rome, Tokyo, Cairo, and Las Vegas. Construct legendary landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower, Big Ben, Statue of Liberty, and many others!
COMPLETE CHALLENGING TASKS
Collect magical cards and crystals, activate teleporters, unlock new maps, and assist charming characters in engaging quests.
MEET UNIQUE CHARACTERS
Make friends with Sand Golem, Anubis, Dragons, Ghosts, Mummies, musicians, chefs, warriors, and other delightful characters who will accompany you on your journey.
PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Invite friends, send extra lives, and share magical puzzle adventures together!
COMFORTABLE & PLAYER-FRIENDLY
Rewarded ads appear only by choice. Enjoy offline play anytime, anywhere, completely free.
KEY FEATURES:
Hundreds of addictive match 3 puzzles
Restore and explore over 35 iconic cities
Collect resources: wood, mana, crystals
Powerful boosters for strategic gameplay
Offline mode – play without internet
Regular updates with new levels and cities
Ready for your next puzzle adventure?
Download Magica: Match 3 Puzzle Game today and begin your exciting journey!

bluejetty:00132209:ios.name: EMT B Prep 2026
bluejetty:00132209:ios.developer: Chengdu Youzou Information Technology Co., Ltd
bluejetty:00132209:ios.summary: Emergency Medical Technicians provide out of hospital emergency medical care and transportation for critical and emergent patients who access the emergency medical services (EMS) system. EMTs have the basic knowledge and skills necessary to
bluejetty:00132209:ios.description:
Emergency Medical Technicians provide out of hospital emergency medical care and transportation for critical and emergent patients who access the emergency medical services (EMS) system. EMTs have the basic knowledge and skills necessary to stabilize and safely transport patients ranging from non-emergency and routine medical transports to life threatening emergencies. Emergency Medical Technicians function as part of a comprehensive EMS response system, under medical oversight. Emergency Medical Technicians perform interventions with the basic equipment typically found on an ambulance. Emergency Medical Technicians are a critical link between the scene of an emergency and the health care system.
To become an Emergency Medical Technician, you need to have a full course of lectures and practical experience, culminating in an official examination for certification.
Passing the exam is the final part of the process, but it determines whether you will finally be certified or not.
This app does just that, it helps you to pass the exam more easily.
It offers a number of useful and easy-to-use features for this purpose.
For example, you can study the official exam syllabus, which is organised into specific points that will give you a clear idea of what to focus on in the exam.
Of course just studying is of limited help as you have already gone through a very specialised learning process, what will really help you to improve your pass rate is to answer the questions through constant practice.
The questions are taken from previous official exam drafts and they are designed as challenges and you need to challenge them one by one. If you complete all of them, it almost means that you are fully ready to pass the official official exam.
The learning process is boring and we have designed the achievement system to make it fun. When you complete a task, you will receive a medal, which is a testimony to your efforts and encouragement.
Come on, download it and you'll pass the exam!

Privacy Policy:https://sites.google.com/view/aboutusterms/#h.9za86w7hq91o

Accounts will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00021267:ios.description:
دار القبس للصحافة والطباعة والنشر مؤسسة صحفية كويتية يشرف عليها ويديرها مجلس إدارة مكون من المساهمين وعددهم خمسة أعضاء .صدر العدد الأول منها بتاريخ 22 فبراير 1972 وترأس تحريرها جاسم احمد النصف لغاية 1983 ، ثم تولى رئاسة التحرير محمد جاسم الصقر من فبراير 1983 ولغاية 4 يوليو 1999 ثم تولى رئاسة التحرير وليد عبداللطيف النصف منذ 5 يوليو 1999 وما زال لتاريخه . .تم إشهارها كمؤسسة صحيفة كويتية مستقلة بتاريخ 12 / 2 / 1972 ، وتمارس أعمالا متنوعة تفيد المجتمع وتخدمه منها :
1. إصدار وطباعة الصحف والمجلات
2. نشر مؤلفات الكتب القديمة والحديثة
3. إصدار نشرات إعلانية وإعلامية
4. إستيراد وشراء المعدات والتجهيزات والمواد اللازمة كآلات الطباعة والتصوير والورق
تبوأت القبس الصدارة من حيث المصداقية والخبر الصحيح والاستقلالية بطرح آرائها مما جعلها الأكثر تعبيرا عن الرأي العام الكويتي وكانت ومازالت السباقة بتبني القضايا الوطنية والقومية من منظار الالتزام بمصالح الكويت والوطن العربى .
محطات في تاريخ القبس
عام 1972 صدر أول عدد من القبس .
عام 1985 أصدرت القبس الطبعة الدولية باسم القبس الدولي .
عام 1990 توقفت عن الصدور بسبب العدوان العسكري العراقي لدولة الكويت.
عام 1991 عادت إلى الصدور بعد تحرير دولة الكويت وفي شهر يونيو صدر أول عدد.
تصدر القبس صفحات متخصصة بعد أن كانت السباقة بإصدار الملاحق في فترة السبعينات و الثمانينات و لديها شبكة مراسلين تغطي أهم العواصم العربية و الدولية .
تصدر كتاب الشهر إلى المشتركين مجانا انسجاما مع رسالتها التنويرية و الثقافية .
تصدر صحيفة ” لوموند دبلوماتيك ” باللغة العربية كل شهر .
مركز المعلومات و الدراسات في القبس
أنشئ المركز عام 1976 و كان يعمل بوسائط تقليدية بتصغير صفحات القبس منذ صدورها على أفلام ميكروفيلمية يمكن اللجوء إليها بالعرض و القراءة و الطباعة و خلال السبعينات أصبح مركز المعلومات يضم أربع وحدات رئيسية هي : وحدة المكتبة و المعلومات و الأبحاث و الصور و الميكروفيلم. مع بداية التسعينات دخلت تكنولوجيا المعلومات بقوة في هذا المجال و استخدمت أجهزة كمبيوتر و برامج حديثة في مجال التوثيق و الفهرسة و إصدار الكشافات الالكترونية و توفير خدمة معلومات متكاملة بطريقة آلية كاملة و فق قواعد منظمة للفهرسة و التوثيق و التكشيف و الحفظ و الاسترجاع و ربط المركز بأقسام التحرير اليكترونيا . يحرص المركز على المساهمة بكتابة الأبحاث والتقارير و الدراسات التي تنشر بالصحيفة باستمرار . تحتوى مكتبة القبس على نحو 15 ألف كتاب و هناك نحو 4 ملايين وثيقة و مليوني صورة .

bluejetty:00062096:ios.description:
Constant Therapy is an award-winning, science-based exercise app for cognitive, language, and speech practice — built for people living with aphasia, apraxia, dementia, stroke, traumatic brain injury (TBI), or other neurological conditions. Join a community of 800,000+ users who have completed 350 million+ science-based practice exercises. Get unlimited AI-guided exercises you can do anytime, anywhere — a helpful way to get more exercise practice between speech therapy, occupational therapy or neurology appointments.
AVAILABLE IN English dialects (US, UK, Australia, India) & US Spanish.
Constant Therapy is built for people who want to:
– Practice finding words, speaking and improve communication despite aphasia
– Work on everyday math and problem-solving skills affected after a stroke or brain injury
– Strengthen memory with structured cognitive exercises for dementia or memory loss
– Regain confidence in doing everyday activities like reading menus, maps, and understanding phone messages
– Improve attention and executive functioning with daily practice after a stroke
– Get more aphasia, apraxia, or cognitive exercise practice between speech therapy or occupational therapy appointments
– Support a loved one who has run out of speech-language therapy or occupational therapy but needs more day-to-day practice
FEATURES & BENEFITS
• For people with aphasia, apraxia, dementia, stroke, TBI, or other neurological conditions: choose your speech, language and cognitive goals, and get customized, ever-adjusting exercises based on your needs
• Practice speaking, memory, attention, reading, writing, language, math, comprehension, problem solving, visual processing, auditory memory, and other functional skills
• Use independently at home, alongside in-clinic speech-language pathology or occupational therapy, or add your clinician to follow your progress
• Ideal for people who want daily home exercises to supplement aphasia therapy, dementia therapy, speech-language therapy, or cognitive therapy from a licensed professional
• Friendly, live customer support trained to work with people who have cognitive and communication challenges
• Track progress with clear, easy-to-understand performance summaries

bluejetty:00129355:ios.description:
Want some changes? New wallpapers are what you need!
Our application offers you a simple and convenient way to customize your device's screen with the most beautiful and stylish wallpapers. Clear navigation, high performance and regular updates turn the application into an intuitive experience for users.
Features:
- Categorized Wallpaper Collections
- Vast Image Library
- User-friendly Interface and Stylish Design
- Regular Updates and Adjustments
Intuitive Interface
No need to search endlessly - our app is easy to navigate, even if you are using it for the first time. Everything is just one tap away. Choose your favorites and save them with a few taps.
Wallpaper Selection for Everybody
Are you looking for something bright and colorful, minimalistic and aesthetic, or unusual and unique? There is everything in our picture collections: from adorable manuls to breathtaking cosmic views. Regular updates will not make you bored. Find more interesting images for your device's screen.
High Resolution
We know how sharp and bright pictures are important for lock and home screens. Our app provides the highest-quality images, so you can appreciate every detail.
Preview Before Save
Use the preview feature before downloading and setting new wallpaper design for your device's screen. See how it looks on your screen and make your choice with ease.
Icon Frames
Add originality to your home screen. Our app features a section for creating customized frames. Choose the color, add gradients, and adjust the design the way you like it. You can apply the frames with the current background or select a new one from the app’s collection.
Bookmark Favorite Wallpapers
Saving becomes even more convenient with the Bookmarks feature. Just mark the wallpapers you like and save them for later. You can easily find the perfect image for your screen and set it at any time.
Wallpapers to Match Your Mood
Your mood changes daily - why not your wallpaper? Explore different wallpaper categories and set a picture that harmonizes with your mood. Feeling energetic? Choose bright and dynamic images. Need peace of mind? Soft pastel tones will bring calm. Want something deep and reflective? Deep blue is here for you. 
Find what matches your vibe today!

Subscribe and get right now:
1. Exclusive wallpaper packs
2. Advanced icon customization
3. Unique stylish backgrounds
4. Regular content updates
Disable ads and unlock all wallpapers with premium access:
- Paid subscription is divided into 3 types: weekly, monthly and annual. - The cost of a weekly paid subscription is $9.99. Monthly - $19.99. Annual - $49.99. 
The amount will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. 
- You can cancel a subscription or trial period at any time, but no later than 24 hours before the end of the current period. OTHERWISE it will be automatically renewed. 
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. 
- After payment, you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings. 
- Any unused portion of the free period will be forfeited upon purchase of the subscription.

bluejetty:00017282:ios.description:
Discover the timeless classic of Tic-Tac-Toe, now reimagined for your mobile experience! Often known as noughts and crosses or Xs and Os, this beloved paper-and-pencil game leaps onto your screen with exciting digital twists. Engage in the traditional 3x3 grid gameplay, or challenge yourself with our extended 4x4 and 5x5 grids. Push your strategic skills to the limit with advanced modes, including thrilling 4-in-a-row and 5-in-a-row challenges.
Tic-Tac-Toe Mobile brings the joy of this simple yet profound game right into the palm of your hand. Perfect for family game time, you can also dive into solo play, battling against AI opponents with varying levels of difficulty. Test your wits against our AI - a true challenge awaits when you face our toughest level!
As you play, accumulate experience points by outsmarting the AI (earn +1 for Easy, +3 for Medium, +5 for Hard, and a whopping +7 for Expert levels). Feel the satisfaction of watching your skills grow game by game.
Key Features:
Expanded Gameplay: Enjoy not just the classic 3x3, but also 4x4 and 5x5 grids.
Advanced Modes: Try your hand at 4-in-a-row and 5-in-a-row for a fresh twist.
Undo Function: Made a mistake? No problem, simply undo your last move.
Save/Load: Pause and resume your game anytime with our save/load feature.
Varied AI Difficulty: From beginner-friendly to expert, find your perfect challenge.
Customization: Personalize your experience with custom board and piece sets.
Timer Mode: Add a rush of adrenaline with timed games.
Get ready to rediscover Tic-Tac-Toe like never before – a perfect blend of classic fun and modern challenge, all in your mobile device!

bluejetty:00128266:ios.description:
Managing your EZ TAG account just got easier. 
For EZ TAG account holders, download the app and log into your account using the same username and password established on your HCTRA.org log in.
If you don’t have an EZ TAG you can open an account with the mobile app using a credit card or bank account and order a toll tag to place on your windshield. 
Your EZ TAG works on all toll roads throughout Texas, Oklahoma, Kansas, Florida and Colorado.
The EZ TAG app allows you to manage all aspects of your EZ TAG Account, including:
• View your balance and add funds to your account
• Manage your payment methods
• View your transactions
• Manage your EZ TAGs and vehicles
• Manage your EZ TAG Account profile
• Receive push notifications and alerts
• View news and closures
• Call for HCTRA’s roadside assistance service
Log-in to HCTRA.org if you need to:
• View Monthly Statements

bluejetty:00186468:ios.name: Math Balance Educational Games
bluejetty:00186468:ios.summary: Mental Math is fun with Math Balance - kids help Toby reach home by balancing bridges and while they have fun, they also learn about equality/comparison, gain flexibility with numbers and practice skills that are essential for understanding
bluejetty:00186468:ios.description:
Mental Math is fun with Math Balance - kids help Toby reach home by balancing bridges and while they have fun, they also learn about equality/comparison, gain flexibility with numbers and practice skills that are essential for understanding algebra. 
This mental math game with 30 levels will help your child get necessary fluidity with numbers. Your child will learn things like addition can happen in any order for the same result, or that sum of different numbers can add up to be the same number. They will also end up having to use different number strategies, such as bridging and compensation which can significantly speed up their mental math computations. 
These are the skills covered by Math Balance - 
- Developing meaning of equal sign, using, greater than and less than sign
- Set up numbers in their expanded form
- Commutative property of addition and, later, using it and expanded form as a strategy to add ex: 67+25 = 60+7+20+5 = 80+12 =92
- Missing Addend strategies:x+b=c, where x is to be found, situations where difference is unknown, where there is a bigger unknown and where there is a smaller unknown -one step problems 
- Showing that addition and subtraction are inverse; 4+5=9, 9-5=4
- Use only doubles, Use only even/odd numbers to get to a total 
- 1 step word problems -Change unknown, Result unknown, Start unknown
- add a string of two-digit numbers (up to four numbers) by applying place value strategies and properties of operations.
Example: 43 + 34 + 57 + 24 = __
- Using concrete models to show addition and subtraction 
- Mentally add 10 or 100 to a given number 100–900, and mentally subtract 10 or 100 from a given number 100–900
- Fluently add and subtract within 1000 using strategies and algorithms based on place value properties of operations, and/or the relationship between addition and subtraction
- Multiplication as repeated addition
For those who follow the Core curriculum, this maps to the following core standards - 2.OA.B.2, 2.NBT.4, 2.OA.2, 1.OA.6, 2.OA.C.3, 2.OA.1, 2.NBT.6, 2.NBT.7, 2.NBT.8, 3.NBT.2.
Subscription info:
- Math Balance can be purchased standalone, or as part of a makkajai Genius subscription. 
- Makkajai Genius subscriptions are auto-renewable and annual. ($59.99/yr) 
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase
- Cancellation will not go into effect until the end of the monthly billing cycle
For support, questions or comments, write to us at: support@makkajai.com
Our privacy policy can be found at: http://www.makkajai.com/privacy-policy and our terms can be found at: https://www.makkajai.com/terms

bluejetty:00171337:ios.description:
Welcome to the "Princess Doll House". These are girly games about home design, style and cooking, created especially for girls aged 5 and over. Our exciting fashion games invite young players into the world of a modern princess, living in a stylish house rather than a traditional dream castle.
Games for teen girls are a great opportunity to explore the world of beauty, design and arrangement of your space, while creating your own princess story.
The Dollhouse games takes young players on an exciting adventure filled with creativity and fun. The main essence of fashion games is interactive interaction with various objects found in the princess house. You can rearrange furniture and other interior items, change the room design and arrange your home.
In the first edition of games “Interior design”, two rooms await you - the kitchen and the living room. In future updates we plan to add other interesting locations, including the bathroom and bedroom.
Fun games for girls start in the kitchen, where young players can move objects, cook food and even mix ingredients to create delicious dishes. Girls will be able to brew coffee, make sandwiches, bake chicken, fish, steak, and also bake muffins, cookies or pancakes! All these and many other dishes will become yours thanks to the recipes that we have prepared for you. Like a true junior chef, create culinary masterpieces for lunch or dinner!
Teen girl games “Home makeover: room decor” - features
-Dream house! Try yourself as an interior designer: your task is to furnish a house to your taste. Decorate the house and make your creative contribution to the decor - you can add furniture, change colors, customize items, and renovate the house. The interior of the apartment and the arrangement of the playhouse depends on your choice and desires.
-Fashion dress up games for girls! Choose outfits and collect looks for your doll. Young players, trying on the role of a fashionista, will dress up doll, like a real fashion stylist and designer. Hurry up, look into your wardrobe and choose the best dress and shoes for your fashion princess.
-Interesting tasks and rewards! Fulfill the princess's wishes, as well as other in-game tasks. You'll help the doll cook delicious meals, take a relaxing bath, do beauty treatments, and explore and find certain items around the fashion house.
Princess Doll House is not just a game about home decor and food making; It's an opportunity to learn new things and have fun while developing your cognitive abilities and creative talents. Offline games for girls 8 years old “Room maker and house designer” - a little princess life simulator. Fashion clothes, dressing up, apartment design, redecor and cooking games- all this awaits young players in our application. Create the beautiful home of your dreams!

bluejetty:00168545:ios.name: Bubble Rainbow: Pop & Explode
bluejetty:00168545:ios.summary: Welcome to Bubble Rainbow: Pop & Explode, where endless fun meets colorful bubbles! Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant hues and captivating bubble-popping action. Let the soothing sounds and beautiful visuals guide you through a journey
bluejetty:00168545:ios.description:
Welcome to Bubble Rainbow: Pop & Explode, where endless fun meets colorful bubbles! Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant hues and captivating bubble-popping action. Let the soothing sounds and beautiful visuals guide you through a journey of relaxation and excitement. Get ready to pop your way to victory in this addictive bubble shooter adventure!
Game Features:
-Colorful Visuals: Immerse yourself in a vibrant world filled with bright colors and captivating visuals. Let the colorful bubbles and enchanting backgrounds transport you to a realm of pure relaxation.
-Simple and Addictive Gameplay: Easy to learn but difficult to master, Bubble Rainbow offers addictive gameplay that will keep you coming back for more. Enjoy hours of bubble-popping fun without any complicated mechanics.
-Powerful Boosters: Discover a variety of powerful boosters and special bubbles to help you clear levels faster. From explosive bombs to rainbow bubbles, use them strategically to create massive chain reactions and score big points.
How to Play:
-Pop Bubbles: Aim and shoot bubbles to match three or more of the same color. Clear the board by strategically popping bubbles to create chain reactions and score big points.
-Use Power-ups: Discover powerful boosters scattered throughout the levels. Activate them strategically to clear clusters of bubbles and reach your high score goals faster.
-Progress through Levels: Embark on a journey through a variety of levels, each with its own unique layout and challenges. Test your bubble-popping skills as you advance through increasingly difficult stages.
-Earn High Scores: Aim for high scores and strive to beat your personal best with every level. Challenge yourself to achieve perfect clears and master the art of bubble popping.
-Enjoy Endless Fun: With no time limits or lives to worry about, enjoy a relaxing and stress-free gaming experience. Pop bubbles at your own pace and lose yourself in the mesmerizing world of Bubble Rainbow.
Get ready to embark on a relaxing and addictive bubble-popping adventure with Bubble Rainbow: Pop & Explode. Let the colorful bubbles mesmerize you as you pop your way to victory!

bluejetty:00159564:ios.description:
What is it?What is it?
EagleExpress is a transportation service that allows Marquette University students, faculty and staff to book free, convenient rides to and from anywhere in the Marquette campus-service area, plus the Milwaukee Intermodal Station and Eleven25 apartments, during evening service
hours. EagleExpress, the safe alternative to walking alone at night, is operated by Marquette University and powered by Via.
How does it work?
With the EagleExpress app, you will be able to select your pickup location, tell us where you want to go, select your ride, and track it in real-time. When your ride is near, you will receive a text notification that your ride has arrived. Rides are free around the Marquette campus. Book rides for yourself or small groups of up to four people. All rides must start and finish within the service zone of the Marquette campus and near neighborhood.
Take a ride on us!
Questions?
Check out more info on the Marquette website, or email us at support.eagleexpress@marquette.edu.Check out more info on the Marquette website, or email us at support.eagleexpress@marquette.edu.

bluejetty:00187667:ios.name: John Gill Expositions Bible
bluejetty:00187667:ios.summary: John Gill’s Bible Commentary app is a must have on your gadget if you desire to study the Word of God deeper and gain different perspectives. John Gill’s Bible Commentary app offers a complete exposition of the Word of God verse by verse.
bluejetty:00187667:ios.description:
John Gill’s Bible Commentary app is a must have on your gadget if you desire to study the Word of God deeper and gain different perspectives. John Gill’s Bible Commentary app offers a complete exposition of the Word of God verse by verse.
John Gill was an English Baptist pastor, a biblical scholar and a theologian who was very dedicated to the Word of God since his childhood days. His work retains influence into the 21st century. He was also argued as a hyper-Calvinist but it was an academic debate. Nonetheless, when John Gill was twelve years old, he heard a sermon from his pastor where God said to Adam, “Where art thou?” (Genesis 3:9) and the message led to his conversion.
The Word of God is an important part of our daily walk as followers of the Lord Jesus Christ. And reading it daily is for the transformation and renewal of strength of your body, soul and spirit protecting you against the works of the devil and of the flesh. The Word of God is a fountain of life, full of God’s promises to all His children. It serves as our hope, our light and our daily communication to the Father. 
And in the light of reading and studying the Word of God, there are aids to help you understand the Bible better such as Bible commentaries from other theologians. A Bible commentary is written by a commentator in a series of notes which explains the meaning of passages of Scripture and or its historical context that may reflect the beliefs and perspective of the writer.
And John Gill was one of the commentators who did exhaustive look at the Bible almost verse per verse. His writings tried to explain the passage of the Scripture considering the historical background and perspective of the Jews when the Word of God was written. 
In Hebrews 4:12, John Gill exposed, “This is to be understood of Christ, the essential Word of God; for the Word of God was a known name of the Messiah among the Jews; and therefore the apostle makes use of it when writing to them…”
Therefore, John Gill’s Bible Commentary app is useful also for those who desire to dig deeper in the Jewish roots of the Bible.
Features of the King James Bible part
1. Daily Bible Verses
Get daily notification so you can meditate on the daily Bible verse of the day. This makes you grow as a Christian.
2. Audio Bible Reading
Every Bible is unique and this one allows you to listen to the word of God as you are on the go. 
3. Highlight and Note taking
You can take notes and even have a notepad in the app which you can use daily to record your activities of the word of God.
Download John Gill’s Bible Commentary app now and enjoy a deeper study, reflection, and meditation of God’s Word for a deeper communication and fellowship with Holy Spirit.

bluejetty:00132214:ios.name: Cheatsheet: Sticky Note Widget
bluejetty:00132214:ios.summary: Cheatsheet is for the little things you never remember: hotel rooms, license plates, luggage combination, ID numbers. Write them down in Cheatsheet and then refer to them anytime in a Widget or paste them anywhere with the Custom Keyboard.
bluejetty:00132214:ios.description:
Cheatsheet is for the little things you never remember: hotel rooms, license plates, luggage combination, ID numbers. Write them down in Cheatsheet and then refer to them anytime in a Widget or paste them anywhere with the Custom Keyboard. No more fumbling to unlock your phone and find your notes app; Cheatsheet is as easy as looking at your lock screen, pulling up the keyboard, or glancing at your Apple Watch.
App Features:
• Simple UI for adding and managing your cheats.
• Over 450 icons to help you recognize what you’re looking for.
• Quickly copy a cheat by tapping-and-holding on a row.
• Search for your cheats, both in the app and in Spotlight.
• Use Shortcuts or Siri to “add notes to Cheatsheet” or “find notes in Cheatsheet”.
• Organize your cheats with folders and titles.
• Format your notes with bold, italics, lists, links, and more.
• Protect your cheats with Passcode Lock (Pro feature).
• Sync between all your iOS devices via iCloud (Pro feature).
Widgets:
• Multiple sizes, styles, and colors.
• Tap a cheat to open it. Tap the “+” button to add a cheat in the app.
• Cheatsheet also has a “Today widget” with options to copy or delete cheats.
Apple Watch:
• Add, edit, and delete cheats right from your wrist.
• Complications show your top cheat (or several cheats) right on your watch face.
• Syncs to your iPhone via iCloud (Pro feature).
Keyboard Extension:
• Shows up to 50 cheats, which you can insert anywhere you can use a custom keyboard.
• Includes space, delete, and return keys to help with simple edits.
Advanced Features:
• Automate your workflows with Shortcuts.
• Action extension: send text or URLs to Cheatsheet from any app via the share sheet.
• Customize the Cheatsheet widget’s appearance and behavior to suit your needs.
• Add or open notes from Control Center (iOS 18 required).
• URL scheme for adding a cheat: cheatsheet://add?text=everything%20is%20awesome.
Cheatsheet Pro:
• Remove limits on the widget, keyboard, and Watch app.
• Protect your cheats with Passcode Lock.
• Organize your cheats with folders.
• Sync your cheats between your devices with iCloud. 
• Cheatsheet Pro is a simple, annual subscription; there is a one-time purchase option for customers who want to avoid subscriptions. Cheatsheet for Mac is sold separately.
• Purchases help support the ongoing development of Cheatsheet — this app is beloved by its users and has over 10 years of active development by a single indie developer, so your support is truly appreciated!
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00038712:ios.summary:
La app para buscar pisos y casas, ya!
¿Buscas piso con tu pareja? ¿La familia ha crecido y necesitas una casa más grande? ¿Quieres desconectar con los tuyos en un chalet fuera de la ciudad? ¿O empezar una nueva vida en tu propio ático? Des
bluejetty:00038712:ios.description:
La app para buscar pisos y casas, ya!
¿Buscas piso con tu pareja? ¿La familia ha crecido y necesitas una casa más grande? ¿Quieres desconectar con los tuyos en un chalet fuera de la ciudad? ¿O empezar una nueva vida en tu propio ático? Descarga la nueva app de yaencontre y sé el primero en conseguir la casa que estás buscando, fácilmente, desde tu propio dispositivo móvil. 
√ Fácil de usar
yaencontre es una aplicación muy intuitiva y amigable que te permitirá buscar tu piso o casa de compra o alquiler de forma rápida y sencilla. 
√ Más de 700.000 inmuebles
Disponemos de un gran volumen y variedad de ofertas por todo el país: pisos, apartamentos, dúplex, áticos, casas, obra nueva, terrenos, locales, garajes, naves, oficinas, negocios, edificios…
√ Búsquedas personalizadas
Filtra tú búsqueda
La app te permite realizar búsquedas de pisos y casas filtrando por compra, alquiler, ubicación, precio y características de la vivienda. A través de la geolocalización de tu dispositivo la app encuentra al momento los pisos y casas que hay disponibles a tu alrededor.
Utiliza el mapa
Dibuja en el mapa la zona que te interesa y verás todos los inmuebles que hay disponibles. También podrás utilizar una geolocalización concreta, ver el precio e incluso una vista previa de las características del piso o casa. ¡Y todo ello, sin salir del mapa!
√ Crea tu propia lista de favoritos
Guarda los pisos y casas que son de tu interés y crea tu propia lista personalizada de favoritos para tenerla siempre a mano. 
√ Recibe alertas
Olvídate de estar siempre pendiente. Te avisaremos al momento para que seas el primero en enterarte de todas las novedades. Únicamente debes guardar las búsquedas que te interesan y crear alertas para que, cuando se publiquen nuevos inmuebles que coincidan con las que has guardado, recibas notificaciones al instante.
√ Vende o alquila tu inmueble gratis
Si lo que quieres es vender o alquilar tu piso o casa, utiliza la app para publicar hasta dos anuncios gratis y estarán visibles en el portal inmobiliario yaencontre.
¿A qué esperas? Descarga, prueba y puntúa la nueva app de yaencontre y encuentra tu casa ¡ya! Si echas algo en falta, estaremos muy agradecidos de que nos lo cuentes. Escríbenos a app@yaencontre.com.

bluejetty:00079417:ios.summary: Meet Motie—your adorable digital pet, here to help you on your self-care journey. With Motie, you’ll navigate through hardships and focus on your well-being to grow into the person you want to become. Stay consistent with your habits, reach
bluejetty:00079417:ios.description:
Meet Motie—your adorable digital pet, here to help you on your self-care journey. With Motie, you’ll navigate through hardships and focus on your well-being to grow into the person you want to become. Stay consistent with your habits, reach your goals, and enjoy the process in a fun, rewarding way!
WHAT MAKES MOTIE SPECIAL?
It’s not just an app—it’s a friend who’s always by your side to help you prioritize your self-care and build healthy routines. Here’s how it works:
► Habit Tracking & Daily Goals
Motie will suggest a self-care plan for the day that you can easily customize to your needs. Whether it’s just getting out of bed and drinking enough water, or doing stretches and journaling, Motie will help focus your energy on what matters most and feel empowered as you finish each step.
► Widgets for Home & Lock Screens
Don’t keep everything on your mind! Motie ensures everything is at hand with Home and Lock Screen widgets. They’ll give you a quick overview of your task list and daily progress—so you’re always one step ahead. Focus on one task at a time building a more organized and peaceful routine.
► Mood Tracking
How are you feeling today? Take a moment to check in with your emotions and reflect on your day. Learn to be gentle to yourself while building resilience for life’s ups and downs.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE MOTIE
Beyond self-care, it can also brighten your day with:
■ Themes
Customize your device with beautiful backgrounds that match your mood or style and transform your screen into a reflection of you.
■ Mini-Games
Looking for a break? Take some time to unwind with criss-cross puzzles or relaxing coloring pages.
■ Distance Widgets for Friends 
Stay connected with the people who matter most. The widget shows the distance between you and your friends in real time, allowing you to feel closer even when you’re apart.
A PLAYFUL APPROACH TO SELF-CARE
Motie adds a charm to taking control of your habits and well-being. With every small and big success, you’ll find more joy and less stress along the way. From managing your tasks to achieving personal goals, Motie is the supportive buddy you’ve been waiting for. Give yourself the gift of simple, stress-free self-care—let Motie guide you to a happier, more balanced you.
UNLIMITED ACCESS TO ALL FEATURES
– You can subscribe for unlimited access to all the app’s features.
– Subscriptions are billed weekly or annually at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan.
– Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
– Subscription auto-renewal may be turned off in the Account Settings.
By using Motie, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:

We created a unique algorithm designed for the ukulele to achieve the best quality of ukulele tuning. Because of this, our ukulele tuner allows you to tune with very high professional precision. You'll get rich and accurate tones.

Fast Ukulele Tuner

In this ukulele tuner, you'll find many settings, such as: 
- different ukulele tuning variations
- dark mode
- notation language
- reference frequency
- left-handed mode
- additional information
And much more! 
With this ukulele tuner, you'll get regular updates. We constantly monitor the quality and create improvements so you have the best ukulele tuner app.
Do you have questions or improvements for our ukulele tuner? Please send us a message at support@liketones.com
Thanks for tuning your ukulele with our app!

bluejetty:00130839:ios.description:
All the News – Australia is your personal electronic newspapers. This is the best way to keep abreast of the current economic, financial, political, social and sporting news in Australia.
• All contents of Australian electronic newspapers at hand
• Enjoy a completely revised navigation, optimized to offer a seamless experience through a streamlined interface
• Access all articles contents and view videos without ever leaving the app
• Receive news alerts in real time and share content you like in a few clicks with your family
• Find essential news in a flash and stay informed in real time
SELECT INFORMATION SOURCES
You can choose your preferred sources of information among those managed by the application. We regularly add new information sources, so do not hesitate to send us your wishes.
SEARCH AND FILTER ARTICLES
Search for articles simply by typing a few keywords. Filter articles to show only unread, videos, most popular...
FAVOURITES
Mark your favorite articles to keep them on your device and find them in one click.
SPEECH SYNTHESIS
Listen to your favorite articles in one click.
NIGHT MODE
Activate night mode to improve reading comfort when you are in a dark environment.
ACCESSIBLE ANYWHERE, EVEN OFFLINE
Once the items are loaded in Akhbar, you can access them even when you're offline. Akhbar automatically saves text content and images of your articles.
SUPPORT
We're listening.

bluejetty:00046311:ios.description:
Track your lifts. Count your calories. Beat your PRs.
Tracked is the free, all-in-one fitness app that connects your workouts and your nutrition. Log exercises, scan barcodes, track macros, hit personal records, and visualize your progress — all in one place. Built for lifters, bodybuilders, and coaches.
Whether you're focused on progressive overload, dialing in your macros, or both — Tracked gives you the tools to stay consistent. From your morning weigh-in to your post-workout protein shake, everything lives in one app.
■ Build & Track Workouts
Create unlimited workouts and exercises customized for you. Swap exercises on the fly, reorder movements, and track changes over time — even in the busiest gym. Tracked keeps a history of every modification so nothing gets lost.
■ Nutrition Tracking
Log meals, scan barcodes, and track 50+ nutrients from a database of 50,000+ verified foods (USDA & CNF). Set personalized calorie and macro goals for protein, carbs, and fat.
■ AI-Powered

■ Dive Into Your Workout History
Analyze volume per workout, strength records per rep, bodyweight PRs, and everything in between.
■ Visualize Your Progress

■ Calorie & Macro Goals

■ Track With Friends
Share workouts device-to-device in a single tap. Share your progress on social platforms and encourage others to track their lifts.

bluejetty:00141816:ios.description:
Solitaire King is a skill-based game combined with PVP gameplay to be more interesting. You can take full use of your strategy battling fairly with players from all over the world anytime and anywhere!
All players in one tournament will be matched within the same skill level, and you will share the same deck and same time limit. So better skills and strategies help you get higher scores and then win more prizes here.
HOW TO PLAY
-Move all cards to foundation pile, stacking them by suit and in sequence of A to K.
-Drag cards in the tableau (seven piles that make up the main table) to build sequences in descending order and alternating color (K to A).
-If you can no longer move any of the face-up cards, you can always tap the stockpile to see if it has any good cards for you to play.
-Keep moving cards from the tableau to the foundation piles, and stacking them up until you reach the highest possible card in each pile.
-The faster you clear the board, or the more cards you moving to the foundations – the higher your ranking will be on the Leaderboard, and the bigger the prize!
-Not all games can be solved! If you're out of moves, tap "FINISH" for maximum time bonus.
THRILLING FEATURES
-Take part in multiplayer tournaments and win grand rewards
-Leaderboard with super jackpot pool!
-Each round only takes 5 minutes and finish earlier for higher score
-Collect awesome daily gifts
-No need to wait for opponents
-Play with no distracting ads
-Undo moves
LEADERBOARD
By constantly playing different modes to win crowns, you can enter the leaderboard. The higher you rank, the more abundant prizes you will get.
TURN YOUR SKILLS INTO SUPER JACKPOT!
Download now to start your harvest journey! Free to play!
CONTACT US
-Website: https://joyboxstudio.com/
-Email: solitaireking009@gmail.com
-Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/solitairekingwinprize

bluejetty:00128435:ios.description:
For personal and small business customers of Chain Bridge Bank, N.A. If you are a commercial 
Treasury Management client of the Bank, please download the separate Chain Bridge Treasury app 
instead. 
To use this app you must be enrolled in Chain Bridge Bank, N.A. Online Banking. Personal customers

Chain Bridge Bank, N.A. business banking. 
Accounts: 
• View balances and recent activity for your Chain Bridge Bank, N.A. accounts, including checking, 
savings, money market, certificate, IRA, and business deposit accounts 
• View and save monthly statements 
Payments and transfers: 
• Deposit checks by photographing the front and back
• Transfer funds between your Chain Bridge Bank, N.A. accounts 
• Send money to friends and family through Zelle®, where enrolled 
• Pay a company through bill pay 
Cards, transactions, and alerts: 
• Reorder a Chain Bridge Bank, N.A. debit card, or turn it on or off if it is misplaced 
• See merchant names, merchant logos, and the last four digits of the card used on each transaction 
• Tag transactions, add notes, and attach photos of receipts 
• Set alerts for low balances, large transactions, deposits, and sign-in events 
Account aggregation and locations: 
• Link accounts at other banks, credit unions, and brokerages to view balances in one place 
• Find Chain Bridge Bank, N.A. branches and ATMs 
Additional features for small business customers: 
• Initiate ACH batches and wire transfers, where enabled by the Bank for your account 
• Approve payments under multi-user, dual-control workflows 
• Manage business users and assign roles, permissions, and approval thresholds

• Review positive pay exception items, where the service is enrolled

Bank.

Member FDIC.

bluejetty:00064451:ios.description:
Zombies!!! : This one's a no brainer!
• Play up to 4 friends : local and cross-platform
• Survival mode
• Build a city or play in a prebuilt city
• Expansion Pack : Not Dead Yet
Zombies!!! puts you in the middle of the action in this video game adaptation of the hit board game. 
In order to escape the ever advancing zombie horde, players must use a combination of wits and brawn to be the first to the heliport and certain escape. The only problem is, the zombies are everywhere, they appear to be very hungry and your opponents would really prefer if you didn't escape. However, there’s no need to take this horde on your own. The game allows up to 4 other human or AI players to join in on the fun. AI players can be chosen from 10 different characters, each with a unique play style.
Take on the Standard Game Mode, building your game board one tile at a time and killing zombies within the confines of the official Zombies!!! rules. Generated Town Mode drops the players into a premade town with Zombies in wait to make you their next meal. Survival Mode is the ultimate test: You versus a town full of zombies! How long can you last?
Not Dead Yet is a fun expansion on the board game that includes additional cards and animations.
If you have any questions, requests, ideas, or want to report bugs, please send us an email from ‘how to play’ menu. Or visit our support site at 
http://zombies.babaroga.com http://facebook.com/babarogagames. 
Twitter: @babarogatweet
We care deeply about this game, and if there are any suggestions about how to make it better, we will do it in future updates. We care about you, the game and your experience

Key Features of the
bluejetty:00014836:ios.description:
United Taxi is the leading provider of Taxi services in Kitchener, Ontario Canada.
We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free United Taxi ride application.
Key Features of the United Taxi application include:
• Book a trip in as few as 2 clicks
• Monitor the progress of your vehicle on a map
• Create a list of favourite addresses and assign a custom name for each
• Review all reservations you have made over the past 30 days
• Provide feedback related to the application and/or service you received
• Call United Taxi with the push of a button
To begin using the United Taxi application today:
• Download the free app
• Enter your phone number
• Validate your account (via the notification code you receive)
• Login to the app (Set your name and Email for receipts)
• Enter your pickup address
• Enter your destination address (this allows us to provide an estimated fare amount)

bluejetty:00180445:ios.description:
Mindbody is the world’s #1 booking platform for fitness, beauty, and wellness experiences. We encourage people to try new things and find what makes them feel physically, mentally, and spiritually their best.  
Whether it’s a class, salon service, or meditation session, we’ve got options.  
With over 40k+ studios around the world, we offer top fitness classes like yoga, Pilates, barre, dance, HIIT, bootcamp, and more. Looking for something along the lines of a massage, hair treatment, or cryotherapy? We’ve got that too. Plus, you’ll find promoted intro offers and last-minute deals—it’s all on the app. 
How it works: 
* Download the free app, then create a Mindbody account (or log in to your existing account) to get started. 
* Enter your location at the top of the screen to see local intro offers, price drops, and deals near you.  
* Looking for something in particular? Jump to the “SEARCH” icon at the bottom of the window to find businesses near you. From there, you can type in the desired service or browse popular categories. 
* Need to refine your results? Filter your search by business, class, date, time, distance, or category. You can also sort based on what’s recommended, top-rated or closest to you. 
* Once you select a class or appointment, you can read up on reviews, instructor & service provider bios, and how to get there. You can also choose a business first to learn more about their amenities, schedule, services, location, and pricing. 
* When you’re ready to secure your service, select the “Book” button in the right-hand corner. From there, you will be asked to confirm your payment information. Plug in your info, then hit “BOOK AND BUY” to make it official.  
Why you’ll love it: 
* Variety: You’ve got local fitness, beauty, salon, spa, and wellness options in the palm of your hand—you decide what works for you. 
* Value: You'll get the best deals to try a new studio or drop-in on a fitness class without committing to a membership. 
* Verified reviews: Know what people are saying about services before you book, with reviews from verified users.  
*Flexible Pricing available in the US only 
*Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life

bluejetty:00023523:ios.description:
Now Available: Spectro by Variable + Pantone® Color Subscription by Variable.

Created with frictionless color communication in mind, the Spectro by Variable app connects to the Spectro 1 and Spectro 1 Pro devices, allowing color professionals to achieve professional-grade color matches and view deep color data anytime, anywhere. 
About the Spectro 1 and Spectro 1 Pro Devices:
Spectro 1 is a compact, affordable color measurement tool for accurately measuring and communicating color at the professional and industrial level.
Using patented technology, the Spectro units are true spectrophotometers that deliver accuracy and repeatability comparable to expensive benchtop spectrophotometers—for a fraction of the price.
Features:
Scan, match, and compare colors
View spectral curves for scanned colors
Achieve exact matches with spectral curve and LAB values
Have access to dozens of brands like Behr, Benjamin Moore, Dulux, PPG, Sherwin-Williams in the palm of your hand
View matches under four different light sources including A, F2, D50, and D65 (Incandescent, fluorescent, horizon, and noon daylight)
Include 2 & 10 degree observations
Store scans and scan data 
Export scan history, inspection history, and saved colors
Save and export spectral curve data in 10 nm increments between 400-700 nm
Create and store standards through the Saved Colors features
Supports multiple dE formulas
And much more!

- WHERE, WHAT & HOW TO SHOP 
- NIGHTLIFE ACTIVITIES 
- CITY TIPS, MOVING AROUND, COMMUTING 
- SAFETY TIPS 
- IPHONE, IPOD TOUCH & IPAD COMPATIBILITY 
------------------------------------------ 
PRODUCT DESCRIPTION 
Stop carrying heavy city tours guide in your pocket. TRAVEL LIGHT!!! 
With eTips Travel Guides you have a full city guide in your iPhone, iPod Touch or iPad. 
This tourist guide is built to be used offline. No connection to Internet required, meaning no extra charges in your phone bill!! 
AUGMENTED REALITY, unlike other tourist guides you will be able to discover the city with the best iPhone and iPad tool - AR - Just click on the AR button, turn yourself 360° and view on the screen where the best spots are and how to find them. You can also scroll up and down to view the closest and furthest attraction. 
After many requests, we bring to you your own steps with a GPS feature. Do not get lost, just take a look where you are standee. 
It is a very practical city guide since it is designed to be used by itineraries. There are 4 different itineraries for the city depending on the duration of your journey. We also provide tips and advices to travellers, how to get into the city, how to move around, where to shop, where to go at night, most popular places, safety tips, etc... 
Unlike other guides, eTips Travel Guide provides you with interactive zoomable OFFLINE MAPS (x6 zoom + GPS capable) of the region showing the attractions, public bus stops, restaurants, pubs, hotels, hospitals and many other useful points of interest. You cannot get lost!. With this guide, you will not only visit the city but also move around its region. 
Tourist info for must see attractions such as Prague Castle, St. Vitus Cathedral, St. George's Basilica, Malá Strana, Old Town Square, Church of Our Lady before Týn, Prague Astronomical Clock, Jan Hus monument, Charles Bridge, Jewish Quarter, Old New Synagogue, High Synagogue, Old Jewish Cemetery, Spanish Synagogue, New Town, Wenceslas Square, Prague, Kutna Hora, Olomouc, Benešov, among others. 
The travel guide is made based on travelers advices. Unlike other city guides, we can guarantee we have already visited these places and would like to give you a fancy and practical tool to make your visit a more enjoyable one. 
If you have any information or feedback or if you want to see something new, please feel free to contact us at: contact@etips.com 
Discover more travel apps at www.etips.com
Follow us @ www.facebook.com/etips.travel

bluejetty:00040207:ios.summary:
VPN Freedom protects your connection with one tap and hides your IP address. No ads, no account, no activity logs.
VPN Freedom is paid for by its subscribers, not by advertisers: the app never shows ads, and there is nothing to sell about
bluejetty:00040207:ios.description:
VPN Freedom protects your connection with one tap and hides your IP address. No ads, no account, no activity logs.
VPN Freedom is paid for by its subscribers, not by advertisers: the app never shows ads, and there is nothing to sell about you. Pick a country, tap to connect, and the traffic of every app on your device goes through an encrypted OpenVPN tunnel. Sites see our server, not you.
WHAT YOU GET
• No ads, ever: no banners, no videos between connections and no advertising software inside
• Servers in many countries: choose the country you connect through, and VPN Freedom picks the least busy server there
• Unlimited data: no data caps and no speed caps
• No activity logs: our VPN servers keep no logs of the sites you visit, your traffic, your DNS lookups or your IP address
• Ad and tracker blocker: turn it on, and while you are connected, ads and known trackers stop loading in every app
• Incognito browser: a built-in browser that keeps no history, cookies or cache; leave it and everything is gone
• IP information: see the IP address and location that sites see, pinned on a map
• OpenVPN over UDP or TCP: UDP for speed, TCP when a network blocks UDP
• No account: no sign-up, no email, no password
A VPN THAT WORKS FOR YOU, NOT FOR ADVERTISERS
VPN Freedom contains no advertising software and does not use your device's advertising ID. To run the service we keep only an anonymous account, your subscription status, app statistics and crash reports, never what you do online.
ONE TAP, EVERY APP COVERED
Open VPN Freedom, tap once and you are protected. On public Wi-Fi in hotels, cafés and airports, VPN Freedom hides your IP address and encrypts your traffic, so your browsing stays private. If a network blocks the connection, switch from UDP to TCP right on the home screen.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Terms of Service: https://vpnfree.app/tos.html
Privacy Policy: https://vpnfree.app/privacy.html

• Two different types of beverages: juice and soda

• Addictive time management gameplay

It’s lunch time! People are excited to visit your new burger shop and try the delicious hamburgers everyone has been talking about! Check the ingredients and get ready to serve the customers a delightful meal of their favorite sandwich recipes!

In My Burger Shop you’ll run the hottest fast food restaurant in town. Manage to serve your clients with your restaurant’s tasty specialties: delicious hamburgers and cheeseburgers -- with extra cheese, onions, pickles, tomatoes and, of course, a lot of bacon! And what about some French fries? Complete the order with a refreshing drink, juice or soda!

Serve your customers with an efficient service to earn coins that you can use to buy new ingredients and other items to customize your shop. Paint the walls, change the floor, buy new trays, lights and much more. You can also unlock new ingredients to make even more burgers and let your business grow.

My Burger Shop is the most fun time management, fast food restaurant and hamburger making game, download now and check it for yourself!

HIGHLIGHTS
• Many ingredients to choose from, just like in a real burger shop: bread, cheese, crispy burgers, chicken patties, lettuce, onions, pickles, even sausages and much more.
• Customizable items to give the store the look you want
• Two different types of beverages: juice and soda
• Serve weird and funny customers
• Addictive time management gameplay
• Lots of bacon -- everyone loves bacon, right?

Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.

Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq

bluejetty:00156849:ios.description:
St. Louis Public Radio App: 
The St. Louis Public Radio App allows you to listen to St. Louis Public Radio live, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule for all the St. Louis Public Radio streams at once! You can explore On Demand content, search for stories, bookmark a story for later, and wake up to St. Louis Public Radio with the alarm clock!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from St. Louis Public Radio even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing – no clicks to start listening.
• Integrated program schedules for every station. You can display up to three of your favorites at a time or flick once to see the schedules for all of your favorite stations.
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
• Listen to St. Louis Public Radio in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
On Demand
• Access public radio programs from multiple content providers (NPR, PRI, APM and St. Louis Public Radio) easily and quickly.
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease. 
• When listening to national programs, individual story segments (when available) are listed so you can review and choose one or listen to the entire program.
• Easy to access past programs.
• The St. Louis Public Radio App displays the web page associated with the program or story segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
Radio Bookmarks
• Save what you were listening to (Live or On Demand) so you can replay, follow-up, or share it later by simply clicking “Bookmark”.
• Compatible with the popular Radio Bookmark device (www.radiobookmark.com).
Search
• The unique “Search Public Radio” feature finds stories or programs across hundreds of stations and web pages and makes it easy to play instantly.
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The St. Louis Public Radio App is brought to you by the people at St. Louis Public Radio and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, and where you want it.
Please support St. Louis Public Radio by becoming a member today!
http://www.stlpublicradio.org
http://www.publicmediaapps.com

bluejetty:00090926:ios.description:
BlockP – Website & App Blocker for Focus & Digital Wellness
BlockP is a powerful website and app blocker designed to help you stay focused, reduce digital distractions, build healthier screen habits, and improve productivity.
Whether you're working, studying, or simply trying to spend less time on distracting websites and apps, BlockP gives you the tools to stay in control of your digital environment.
FEATURES
WEBSITE BLOCKER
Block distracting websites across supported browsers to create a more focused browsing experience.
Choose from built-in categories or create your own custom blocklists to match your goals.
App Blocker
Reduce interruptions by blocking selected apps during work, study, or personal focus sessions.
Create schedules or activate blocking whenever you need uninterrupted time.
Focus Mode
Start distraction-free focus sessions with a single tap.
Focus Mode temporarily blocks selected apps and websites so you can concentrate on what matters most.
Custom Blocking Rules
Personalize your experience by adding websites, apps, and schedules that fit your daily routine.
Accountability
Stay motivated by inviting a trusted accountability partner who can help encourage consistency with your goals.
Progress Tracking
Monitor your activity, maintain streaks, and celebrate milestones as you build healthier digital habits.
Community
Connect with others who are working toward better focus, productivity, and balanced technology use.
Learning Resources
Discover practical articles and tips on:
• Improving focus
• Building better habits
• Reducing digital distractions
• Time management
• Productivity techniques
Panic Mode
Need an immediate break from distractions?
Temporarily block access to selected websites and apps so you can quickly return to your priorities.
Daily Reports
Receive helpful progress summaries that highlight your consistency and focus over time.
Security & Protection
BlockP helps ensure your blocking rules remain active with notifications if important permissions or protection settings change.
Why Choose BlockP?
• Block distracting websites
• Block selected apps
• Improve productivity
• Reduce screen time
• Build healthier digital habits
• Create personalized blocking schedules
• Stay accountable
• Track progress with streaks
• Support long-term focus and consistency
Whether you're working, studying, or building better habits, BlockP helps create a distraction-free digital environment.
Permissions
BlockP uses Apple's Network Extension framework to apply website filtering. Permission is required to enable website blocking and related protection features.
Subscription
BlockP is free to download.
Premium features are available through an optional subscription that unlocks advanced blocking tools, accountability features, detailed insights, and additional customization.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the renewal date. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime from your Apple ID settings.
Support : support@blockp.io
Terms of Use : https://blockp.io/terms-and-condition/
Privacy Policy : https://blockp.io/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00157497:ios.description:
Export your WhatsApp chats into a PDF in seconds! 100% private.
Ever wanted to print out your messages?
Or tried to search through your chat history? 
Or just want to create a readable backup of your chat history?
Create PDFs from your WhatsApp chats right on your iPhone! No uploads. No accounts. No waiting.Perfect for saving memories, sending to friends, collecting study notes or archiving chats.
**100% On-Device & Private** Everything stays on your iPhone. We never see your messages. No login, no ads, no data collection
Simply export your WhatsApp chat into ChatPDF then:
- Select the sender
- Select the start and end dates for the messages 
- Select the page size (A4, Letterhead or even your iPhone screen size!)
- Select the optional printer friendly format, ie black and white
Then a PDF of your WhatsApp chat is created which you can export to your preferred PDF-viewing app! Now you can search through your chat history with ease. Or just print out the PDF the old fashioned way.
IN-APP PURCHASE
One-time purchase to unlock exporting of the created PDF files
NOTE
ChatPDF only supports exporting the chat history from WhatsApp.
ChatPDF does not support iMessage or other messaging apps.
PRIVACY
ChatPDF only stores data locally on your device and does not rely on any network connections. No sign-ups, no accounts, no ads.
DISCLAIMER
ChatPDF is not affiliated with WhatsApp or its respective legal entities

bluejetty:00060774:ios.name: World English Bible: WEB
bluejetty:00060774:ios.summary:
World English Bible is a free updated revision of the American Standard Version
The World English Bible (also known as the WEB) is a free updated revision of the American Standard Version (ASV) 1901. It is one of the few public domain, mod
bluejetty:00060774:ios.description:
World English Bible is a free updated revision of the American Standard Version
The World English Bible (also known as the WEB) is a free updated revision of the American Standard Version (ASV) 1901. It is one of the few public domain, modern-English translations of the entire Bible, and it is freely distributed to the public using electronic formats. The Bible was created by volunteers using the ASV as the base text.
The World English Bible claims to be one of the few English-language Bibles custom translated to be understood by most English-speakers worldwide, eliminating the need for data-processing based or computer operating system-specific internationalizations. Work on the World English Bible began in 1997 and it was first known as the American Standard Version 1997.
The World English Bible project was started in order to produce a modern English Bible version that is not copyrighted, does not use archaic English (such as the KJV), and is not translated into Basic English (such as the Bible In Basic English). The World English Bible follows the American Standard Version's decision to transliterate the Tetragrammaton, but uses "Yahweh" instead of "Jehovah" throughout the Old Testament. The British and Messianic Names editions as well as the Apocryphal books and New Testament use the traditional forms (e.g., the LORD).
The work is based on the 1901 American Standard Version English translation, the Greek Majority Text, and the Hebrew Biblia Hebraica Stuttgartensia with some minor adjustments made because of alternate readings found in the Dead Sea Scrolls and the Septuagint. These alternate readings are usually ignored or restricted to the footnotes. The translation process included seven passes of editing and proofreading for each book. An initial automated pass updated approximately 1,000 archaic words, phrases and grammatical constructs. The first manual pass added quotation marks (the ASV had none) and other punctuation and compared the translation to the Greek and Hebrew texts in areas where significant textual variants or meanings were unclear.
Benefits of application:
- The application works without an internet connection (offline);
- Ability to search;
- Ability to increase / decrease the font;
- Ability to create an unlimited number of tabs to a particular verse, one of the books;
- If you are interested in the allocation of poems you can copy or send a message;
- Ability to scroll through the volume buttons.
Our team is not in place, and aims to expand its functional applications.
User guide:
Each menu item is a separate book, and each separate page in one of the books is the chapter.
Place the cursor instead of the chapter number and enter the chapter number. Thus, you will not have to scroll all the chapters, selecting interesting.

Privacy Policy - http://apple.nsource.by/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00151444:ios.summary: Aplicativo Uptime Condomínios para gerenciamento de condomínios: Ele integra o pacote de serviços disponíveis ao seu condomínio, proporcionando a automatização de rotinas aliada à praticidade e economia para todos. O aplicativo Uptime permi
bluejetty:00151444:ios.description:
Aplicativo Uptime Condomínios para gerenciamento de condomínios: Ele integra o pacote de serviços disponíveis ao seu condomínio, proporcionando a automatização de rotinas aliada à praticidade e economia para todos. O aplicativo Uptime permite automatizar as rotinas do condomínio como:
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- visão da lista de funcionários do condomínio,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- gestão e publicação das manutenções preventivas,
- gestão e publicação dos contratos,
- gestão e publicação das finanças (fluxo de caixa),
- publicação do balancete interativo,
- publicação dos boletos das taxas mensais,
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota,
- integração com controles de acesso e muito mais!
Tudo isso para dar mais transparência e eficiência à gestão de condomínios.
Todas as mensagens geram notificação pelo aplicativo e por e-mail, bem como sua entrega e leitura são disponibilizadas no painel da administração.
Para se cadastrar como morador no aplicativo, é preciso que o seu condomínio já esteja cadastrado em nossa base.
Se tiver dúvidas entre em contato conosco!

bluejetty:00073529:ios.description:
Book thousands of hotels, earn rewards, and manage your stay—all in one convenient app.
Whether you're planning a weekend getaway, family vacation, or business trip, the Wyndham Hotels & Resorts app makes travel easier. Browse and book stays around the world, access exclusive member rates, and enjoy helpful in-stay features designed to simplify your travel experience.
SEARCH & BOOK WITH EASE
• Find and book hotels worldwide in just a few taps.
• Add your favorite hotels to your wishlist for faster booking.
• Save your preferences to make planning even easier.
• Compare hotels using interactive map and list views to find the right stay for every trip.
• Access exclusive offers and member-only rates.
MANAGE YOUR STAY
• Check in and out directly from your phone at select hotels.
• Use digital tipping to recognize staff for great service at select hotels.
• Message the front desk with requests and questions at select hotels.
• Discover local recommendations and activities during your stay.
• Order food delivery from nearby restaurants at select hotels.
GET MORE WITH WYNDHAM REWARDS
• Track your points, stays, and account activity in real time.
• Earn points for every qualified stay—that’s 10 points per dollar or 1,000 points, whichever is more.
• Redeem points for free and discounted nights at thousands of hotels, vacation club resorts, and vacation rentals around the world.
• Unlock exclusive member savings and special offers available only through Wyndham Rewards.
Not a Wyndham Rewards member? Join for free in the app and start earning and redeeming points at our participating hotel brands:
AmericInn®, Baymont®, Days Inn®, Dazzler®, Dolce Hotels and Resorts®, Esplendor®, Hawthorn Extended Stay®, Howard Johnson®, La Quinta®, Microtel®, Ramada®, Registry Collection Hotels, Super 8®, Trademark Collection®, Travelodge®, TRYP®, Vienna House®, WaterWalk Extended Stay®, Wingate®, Wyndham, Wyndham Alltra, Wyndham Garden®, Wyndham Grand®, and select Caesars Entertainment properties.
