bluejetty:00178145:ios.name: Disneyland® Paris
bluejetty:00178145:ios.summary:
Whether you’re planning your visit or you’re already in the heart of the magic, the Disneyland Paris app turns your phone into a magic wand that will help you prepare your stay and enjoy your day! 
BEFORE YOU ARRIVE
 • Buy and store your P
bluejetty:00178145:ios.description:
Whether you’re planning your visit or you’re already in the heart of the magic, the Disneyland Paris app turns your phone into a magic wand that will help you prepare your stay and enjoy your day! 
BEFORE YOU ARRIVE
 • Buy and store your Park Tickets.
 • Manage your Hotel booking and begin your check-in to save time on the day.
 • Buy and store Disney Premier Access Ultimate to get in the fast lane one time on multiple attractions, whenever you want.
 • Reserve your spot at the Super Hero Station (for Guests staying at Disney Hotel New York – The Art of Marvel).
 • Get tailor-made recommendations with Disney® Picks and create a Wishlist to tick off your favourites one by one on the day.
 • Find information about accessibility conditions for each attraction.
DURING YOUR VISIT
 • Check wait times for attractions and show times. 
 • Use our interactive map and filters to find attractions, restaurants, shops, shows and Meet 'n' Greets.
 • Buy Disney Premier Access One or Disney Premier Access Ultimate to get speedy access to some of our most popular attractions.
 • Enlist for a training session at the Hero Training Center at Marvel Avengers Campus.
 • See your upcoming and past Disney Premier Access time slots and access your QR codes in "My Plans".
ENJOY A DISNEYLICIOUS EXPERIENCE
 • Book a table for your visit (up to 2 months ahead, or 12 months for Disney Hotel Guests).
 • Order your food in advance and pick it up later at certain counter-service restaurants.
 • Search restaurants by type of cuisine or mealtime.
 • Browse restaurant menus. 
 • See eligible restaurants if you have Meal Plan.
STAY IN THE KNOW 
 • Get notifications with timely reminders about your bookings, real-time information about shows and attractions on the day, info about our upcoming seasons and events, and much more!
 • See all the benefits of your Annual Pass including discounts, special events and days you can visit.
Please note: when using this app, you will be given the option to receive notifications, activate location-based services, create or sign in to a Disney Account and have your information stored in cache to improve your experience in the app.
Privacy policy: http://www.disneylandparis.co.uk/legal/privacy-policy-mobile/ 
Disneyland® Paris park rules: http://www.disneylandparis.co.uk/legal/theme-parks-rules/

bluejetty:00086821:ios.description:
We want to inspire you to be healthy and happy.
To make sure you get the most out of your SATS membership, we aim to deliver better training experiences through this app.
GET INSPIRED
Discover new classes, check out PTs or go straight to one of your most booked sessions. Want an extra push? Try joining one or several challenges. Maybe you are like us and feel inspired when you train with friends? Add friends, see their group classes or invite them to yours. Like and comment their training to motivate each other*.
*The social experience is optional and can be turned off completely.
SEARCH, FIND & BOOK WORKOUTS\nFind and book the perfect group class or book a PT that can help you on your way to reach your goals, all added to your personal calendar if you want to. If you book a class and something changes, we will notify you from the app.
THE KEY TO THE GYM
Use the app as a partner to the clubs, log in with your personal QR code, which can also be found on your wearable.
KEEP TRACK
Activities that are performed at our clubs are automatically added; check-ins, group classes and PT sessions.
While your activities outside are also easy to add manually in the app.
SEE AND USE YOUR REWARDS
In SATS you earn extra benifits and discounts for working out or being loyal! All these can be found and used from the app.
---------------------------------
We will continue to upgrade this app frequently, so stay tuned for updates! 
Do you have feedback about the app? Then tell us what you think. You can do this directly in the app.

bluejetty:00014203:ios.description:
Force Fleet is the ideal GPS vehicle tracking and dashcam video solution for business owners like you. Track your drivers and employees in the field, monitor the health and performance of your business vehicles, and protect your business from liability.
*Note: This app is designed for existing Force Fleet customers and requires an active LTE connected GPS Tracker and/or TrakView Dashcam device. To learn more, visit forcefleet.com.
Track your vehicles in real time
Location Sharing Links: send your customers a link allowing them to track a specific vehicle on its way to a service call
Live GPS Tracking: Vehicle locations updated on a map, every 10 seconds
Trip History: Start / stop, route, distance, duration, gas mileage, speed, and driving behavior
Location Alerts: Set up geofences (virtual boundaries) and get a notification upon entry or exit 
Monitor your vehicle health
Engine Diagnostics: DTC (Diagnostic Trouble Codes) with descriptions
Maintenance Records & Recalls: list of all the recommended services for at each mileage interval, plus alerts for OEM notices
TireCheck: patented feature for monitoring tire tread depth using your mobile device’s camera
Ensure safer driving and better security
Driver Safety Scores and Reports: coach safer driving habits with RoadScore on every trip
Speeding Alerts: Get real-time speeding alert notifications based on the driver and the vehicle
Disturbance Alerts: Instant notifications if any of your vehicles is bumped, towed, broken into, or otherwise disturbed while parked.
NEW TrakView Dashcam Features
Automatic Trip Recording: Automatically records entire trip on local memory
Driving Event Clips: Harsh braking rapid acceleration, crashes, and disturbances are categorized in the Clips section for easy access 
Dashcam Live View: See what’s happening inside and out of your vehicles from your phone or computer, 24/7.
Video Clip Finder: Easily go back in time to find the video clips that matter to your business.
Crash Detection and Alerts: Get an alert on your phone if a vehicle is involved in an accident. Utilizes the world’s most advanced crash detection algorithm, developed and certified by Bosch.

Securely manage your remote workforce with instant provisioning of company or employee-owned devices and unmanaged contractor endpoints. 
Mitigate risk
Mitigate breach risks with zero trust secure access. Deliver continuous verification of user and device identity and trust to reduce attack surface.
Enable remote work productivity
Empower employees with streamlined access, increased security and upgraded performance compared to traditional VPN technology.

bluejetty:00185937:ios.name: ARia's Legacy - AR Escape Room
bluejetty:00185937:ios.summary: ARia’s Legacy is the first mobile escape room game using fully immersive AR. Instead of displaying objects on a table in front of you, it creates a virtual environment around your physical space that has you walking around your room discove
bluejetty:00185937:ios.description:
ARia’s Legacy is the first mobile escape room game using fully immersive AR. Instead of displaying objects on a table in front of you, it creates a virtual environment around your physical space that has you walking around your room discovering parts that were never there before. Through the power of ARKit, you can immerse yourself in different levels of mystery using an iPhone or iPad, as you uncover the story behind ARia’s sudden disappearance and discover her legacy.
In ARia's Legacy, you are part of a team of archaeologists excitedly looking for artifacts at your newest archaeological site. Suddenly, your shovel strikes a chest that you quickly unearth with the help of various tools around you. But when you try to open it, you are seemingly thrown into a locked room that is at once familiar and eerily foreign to you.
Your only clue seems to be the chest that you found and the name “ARia" ringing in your head.
Check out your private investigator skills & check every scene and object to find the clues, solve the mystery puzzle, and inspect objects anywhere around you. The ARia’s legacy mystery game required patience skills to solve the scenes quickly and escape out. 
The AR room camera game has lots of mysterious levels, each designed with unique exit plans. Explore the location carefully and combine various clues to find the way out!
==> Features of ARia's Legacy Escape Room - AR Camera Game
- Easy to play! But hard to master.
- A lot of exciting puzzles, each with unique challenges.
- Different mysteries to solve.
- High-quality game graphics.
- If you have difficulty finding the escape route! Hints are available to help you to find the items. 
==> Permissions:
- Full Network Access 
- Camera 
If you feel generous and have a couple of minutes, please leave us a review (hopefully five stars). It makes a huge difference in supporting us. For more suggestions related to this game, contact us at support@afternoonapps.com or join our discord channel at https://bit.ly/ARia-Discord. 
Thank you in advance! :)

bluejetty:00039708:ios.description:
Echo is an anonymous secret-sharing and chat application where users can create their virtual avatars and chat with AI characters. 
What you need to know about Echo: 
- Customize your virtual identity for anonymous interactions. 
- Get guidance from AI secret guardians. 
- Enjoy open and honest secret exchanges. 
- Random matching to find soulmates. 
- Private chats via voice and video calls. 
Why choose Echo? 
Echo encourages bold communication and genuine self-expression. Enjoy authentic social chats by anonymously sharing your secrets and receiving genuine feedback from others, and engage in private video chats. For users who prefer not to interact with real people, you can confide in virtual AI characters, ensuring your secrets remain completely confidential.
Anonymous Connections on Echo
Echo provides a platform to share secrets with anonymous users worldwide. By sharing deeply hidden desires and engaging in chats, you can establish meaningful connections and find encouragement and growth in anonymous sharing.
AI Secret Guardian
Echo offers a direct and immediate way to share secrets through direct communication with an AI. The AI secret guardian approaches all secrets with complete neutrality, ensuring that your secrets are fully protected while providing profound and inspiring answers that encourage self-exploration and reflection. Whether you choose to share with a real person or a virtual AI character, Echo supports you in fully expressing yourself and receiving responses.
Privacy Protection by Echo
At Echo, your privacy is paramount. All shared secret information and chats with AI characters (including photos and audio) are retained within Echo's anonymous world and are not stored on your device, ensuring the confidentiality of your interactions.
- Echo In-App Purchases
Purchase virtual diamond currency for the app, which can be used for in-app benefits and virtual items. It is valid indefinitely and cannot be transferred.
For more information, please visit our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service:

bluejetty:00180611:ios.description:
Welcome to the MyClinCard app for the ClinCard® Prepaid Visa.
Now that you are set up to receive payments and reimbursements in real time with the ClinCard® reloadable debit card, the MyClinCard app will enable you to securely and conveniently access financial details and complete additional ClinCard® account-related activities. 
Key Features:
● View recent transaction history
● Retrieve or change your PIN
● Transfer funds from your card to your bank account
● Download account statements
● Set up alerts for your card
● Replace a lost, stolen or damaged card
● Contact support
● Review FAQs
Please note that this app only supports the ClinCard® Prepaid Visa. For ClinCard® Prepaid Mastercard support, please call +1-866-952-3795 or visit https://consumercardaccess.com/myclincard.

bluejetty:00011148:android.description:
From authors of offroad simulator series! New offroad simulator game with the most realistic driving physics, especially for offroad driving lovers. Enjoy offroad car simulator 3, drive cars in different environments, speed driving on the offroad adventures. 
Explore huge world of driving a car or just get out of the car and walk through them. 
There are 11 characters: you are free to choose the driver you like! One of them will become the best hero driver for your offroad cars.
Driver can move in garage, change and select cars, customize them, paint them. You can walk in different environments getting out from the car and then sit again to enjoy driving!
You can drive car in different environments:
 - Desert
 - Ruins
 - Winterland
 - Military
 - Railway Station
 - Mountains
Select one of the cars from this amazing collection:
 - Dodge
 - G63
 - Gle
 - Tesla
 - X5
This game brings realistic and detailed graphics, you will get offroad cars with amazing look. But what is the most important, you can customize your car design and technical part by your needs. Here is the complete list of customization features:
 - Car body colors
 - Wheel colors
 - Glass colors
 - Suspension
 - Car height
 - Wheel sizes and angles
 - Engine
 - Brakes
 - Tyres
 - Controls
 - Assisting systems
Good luck driver! Select your character and drive these amazing cars! 
Feel the real car driving simulation!

bluejetty:00160338:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00160338:ios.description:
금캐기 - 가만히 있어도 금이 쌓이는 손쉬운 돈버는 리워드 앱!
금캐기는 아무런 조작 없이 자동으로 금을 채굴해주는 혁신적인 리워드 앱입니다. 채굴된 금은 실물 금으로 교환하거나 다양한 기프티콘으로 바꿀 수 있어 편리하게 수익을 얻을 수 있습니다. 지금 카카오톡 로그인으로 3초 만에 시작해보세요!
주요 기능
▶ 24시간 자동 금 채굴
앱을 실행하지 않아도 자동으로 금이 채굴됩니다. 금캐기는 앱을 켜둘 필요가 없어 언제 어디서나 가만히 있는 동안에도 금을 쌓아갈 수 있는 특별한 시스템을 제공합니다. 잊고 있다가 다시 접속해도 금이 차곡차곡 쌓여있는 모습을 확인할 수 있습니다.
▶ 기프티콘 및 실물 금 교환
모아둔 금은 다양한 기프티콘으로 교환할 수 있으며, 원한다면 실물 금으로도 바꿀 수 있습니다. 커피, 간식, 생활용품 등 다양한 기프티콘을 손쉽게 구매하거나, 쌓인 금을 실제 금으로 전환하여 더 의미 있는 보상을 누려보세요.
▶ 채굴 속도 업그레이드
금캐기에서는 추가 채굴기를 장착하여 채굴 속도를 높일 수 있습니다. 더 많은 양의 금을 짧은 시간 안에 채굴하고 싶은 사용자들에게 최적화된 기능으로, 추가 채굴기 사용 시 금이 쌓이는 속도가 눈에 띄게 증가합니다.
▶ 친구 초대로 더 많은 금 적립
친구를 초대하면 친구가 채굴한 금의 일부가 내 금으로 추가 적립됩니다. 친구와 함께 사용하면 채굴 속도가 더 빨라지고, 초대된 친구와 함께 더 많은 수익을 쌓아가실 수 있습니다. 친구와 공유하고 혜택을 함께 누려보세요!
▶ 금 시세 및 차트
매일 업데이트되는 금 시세와 차트를 통해 금의 흐름을 쉽게 파악할 수 있습니다. 안정적인 정보를 제공하며, 금 시세에 따라 보상의 가치를 효율적으로 관리할 수 있습니다.
금 시세 예측: 오늘 금 시세가 상승할지, 하락할지를 예측해보세요. 정확히 맞출 경우 특별한 보상이 기다리고 있습니다!
▶ 명예의 전당
금캐기를 통해 가장 많은 금을 모은 사용자들의 기록을 확인할 수 있는 명예의 전당이 준비되어 있습니다. 자신의 채굴 성과를 자랑하고, 다른 유저들과 경쟁하며 금 모으기의 동기부여를 받아보세요.
▶ 채굴가방: 추가 발견된 광물 보관 및 판매
채굴 중 발견되는 광물은 채굴가방에 보관됩니다.
보관된 광물을 판매하여 추가 금액을 획득하고, 수익을 더욱 극대화하세요.
▶ 카카오톡 간편 로그인
회원가입 절차 없이, 카카오톡 간편 로그인으로 금캐기를 시작할 수 있습니다. 단 3초면 로그인 완료! 번거로운 절차 없이 바로 금 채굴을 시작하세요.
금캐기 앱의 장점
편리함: 자동 채굴 기능으로 따로 신경 쓸 필요 없이 금이 쌓입니다.
다양한 보상: 기프티콘부터 실물 금까지 원하는 방식으로 금을 사용할 수 있습니다.
초대 보너스: 친구와 함께하면 더욱 빠르게 금을 모으고 적립할 수 있습니다.
간편한 접근성: 카카오톡 로그인을 통해 누구나 쉽게 사용할 수 있습니다.
지금 금캐기를 다운로드하여, 새로운 방식으로 손쉽게 금을 모으고 돈을 벌어보세요.

bluejetty:00027663:ios.description:
FirstSeed Calendar keeps your events and reminders in one place. It’s fast, flexible, and built so you can handle most tasks with one hand.
Features:
- Month view that handles everyday tasks with one hand
- Week view that fits the whole week on one screen, with no vertical scrolling
- Day, list, and year views, including a list view laid out like a paper planner
- Events and reminders together in one calendar
- Move or duplicate events to multiple dates at once
- Respond to invitations right from the app
- Daily Summary notifications for today’s or tomorrow’s events
- Home Screen, Lock Screen, StandBy, and interactive widgets, including a timeline widget
- Control Center controls
- Apple Watch app with complications
- Dark mode, custom themes, and colors for weekends and holidays
- Designed for Liquid Glass, with clear and tinted icons and widgets
Pro: One-Time Purchase, No Subscription:
- Sync directly with Google Calendar, including per-event colors
- Trash: recover deleted events and reminders for up to 30 days
- Automatic backups of your calendar data
- Quick Event: create events by typing naturally, like “Lunch with Bob at noon tomorrow”

bluejetty:00114859:ios.name: Redirect It! - Logic Puzzle
bluejetty:00114859:ios.summary:
► FOLLOW THAT ARROW
Get your mind and fingers set to untangle mazes of arrows in the fun take on a traditional maze escape game. Each level you’ll square off against an increasingly tangled knot of arrows, and you’ll need to put all of you
bluejetty:00114859:ios.description:
► FOLLOW THAT ARROW
Get your mind and fingers set to untangle mazes of arrows in the fun take on a traditional maze escape game. Each level you’ll square off against an increasingly tangled knot of arrows, and you’ll need to put all of your logic skills to the test as you figure out which order to remove them, thus clearing the way for the rest. Fear not though, this puzzle is minimalistic and relaxing, not cluttered and stressful. 
► MASTER THE MAZE
Colorful arrows twist and turn around each other, and it’s up to you to figure out which way they’re headed and help them escape from the puzzle grid, making way for others to be moved as well. Levels start off with just a few arrows, and quickly work up to more and more, keeping things interesting. While the puzzle required you to use your logic skills and brain, it still manages to be relaxing and just the perfect level of challenging.
You’ll love:
● The minimalistic design – Black background, colorful arrows, and no crazy animations or over-the-top graphics – focus on the puzzle without worrying about what might pop up next. The bright arrows stand out well from the background making it easier to see how the maze all fits together, and adding a touch of whimsy to the game. Easily toggle the music and haptic on or off depending on your mood, and don’t worry about tons of popups and events cluttering your game.
● The relaxing gameplay – Each level is short and sweet, meaning you can easily squeeze one in whenever you need a distraction. Plus there’s no countdown clock to put pressure on you, so if you get stuck you can easily step away and come back to finish later when you’ve got the time and energy. Last but not least boosters are available in case you can’t quite get past a tricky level.
● The mental stimulation – While the puzzles might seem simple at first, you’ll find that they start getting challenging fast! More arrows, more twists, and more fun await as you graduate from levels with just a handful of arrows to those with dozens. All those extra colors and crazy shapes and patterns will really stimulate your brain to start looking for patterns, which can be super helpful in real life.
► A CHALLENGING ESCAPE
Ready to take on an a-maze-ing arrow puzzle that will both relax and challenge your brain? With its simple design and fun graphics you won’t feel a lick of stress as you take on this logic puzzle and help the arrows escape.
Download Redirect It! today and see how many levels of twisty, knotted up arrows you can detangle before getting stuck.

bluejetty:00168503:ios.description:
Create custom AI voices and expressive audio with Voicify.
Voicify is an AI voice generator for creating custom voices, turning text into expressive audio, and building multi-voice dialogues. Create a custom voice from a short audio sample, write what you want it to say, pick an emotion, and generate voice clips to use in your content or share with friends.
CREATE YOUR VOICE CLIP
Turn your ideas into audio in just a few steps. Write your own text or add your own recording. Then choose a voice, select an emotion, and share or download your finished voice clip.
KEY FEATURES
Custom AI voices: Create a custom AI voice from a short audio sample.
Text-to-speech: Turn written text into expressive voice clips.
Voice conversion: Record yourself and hear it in another voice.
Ready-to-use voices: Browse a collection of characters and find the right sound for your idea.
Emotions: Give each clip a mood, including happy, sad, angry, fearful, surprised, calm, and neutral.
Dialogues: Write a conversation between several voices and generate it as one audio.
Easy sharing: Download your audio or share it as a video, and use it in your own creative content.

Unlock all voices, unlimited dialogues, and an ad-free experience with Voicify Premium.
Voicify brings custom AI voices, text-to-speech, emotions, and dialogues together in one creative audio experience. Create a voice, shape the sound, and bring your ideas to life.
Voicify includes free features and optional paid upgrades. Access to Voicify Premium requires a subscription.

Use Voicify responsibly and respect the rights of others. Only upload voice samples you created, have permission to use, or are otherwise legally authorized to use. Do not use Voicify to mislead others, cause harm, or violate applicable laws or third-party rights.

bluejetty:00186095:ios.description:
Ultimate Hangman Go is a must have hangman game with 4 awesome themes (Doodle Hangman, Chillin' Chalk, Christmas Snowman and Flower Power), 11 great songs and 73 word categories including 7 random modes. 
There is also 2 player mode so you can enter your own words and play with a friend!
Have you ever wondered what it would be like if the hangman drawing came alive? That is just what happens in our Doodle Hangman theme. It has multiple animations per sequence so you never know what he will do next. Special escape animations occurs if you guess word when on ninth letter. Chillin' Chalk is our school house chalkboard theme where you get to play in landscape mode. Christmas Snowman has a snowman that disappears as wrong letters are chosen and Flower Power has flowers with parts that fly away. These last 2 themes provide for relaxing hangman play without the violence. :)
English categories include: Vocabulary Words 1, Vocabulary Words 2, Vocabulary Words 3, Vocabulary Words 4, Vocabulary Words 5, Adjectives, Verbs, Animals, Christmas & Winter, Clothes, Countries, Elements, Foods, Fruits & Veggies, Human Body, Kings & Pirates, Plants & Trees, Sports, Basic English Random, SAT I, SAT II, SAT III, SAT IV, SAT V and SAT Random.
Dutch categories include: Cars & Countries, Fruits & Vegetables and Dutch Random.
Spanish categories include: Vocabulary Words 1, Vocabulary Words 2, Adjectives, Verbs, Animals, Foods, Plants & Trees, Sports and Spanish Random.

apple-itunes:994459137.name: meteoblue weather & radar maps
apple-itunes:994459137.description:
Swiss precision & high-end weather data
More than just a simple weather forecast - experience the world's highest publicly documented forecast accuracy with meteoblue. Whether for everyday life, professional sports, agriculture or aviation - our app brings the expertise of Swiss meteorology directly to your smartphone.
meteoblue displays highly accurate weather data in a sophisticated design, intended to be intuitively navigable while providing all relevant information. Check forecasts for any location on Earth - whether in the city, on the summits of the Rocky Mountains or in the middle of the ocean.
New: The meteoblue app for Apple Watch brings you the forecast, current weather, warnings and rainSPOT right to your wrist.
WHY CHOOSE US:
1. Swiss precision: The meteoblue forecast is composed of a unique selection of physical weather models that each excel at forecasting for specific variables and areas. The proprietary meteoblue Learning MultiModel post-processing technique blends and refines their outputs down to a 10-metre resolution.
2. Worldwide coverage: Search a database of over 6 million locations. Find weather data by place name, postcode or directly via GPS coordinates.
3. Offline mode: Stay informed even when you have no reception. meteoblue automatically stores the data from your most recent queries for offline use.
EXCLUSIVE FEATURES & PROFESSIONAL TOOLS:
Live rain radar & satellite: Track precipitation in real time. Our radar map displays rain, snow, hail and thunderstorm lightning activity with the highest level of detail. The global satellite maps show cloud cover and weather.
where2go - The Sun Finder: Plan your perfect weekend getaway - find the sunniest spots in your area on an interactive map with where2go.
Multimodel meteogram: Trust is good, comparison is better. See the forecasts from the leading global weather models (NEMS, ECMWF, GFS) in a single meteogram. When the models agree, the forecast is reliable.
Accurate 7- & 14-day forecasts:
7-day overview: Hourly values for temperature, precipitation, wind and UV index.
14-day trend: Our assessment of weather developments for long-term planning is as accurate as possible.
Predictability: A scale shows you immediately how reliable the current forecast is.
Specialised meteograms:
5-day meteogram: Vertical cloud layers, wind speed and temperature curves.
All-in-one meteogram: All important parameters at a glance - ideal for outdoor enthusiasts.
TAILORED TO YOUR ACTIVITIES:
Outdoor & hiking: Detailed information on wind gusts, frost limits and probability of rain.
Skiing & winter sports: Current snowfall limits and detailed mountain weather forecasts for the Alps and worldwide.
Aviation: Use thermal forecasts, trajectories and air stability maps for your flight planning.
Agriculture: Optimise sowing and harvesting with specialised data on soil moisture and spray weather windows.
MAXIMUM FLEXIBILITY:
Multiple weather widgets: Get the latest forecast right on your home screen – from a compact icon to a detailed 5-day outlook.
Personalisation: Choose your preferred units for temperature (°C/°F), wind speed (km/h, mph, knots) and precipitation (mm/in).
Ad-free option: Enjoy meteoblue completely ad-free and with extended features through an annual in-app subscription.
Resizible: Customize your home screen with our widget types that feature a resizable one to fit your personal layout and information density.
Become part of the meteoblue community! More and more users worldwide trust our data on a daily basis. Whether you are a professional meteorologist, outdoor enthusiast or a recreational skipper, meteoblue is your reliable companion in all weather conditions.
Download the app today and experience weather forecasting on a whole new level!
